entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$BIOGENESIS_TITLE$§!，因为你所选的部分选项与其主题相符。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$BIOGENESIS_TITLE$§! as some of the choices you've selected suit its content.

entries.zh: §H特质类别§!\n该特质属于以下类别：
entries.en: §HTrait Categories§!\nThis trait belongs to the following categories:

entries.zh: 该物种的幼体发育不在母体中，而是在卵壳的保护之中进行。这一特质使其人口可以在物质充裕的时期快速增长。
entries.en: The young of this species do not develop inside a parent, but inside the protective shell of an egg. This allows for rapid growth during times of plenty.

entries.zh: 人口增长速度：当居住在拥有本地$r_food$（或等价物）§G产出盈余§!的行星上时§G+15%§!
entries.en: Pop Growth Speed: §G+15%§! while living on a planet with a local $r_food$ (or equivalent) §GProduction Surplus§!

entries.zh: 该物种在一颗存在周期性季节且可以支持冬眠的行星上演化。在现代，可以通过人工模拟这种季节性节律来有效地储存生产力较低的社会成员。
entries.en: This species has evolved on a planet with cyclical seasons that support hibernation. In the modern age, these seasonal triggers can be artificially simulated to efficiently store less productive members of society.

entries.zh: 受雇人口维护费：§G-15%§!\n    —失业及['concept_denizen']人口维护费：§G-75%§!
entries.en: Employed Pop Upkeep: §G-15%§!\n    - Unemployed and ['concept_denizen'] Pop Upkeep: §G-75%§!

entries.zh: 该物种脆弱的骨骼使其移动轻盈。然而，他们更容易受到星球重力效应的影响。
entries.en: The fragile bones of this species allow them to move elegantly and with ease. However, they are also more susceptible to the gravitational effects of their world.

entries.zh: 每行星规模导致的$pop_cat_worker_plural$、$pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$、士兵岗位$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$：§R-0.67%§!
entries.en: $BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ $pop_cat_worker_plural$, $pop_cat_simple_drone_plural$, and Soldier Jobs per Planet Size: §R-0.67%§!

entries.zh: 该物种在几乎任何环境中扎根生活，这导致迁移对他们而言变得极其痛苦。
entries.en: This species literally takes root in whichever environment they find themselves, making removal a highly traumatic experience.

entries.zh: §R人口不会自动迁移§!\n    —强制迁移花费花费：§R+200%§!
entries.en: §RPops will not Automatically Resettle§!\n    - Resettlement Cost: §R+200%§!

entries.zh: 该物种的内液是最强有力的防御。这些高腐蚀性且致命的液体一定会让任何敌人后悔刺破它的身躯。
entries.en: The internal fluids of this species serve as their most potent defense. Highly corrosive and lethal, these liquids ensure that any enemies regret poking holes.

entries.zh: 陆军§Y死亡时爆炸§!，对敌人造成§G250§!伤害\n    —$mod_pop_cat_purge_bonus_workforce_mult$：§R-75%§!
entries.en: Armies §YExplode on Death§! for §G250§! Damage to Enemies\n    - $mod_pop_cat_purge_bonus_workforce_mult$: §R-75%§!

entries.zh: 这些物种会把居室带在身上，这些居室可能是天然长出的、偶然发现的或是设计而来的。这些外壳提供了一个安全的庇护所，使其在夜间一定有安寝之地。
entries.en: Whether naturally grown or found by chance (or design), this species carries their homes with them. These shells provide a protective sanctuary, ensuring there is always a place to rest for the night.

entries.zh: 这种物种是伪装大师，能与周围环境完美融合，几乎使其自身对捕食者和猎物都不可见。它们对光学的先天理解使其在游击战中占据优势。
entries.en: Masters of disguise, this species seamlessly merges with their surroundings, rendering themselves nearly invisible to predators and prey alike. Their innate understanding of optics gives them an edge in guerilla warfare.

entries.zh: 凭借其对色彩的艺术运用，这种物种已超越了简单的伪装，进化出通过其身上鲜艳而复杂的图案进行交流的能力。
entries.en: Harnessing the artistry of color, this species has transcended mere camouflage, evolving to communicate through the vibrant and intricate patterns displayed on their bodies.

entries.zh: 或任何用身体变色交流的物种
entries.en: Or any species using body coloration to communicate

entries.zh: 这种物种天生脆弱，即使是最普通的日常活动，也必须万分小心，以免破碎。
entries.en: Plagued by inherent fragility, this species must exercise extreme caution in daily activities to avoid cracking up during even the most mundane tasks.

entries.zh: 这种物种与其近亲之间有着深厚持久的联系，因此形成了高效且团结的群体。
entries.en: Bound by deep, enduring relationships with their closest relatives, this species forms highly efficient and cohesive collectives.

entries.zh: 同一行星上拥有该特质的每§Y100§!£pop£人口产生的幸福度：§G0.1%§!（最大：§G+20%§!）
entries.en: Happiness per §Y100§! £pop£ Pops with this Trait on the same planet: §G0.1%§! (Max: §G+20%§!)

entries.zh: 该物种覆盖着一层特殊发育的皮肤，需要理想的环境条件。只要该物种不远离其原生气候，这应该不成问题。
entries.en: Specially developed skin that requires ideal conditions coats this species. As long as this species does not stray far from their home climate that shouldn't be a problem.

entries.zh: 与偏好处于不同['concept_climate_category']的星球上的宜居性：§R-20%§!
entries.en: Habitability on worlds with a different ['concept_climate_category'] from our Preference: §R-20%§!

entries.zh: 将知识和经验传承给下一代，是许多文明的开端。而这个物种更进一步，将生存的智慧直接编码到它们的基因中，确保每一代都天生具备祖先积累的智慧。
entries.en: Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations. This species has taken it a step further by encoding survival insights directly into their genetic code, ensuring that each generation is born with the accumulated wisdom of their ancestors.

entries.zh: 殖民地建立年限提升的宜居性：每年§G+0.5%§!（最大§G+25%§!）
entries.en: Habitability from Colony Age: §G+0.5%§! per Year (Max. §G+25%§!)

entries.zh: 或任何具有遗传性生存本能的物种
entries.en: Or any species with inherited survival instincts

entries.zh: 该物种在早期发育阶段生产，导致幼体长期无法为社会做出贡献。在此期间，它们对智慧带来的责任和担当全然不知。
entries.en: This species gives birth at an early stage of development, resulting in a prolonged period where the young are incapable of contributing to society. During this time, they remain blissfully unaware of the responsibilities and burdens that come with sapience.

entries.zh: 带有该特质的人口在新生的前§Y5§!为未开智状态。
entries.en: Newly grown Pops with this trait spend the first §Y5§! Years after being grown as a Pre-Sapient.

entries.zh: 或任何幼年期较长的物种
entries.en: Or any species with an extended infancy period

entries.zh: 在一个短暂的无意识阶段后，这个物种很快就会成长为一个拥有完整智能的存在。
entries.en: Spending a brief time bereft of conscious thought, this species will soon grow up to be a fully sapient being.

entries.zh: 该物种凌驾于陆地限制之上，自由地翱翔于天空。它们的城市拥有独特的密集布局，为空中居民进行了优化。在战斗中，它们极难被发现，是难以捉摸的目标。
entries.en: This species soars above the constraints of the earth, freely navigating the skies. Their cities feature unique, dense layouts, optimized for aerial inhabitants. In conflict, they prove to be elusive and difficult targets.

entries.zh: 或任何适应空中生活的物种
entries.en: Or any species adapted to aerial life

entries.zh: 该物种不仅能够飞行，还拥有独特的脑部结构，使其能够本能地处理和导航三维空间。这些能力使其在规划战斗、勘测星球和管理城市方面无与伦比。
entries.en: Not only capable of flight, this species possesses unique cerebral adaptations, enabling them to instinctively process and navigate three-dimensional spaces. These abilities make them unparalleled in planning battles, surveying planets, and managing cities.

entries.zh: 或任何具有三维空间定位天赋的物种
entries.en: Or any species gifted in three-dimensional navigation

entries.zh: 该物种演化出了冗余的器官，遭受到再严重的损伤都有机会幸存——从他们续存至今来看，这真是一种成功的适应性。
entries.en: This species evolved redundant organs to survive even the most grievous injuries - a successful adaptation, as evidenced by their continued existence.

entries.zh: 领袖能够躲避第一次死亡降临\n    —进攻部队死亡时：§G20%§!几率生成一支替补部队\n    —£job_livestock£ §Y$job_livestock$§!岗位效率：§G+50%§!
entries.en: Leaders will survive their first death\n    - On Offensive Army Death: §G20%§! Chance to spawn a Replacement Army\n    - £job_livestock£ §Y$job_livestock$§! Job Efficiency: §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 这位领袖被他们独特的生理机能救了一命，但不会再有下一次了。
entries.en: This leader was saved from certain death by their unique biology, it will not happen again.

entries.zh: §R警告：禁用除['concept_mutation_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。§!\n\n该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
entries.en: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].§!\n\nThis species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

entries.zh: [GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。\n\n
entries.en: The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.\n\n

entries.zh:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$我们一直清楚，是猎物的血肉塑造了我们自己——每次狩猎、杀戮都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，在[GetStartingDrive]带来的黎明中，我们已经做好准备潜入星系这片狩猎场，收获其中所有的一切。
entries.en:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the dawn of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

entries.zh:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$我们的集体潜意识一直知道自己的基因潜能——我们可以吸收并适应猎物的特性，将它们的优势整合到我们的集体中。

这种古老的捕食本能延续至今达到了一种受控平衡。我们不再需要依赖狩猎来进化，而是可以在实验室内合成任何遗传物质并将其无缝地分发到整个蜂巢中。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已经做好了准备踏遍星系，收获其中的一切。
entries.en:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$Our shared intelligence implicitly has always understood the potential of our genetics - we can absorb and adapt the essence of our quarry, integrating their strengths into our collective.

That ancient predatory instinct still lingers, but now it is balanced and controlled. No longer must we hunt to evolve; our labs can synthesize any genetic material and seamlessly distribute it throughout our hive.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to spread across the galaxy and savor all it has to offer.

entries.zh:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$直到吞噬了[GetHomeWorldName]上的一切生命形式后我们才意识到了自己的愚蠢。这下我们得上哪儿去找到新的适应力？于是我们抬起了头。

一般的猎食者为了生存狩猎，而我们作为完美的猎食者，狩猎是为了达到我们自身的完美。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们又一次做好了屏息凝神的准备。星系无边无垠，宛如一场饕餮盛宴。
entries.en:
$START_SCREEN_EVOLUTIONARY_PREDATORS_BASE$Only after we had consumed every last lifeform on [GetHomeWorldName] did we realize our folly. How would we get new adaptations now? So we looked up.

We are the ultimate predators. Others hunt to survive; we hunt to perfect ourselves.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to prowl once more. The galaxy is vast, and full of food.

entries.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]生来便是猎手。浩瀚虚空也不过是我们追猎过的最深邃的荒野——而方舟就是我们生长出的最锋利的獠牙。在饥饿的驱使下，没有我们无法穿透的黑暗，也没有遥不可及的距离。

我们深知，猎物的血肉塑造了我们——每次狩猎、杀戮，都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，随着[GetStartingDrive]的部署，我们已准备巡视星海，收获其中所有的一切。
entries.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. The void is simply the deepest wilderness we have ever stalked - and our arkship, the sharpest fang we have ever grown. No darkness too complete, no distance too great, when hunger drives us forward.

We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the fleet-wide installation of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

entries.en: §LThis species does not stick as rigidly to identifiable features and organs as most other species do. Instead they grow the best appendage for the job. However this instability has some drawbacks.§!

entries.zh: §L该适应力能产生钻石一般坚硬的利爪，使其更容易提取矿物。§!
entries.en: §LWith diamond-hard digits, this adaptation allows for easier extraction of minerals.§!

entries.zh: §L一层厚厚的绝缘体，可以防止各种意外，在各种高能环境中尤为有效。§!
entries.en: §LA thick insulating layer safeguards against accidents, especially in high-energy environments.§!

entries.zh: §L长有锹状指甲的额外附肢可以加快翻土和播种。这些犁肢适应各种地貌环境，永远是相应岗位的不二之选。§!
entries.en: §LAn extra appendage with a hardened shovel-like digit speeds up tilling and planting. Adapting to various terrain types, these malleable plows are always the right tool for the job.§!

entries.zh: §L虽然让中央皮质充血稍有不适，但这可以大幅提高处理问题和创新的速度。§!
entries.en: §LWhile an engorged central cortex is slightly uncomfortable, it dramatically accelerates problem-solving and innovation.§!

entries.zh: §L增强感觉器官使我们更能理解和欣赏不同的观点。审慎观察方能蓬勃生长。§!
entries.en: §LEnhanced sensory organs facilitate a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives. Before you can thrive, you must first observe.§!

entries.zh: §L在操作滚烫或有者腐蚀性的物质时，皮肤上增厚的胼胝有百利无一害。§!
entries.en: §LWhen handling scalding or corrosive materials, extra-thick calluses can be invaluable.§!

entries.zh: §L具有高适应性的信息素可以在谈判中显著地提升说服力。§!
entries.en: §LHighly adaptive pheromones can be incredibly persuasive during negotiations.§!

entries.zh: §L一系列高精度孔使得该物种仅通过移动就能发出舒缓和谐的声音。§!
entries.en: §LA series of highly-calibrated holes allows this species to produce soothing, and harmonious sounds simply by moving about.§!

一个由“进化掠夺”定义的民族，只会允许其适应性最强的人领导他们。这位巅峰统治者不仅掠夺失败者的基因组，还夺取他们的智慧和决心，将每一次胜利都转化为走向完美统治的阶梯。
entries.en: A people defined by Evolutionary Predation would allow none but their most adaptable to lead them. This apex ruler not only harvests the genomes of defeated foes, but also appropriates their cunning and resolve, turning every victory into a step toward perfect mastery.

$t$使别国§Y臣服§!

entries.en:
The Apex Predator grows when:
$t$Winning §YWars§!
$t$§YSubjugating§! Others
$t$Causing resolutions to fail in the §YGalactic Community§!

entries.zh: 我们的顶级掠食者$LEADER|Y$击败§Y[This.GetApexDefeatedSpecies]§!并得到了进一步成长。
entries.en: Our Apex Predator $LEADER|Y$ has defeated the §Y[This.GetApexDefeatedSpecies]§! and grown further.

entries.zh: 我们已经开始了将$PLANET|Y$环境改造为§Y蜂巢星球§!的进程。
entries.en: We have started the process to terraform $PLANET|Y$ into a §YHive World.§!

entries.zh: 有些星球不需要成为我们集体的一部分。
entries.en: Some worlds need not become a part of our collective.

entries.zh: 避免我们的§Y政权§!将此改造为§Y蜂巢星球§!。
entries.en: Prevents our §YAuthority§! from turning this into a §YHive World§!.

entries.zh: 该星球注定值得成我们的一部分。
entries.en: This planet is deemed worthy to become part of us.

entries.zh: 允许我们的§Y政权§!将此改造为§Y蜂巢星球§!。
entries.en: Allows our §YAuthority§! to turn this into a §YHive World§!.

entries.zh: 随着不断与新物种遭遇，我们对各种独特的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']进行分析、传播。一旦完成，我们就可以演化，向我们的基因编码中永久性地增添新的正面§Y物种特质§!。
entries.en: Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive §YSpecies Trait§! to our own genetic code.

entries.zh: 该§Y局势§!的进展取决于我们吞噬的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']数量，也可以依据§Y应对方案§!加快推进速度。
entries.en: The progress of this §YSituation§! is dependent on how many ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] we consume. It can progress faster depending on the §YApproach§!.

entries.zh: 我们会基于现已吞噬的基因物质获取一个新的永久性物种特质。[Owner.GetConsumedGenes]
entries.en: We will gain a new permanent species trait based on the genetic material we consumed. [Owner.GetConsumedGenes]

entries.zh:
§Y基因洞见可以通过如下方式获得：§!
$t$—殖民新行星
$t$—净化或将其他物种圈养为牲口
$t$—在帝国中拥有奴隶或更好阶层的其他物种
$t$—在['concept_council']雇佣外星领袖
$t$—保有签有§Y基因什一税§!协议的附庸
$t$—作为巨型企业，维持商业协议
$t$—通过事件遭遇外星生命
entries.en:
§YGenetic Insights can be gained by:§!
$t$- Colonizing new planets
$t$- Purging or keeping other species as Livestock
$t$- Keeping other species within our Empire as slaves or better
$t$- Employing alien leaders on our ['concept_council']
$t$- Keeping vassals with §YGenetic Tithe§! Agreeement
$t$- For Megacorps, maintaining Commercial Pacts
$t$- Encountering alien life through events

entries.zh: 豢养§Y牲口§!和§Y净化人口§!产生的局势进展提升§G+50%§!
entries.en: Increases Situation Progress from §YLivestock§! and §YPurged Pops§! by §G+50%§!

entries.zh: §Y行星殖民地§!产生的局势进展提升§G+50%§!
entries.en: Increases Situation Progress from §YPlanet Colonies§! by §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 奴隶及以上的外星§Y物种§!、§Y领袖§!和§Y附庸国§!产生的局势进展提升§G+50%§!
entries.en: Increases Situation Progress from alien §YSpecies§! that are slaves or better, §YLeaders§!, and §YSubjects§! §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 推进§Y适应进化§!事件进度：§G增加5%§!
推进§Y适应进化§!事件进度：§G增加10%§!
推进§Y适应进化§!事件进度：§G增加20%§!
我们的下次演化将新增
entries.en: DNA will be added to our next evolution.

entries.zh: 该条款指定附属国是否要向宗主国上交基因样本。
entries.en: This Term dictates whether or not the Subject sends samples of their DNA to their Overlord.

entries.zh: 该附属国向宗主上交基因信息。
entries.en: The Subject sends DNA packets to the Overlord.

entries.zh: 该该附属国无需向宗主上交基因信息。
entries.en: The Subject does not send their DNA to the Overlord.

entries.zh: 我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。\n\n无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。
entries.en: Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.\n\nWhatever decision we make will affect the future of the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] for generations to come.

entries.zh: 向我们的首要物种增加一个新的物种特质。
entries.en: Adds a new Species Trait to our Primary Species

entries.zh: 我们的物种需要成长得更快！
entries.en: Our species needs to grow faster!
Can we be made more productive?

entries.zh: 我们的领袖需要各种优势。
我们需要适应变化的气候。
entries.en: We need to adapt to shifting climates.

entries.zh: 降低我们人口所需要的维护费。
entries.en: Reduce the upkeep required to sustain our people.

entries.zh: 类人物种特质可以增强我们的适应力。
entries.en: Humanoid traits could enhance our versatility.

entries.zh: 哺乳类基因藏着更多秘密。
鸟类可以让我们无比轻盈。
entries.en: Avians could grant us unmatched agility.
Even a molluscoid can teach us something.

entries.zh: 真菌类扩张迅速——我们也可以。
entries.en: Fungoids spread rapidly - we could too.

entries.zh: 植物类的能量效率大有裨益。
entries.en: The energy efficiency of the plantoids could be useful.

entries.zh: 石质类基因难以下咽，但也存在可口的可能性。
entries.en: Difficult to consume, lithoid DNA offers delicious possibilities.

entries.zh: 死灵类的肉体也还是肉体。
水生类的适应力能在大海之外也带来生存策略。
entries.en: Aquatic adaptations offer survival strategies beyond the sea.

entries.zh: 嗜热者§R会燃烧§!，但我们能处理好。
entries.en: The Thermophiles §Rburn§!, but now we can handle it.

entries.zh: 稳定等离子体基因将会是一场饕餮盛宴。
entries.en: Stabilizing Plasmic DNA would be an impressive feat.

entries.zh: 星系中的巨物们能教会我们些什么呢？
entries.en: What can the Titans of the galaxy teach us?

entries.zh: 灵能基因组中究竟是什么激发了这样的超凡认知力？
entries.en: What within the Psionic genome fuels such cognitive prowess?

entries.zh: 拥抱混沌——让直觉指引我们！
entries.en: Embrace the chaos - let our instincts guide us!

entries.zh: 让变异产生的能力带我们突破自然的限制。
entries.en: Let mutation unlock abilities beyond our natural limitations!

entries.zh: 由于选择了§Y$tr_mutation_unnatural_selection$§!传统，该选项可用。
entries.en: This option is available due to the selection of the §Y$tr_mutation_unnatural_selection$§! Tradition.

entries.zh: 由于选择了§Y$tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation$§!传统，该选项可用。
entries.en: This option is available due to the selection of the §Y$tr_mutation_nucleotide_isolation$§! Tradition.

entries.zh: 一颗供我们品尝享用的新星球。定居者们正在对该星球上所存在的一切进行编目和理解。
entries.en: A new world to taste and assimilate. The settlers are in the process of cataloging and understanding everything this planet has to offer.

entries.zh: 这里再没有什么事物是新鲜的了；曾经踏遍了每一块岩石搜寻独特生物特性的定居者们现在心满意足。
entries.en: There is nothing more to discover here; the settlers who once scoured every rock for signs of biological uniqueness are now satisfied.

entries.zh: 自古以来这颗行星就一直在产出基因异常。这些大陆上的住民千奇百怪、无穷无尽。
entries.en: Since time immemorial this world has produced genetic oddities. There is no end to the variety that inhabits these lands.

entries.zh: 该星球的居住者们开始快速地观测当地生物群并收集它们独特的基因。
entries.en: The inhabitants of this world are quick to observe and collect the genetic uniqueness of the local fauna.

entries.zh: 我们可以更直接一些地去获取基因物质——渗透到该物种中悄悄地收集。
entries.en: We can be more direct in acquiring genetic material - by infiltrating this species and discreetly collecting unattended DNA.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n§Y$evolutionary_predators_situation$§!局势获得小幅度进展并且得到该主体物种的基因。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nGain minor progress on the §Y$evolutionary_predators_situation$§! situation and the DNA of the primary species.

entries.zh: 我们的特工正在[Target.GetSpeciesName]定居点潜行，很快将能进入他们的建筑。我们需要耐心，而我们有的是耐心——最好的猎手总是从容不迫的。
entries.en: Our operatives are prowling [Target.GetSpeciesName] settlements and will soon gain access to their structures. All in good time. We are a patient breed; the best hunts are never rushed.

entries.zh: 猎物就在眼前。我们派遣去渗透[Target.GetName]的猎手非常有信心。他们将很快能进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]的居住区，宝贵的基因物质触手可及。
entries.en: Our prey is in sight. The hunters we sent to infiltrate the [Target.GetName] are confident. They will soon have access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory, and all of the precious DNA within.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经准备就绪。他们已经获得了进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]集居地的权限，并且准备好了合适的伪装。当然，像任何优秀的猎手一样，他们已经确保了多条撤离路线，有些比较体面，有些则不太体面。如果不得不使用下水道逃生，那可就太不幸了。
entries.en: Our agents are ready. They have gained access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory as well as proper disguises. Naturally, like any good hunter, they have secured multiple escape routes, some more agreeable than others. It will be unfortunate should we need to make use of the sewers.

entries.zh: 成功了！我们的特工带着一大堆基因物质满载而归，这样一来在下一次突变时我们又能确保获取巨大的优势了。也许我们还可以发展出对[From.Target.GetSpeciesName]的一些口味偏好。
entries.en: It is done! Our operatives have come away with a wealth of genetic material. We are sure to see great advancements when next we mutate. Perhaps we might even develop a taste for the [From.Target.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 自然选择和基因漂变再也不能阻止我们主宰生物学规律。作为一个文明，我们正在重塑物种未来的门槛前。[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]如同黏土，而我们将会是自己的雕刻家。
entries.en: Natural selection and genetic drift no longer stand between us and biological dominance. As a civilization, we are on the verge of redefining the future of our species. Our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] is clay, and we are its sculptor.

entries.zh: 我们的基因学家正在持续推进研究工作。
entries.en: Our geneticists steadily advance our research.

entries.zh: 我们将会解锁基因操纵的全部潜力，确保自己物种的绝对优势。\n\n我们将决定基因重塑的终极表达。
entries.en: We will unlock the full potential of genetic manipulation and ensure the advancement of our species.\n\nWe will choose the ultimate expression of Biomorphosis.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们已经为该阶段做好了选择。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$We have already made our choice for this stage.

entries.zh: 为了加速进化，我们必须果断地选择出一条进行自我定义的道路。当开始意识到自己全部的潜力时，我们敏锐地意识到，这种努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。\n\n设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。如今的变革亦将重塑我们的未来。
entries.en: To expedite our evolution, we must decisively select the path that will define our journey. As we begin to realize our full potential, we are acutely aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our very essence.\n\nEngineering evolution is a task of profound significance. The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

entries.zh: $bio.5.desc.no_options$\n\n为了开始自我的提升，现在必须选择旅程的第一步要踏向何方。
entries.en: $bio.5.desc.no_options$\n\nTo begin uplifting ourselves, we must now choose on which path we will begin our journey.

entries.zh: 设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在拥有对基因特质、繁衍和基因测序的更深层次理解。\n\n我们进步的顶峰近在眼前。在短短几年内，我们将充分实现自身作为一个物种的全部潜力。
entries.en: Engineering our own evolution has led to profound advancements. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.\n\nThe culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

entries.zh: $bio.10.desc.no_options$\n\n然而在目前，我们还会继续在当前道路上前进，或为我们下一个发展阶段改变焦点。
entries.en: $bio.10.desc.no_options$\n\nAt the present however, we may continue on our current path, or choose another focus for the next stage of our development.

entries.zh: 我们的努力把自己推到了一个重大变革的前夕。我们很快就必须对前进道路做出关键决定，从而充分实现我们的进化潜力。
entries.en: Our efforts have led us to the brink of a significant evolutionary shift. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

entries.zh: $bio.15.desc.no_options$\n\n需要再次重新确定着力点了。
entries.en: $bio.15.desc.no_options$\n\nWe must once again decide where we should focus our efforts.

entries.zh: 变异会将我们带向未来。
entries.en: Mutation will lead us to the future.

entries.zh: 我们将着力于保持纯净。
entries.en: We will focus our efforts on becoming pure.

entries.zh: 克隆研究可以促进我们成长。
entries.en: Cloning research will allow us to grow.

entries.zh: 我们的未来在于基因突变。
entries.en: Our future lies with genetic mutation.

entries.zh: 无论我们是为追求最纯粹的自我而奋斗，还是以克隆铺就成功之路，抑或是通过有意的基因突变来增强自我，此刻过后我们都将为自己的选择一往无前。
entries.en: Whether we strive for the purest form of ourselves, clone our way to success, or genetically augment ourselves through deliberate mutation, this moment marks a point of no return.

entries.zh: 我们的本质始终是可塑的。我们是宇宙中最复杂的生命形式，借助我们的研究，我们将不断改变。\n\n未来是混沌的，而这正是我们所需要的。
entries.en: Our nature has always been malleable. We are the most complex lifeform in this universe, and with the help of our research we shall keep changing.\n\nThe future is chaotic, and that is perfect for us.

entries.zh: 我们将深察纯净之真谛。
entries.en: We will know what it means to be pure.

entries.zh: 我们会以克隆通向成功。
entries.en: We will clone ourselves to success.

entries.zh: 我们将驾驭变异的力量。
由于我们对基因纯净的侧重，得到增益的公民们开始认为自己天生就比其他人优越。由于这种优越感，他们要求更短的工作时间、更多的便利设施和更多的政治权力。他们日益激烈的集会正在造成严重的社会混乱。
entries.en: As a result of our focus on genetic purification, augmented citizens have begun to view themselves as inherently superior to the rest of the population. They demand shorter work days, more amenities, and stronger political power due to their perceived superiority. Their increasingly aggressive rallies are causing significant societal disruption.

entries.zh: 新闻公报上充斥着分裂言论，分歧正在撕裂社会。得到改良基因的人获得了更多的机会，由此催生了一种新的阶级斗争。\n\n基因增强者相信他们代表了我们物种的未来，而传统主义者则认为我们在非自然领域走得太远了。
entries.en: Divisive rhetoric dominates news bulletins, and disagreements are tearing social units apart. A new kind of class struggle is emerging, as more opportunities fall to those with modified genes.\n\nThe genetically enhanced believe they represent the future of our species, while traditionalists feel we are straying too far into unnatural territory.

entries.zh: 优越的个体造就优越的世界。
entries.en: Superior individuals for a superior world.

entries.zh: 也许要等等我们的人民。
entries.en: Perhaps we are moving too fast.

entries.zh: 在某些行业，纯度检测滥用愈发司空见惯。那些被认为拥有优越基因组成的人在工作、教育方面将受到优待，并被盲目地授予更容易获得权力的职位。\n\n虽然一些人认为，生物增强的个体确实更强壮、更健康，但另一些人则认为，这种心态对那些不愿或无法改变基因组以追求基因完美的人造成了不当的歧视。
entries.en: Arbitrary purity tests are becoming commonplace in some industries. Those deemed to have superior genetic makeup are receiving preferential treatment in work, education, and blindly granted easier access to positions of power.\n\nWhile some argue that individuals with bio-enhancements are indeed stronger and healthier, others contend that this mindset creates undue discrimination for those unwilling or unable to alter their genomes in the pursuit of genetic perfection.

entries.zh: 我们必须确保所有人的机会均等。
entries.en: We must ensure equal opportunities for all.
This is survival of the fittest.

entries.zh: 我们对纯洁的追求使某些人敢于在公共安全方面发挥突出作用。由于拥有超强的力量、敏捷和耐力，一小群行善者将自己塑造成侠客，将法律掌握在自己[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。\n\n然而，这种新颖的勇气并非无人挑战。在阴影中，同样强大的对手正在出现，他们的的邪恶意图是达成力量的平衡。两个阵营之间的冲突造成重大财产损失，甚至危及平民。
entries.en: Our push for purity has emboldened certain individuals to assume a prominent role in public safety. Enhanced with super strength, agility, and endurance, small gangs of do-gooders are styling themselves as champions, taking the law into their own [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].\n\nHowever, this newfound valor has not gone unchallenged. In the shadows, equally augmented adversaries are emerging, their malevolent intentions fueled by a desire to balance the scales of power. Clashes between the two camps are causing significant property damage and even endangering civilians.

entries.zh: 我们的街道不需要义务警员。
entries.en: Vigilantes have no place on our streets.

entries.zh: 超能力个体的活动已经被取缔了，他们现在受到了严格的的规定限制。我们正着力监视并遏制这种活动。\n\n当我们努力确保他们只使用自己的力量为帝国服务时，超能力者和未增强者感受到了越来越多的恐惧和蔑视。我们的人民在这个问题上有着严重的分歧。
entries.en: We have clamped down on the activities of super-powered individuals. These beings now face harsh restrictions and regulations. Our surveillance efforts have allowed us to monitor and curb their activities.\n\nWhile we work hard to ensure they only use their powers in service to our empire, there is growing fear and disdain among the super-powered and the un-augmented. Our population is heavily divided on this matter.

entries.zh: 帮助弱势群体重返社会。
我们对基因强化义警的依赖程度与日俱增，这已成为一把双刃剑。虽然这些存在为我们带来了安全感和福祉，但我们也清楚地意识到自己对他们的依赖程度。\n\n民众虽然心怀感激，但现在他们开始绕过司法程序和行政官，转而向这些超能力者寻求指导和支持。英雄与政府之间的界限已经模糊。权力正处于一个微妙的平衡点。
entries.en: Our increasing reliance on genetically enhanced vigilantes has become a double-edged sword. While these beings provide us a sense of safety and wellbeing, it is not lost on us how much we have come to depend on them.\n\nThe people are grateful, but they now turn to these super-powered individuals for guidance and support, bypassing the judiciary process and ignoring officials. The distinction between the heroes and the government has blurred. Power hangs in the balance.

entries.zh: 限制这些\"英雄\"参与政务。
entries.en: Restrict the "heroes" involvement with government affairs.

entries.zh:
一位因其不知疲倦的工作态度而在全星系备受赞誉的杰出领袖，被揭露其实不是一个人，而是两个人。

事实表明，这位领袖获得了一个完美克隆体，让两人能够轮班工作。当一个克隆体在执行公务和处理行政事务时，另一个则在秘密休息和恢复。

这一揭露在政治领域掀起了轩然大波，引发了人们对领导力本质和克隆技术伦理界限的质疑。
entries.en:
A prominent leader, celebrated galaxy-wide for their tireless work ethic, has been revealed to be not one, but two individuals.

It has come to light that this leader obtained a perfect clone, allowing each to work in alternating shifts. While one clone engaged in public duties and administrative toil, the other would rest and recuperate in secrecy.

This revelation has sent shockwaves through the political landscape, calling into question the true nature of leadership and the ethical boundaries of cloning technology.

entries.zh: 这是克隆技术的高效运用。
因欺骗行为将两人一并革职。
entries.en: Dismiss them both for their deceit.

entries.zh: 委托制造克隆体用于器官摘取的做法已经引发了问题。一些明显具有感知能力的克隆体，正在通过长期绝食的方式进行反抗。\n\n虽然许多人认为原体的健康和长寿应当优先考虑，但也有人主张每个具有思维能力的存在都应当拥有个人自主权。这个有争议的问题现已成为激烈辩论的焦点。
entries.en: The practice of commissioning clones for organ harvesting is already leading to complications. Several clones, obviously possessing sentience, are rebelling by means of a protracted hunger strike.\n\nWhile many argue that the health and longevity of an original should take precedence, others contend that every thinking being has the right to personal autonomy. This contentious issue is now a subject of heated debate.
The rights of the original are paramount.

entries.zh: 执法部门陷入了两难境地。我们首都的犯罪率正在上升，但被绳之以法的人却比以往任何时候都少。嫌疑人越来越多地以其克隆体犯案为由进行辩护。\n\n一旦没有人赃并获，就几乎不可能证明嫌犯的罪行。一些司法人员现在呼吁废除大多数非法行为的罪名。
entries.en: Law enforcement is in a quandary. Crime in our capital is on the rise, yet fewer people than ever are facing justice. Suspected criminals are increasingly pleading not guilty, claiming their clones committed the offenses.\n\nIn cases where suspects are not caught in the act, it has become nearly impossible to prove guilt. Some judiciaries are now calling for the effective decriminalization of most illicit activities.

entries.zh: 在我们的境内发现了一座未经授权的大型克隆设施，里面安置着数千个复制人，每一个都是我们[Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Owner.Leader.GetName]的复制品。现场发现的平民科学家已被拘留，但没有人愿意合作，都声称不知道是谁下令制造这些克隆体。\n\n零星的证据表明[Owner.Leader.GetName][Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself]自己可能是这一行动的幕后主使。不幸的是，[Owner.Leader.GetSheHe]已经消失得无影无踪。
entries.en: A massive unsanctioned cloning facility has been uncovered within our borders, housing thousands of doppelgangers, each a replica of our [Owner.Leader.GetTitle], [Owner.Leader.GetName]. Civilian scientists found on-site have been taken into custody, but none are cooperating, claiming ignorance of who ordered the clones.\n\nSparse evidence suggests [Owner.Leader.GetName] [Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself] may be behind this operation. Unfortunately, [Owner.Leader.GetSheHe] vanished without a trace.

entries.zh: 我们继承了一支克隆军团。
entries.en: We have inherited a clone army.
We will gain a group of §YPops§!.

entries.zh: 对如此多克隆体实施安乐死的做法引发了公众愤怒，并引发了严肃的争论。不满的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]权利活动人士和宗教团体正在举行大规模抗议。\n\n与此同时，有传言称一些克隆体已经逃脱，正潜伏在普通民众之中。
entries.en: Euthanizing so many clones has sparked outrage and triggered serious debate. Disgruntled [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] rights activists and religious groups are staging large scale protests.\n\nMeanwhile, there are rumors that some of the clones escaped, and are lurking among the general public.

entries.zh: 也许我们能从中吸取教训...
entries.en: Perhaps we can learn from this...

entries.zh: 部署安全部队平息骚动。
entries.en: Deploy security forces to silence the rabble.

entries.zh: 许多具有显著或非常规基因变异的个体已被社会排斥。被迫转入地下的这些变种人已经形成了他们自己的聚居地。\n\n那些冒险进入这些区域的人很少能够回来。
entries.en: Many individuals with prominent or unconventional genetic mutations have been ostracized from society. Forced underground, these mutants have formed their own enclaves.\n\nThose who venture into these areas seldom return.

entries.zh: 远距离监控他们的发展。
entries.en: Monitor their progress. From a distance.

entries.zh:
失意的年轻人开始以极端娱乐的方式剧烈改变自己的外貌。

最新的潮流包括对复眼的狂热追求，以及比拼在一个身体上能够添加多少额外肢体，目前的记录是156个。

这些生物黑客已经引起了公众关注，引发了安全方面的担忧。随着对基因变异进行严格限制的呼声日益高涨，我们必须确定官方立场。
entries.en:
Disenfranchised youths have begun drastically altering their appearances as a form of extreme amusement.

The latest trends include a mania for compound eyes, and competitions to see how many additional limbs are possible on a single body, with the current record set at 156.

These biohackers have garnered public attention, raising safety concerns. As calls for strict restrictions on genetic mutations grow louder, we must decide our official stance.

entries.zh: 这只是无害的娱乐而已。

在我们的文明中广泛采用基因操作技术催生出了令人目不暇接的各种身体变异。

一些原本可预测的生理过程现在出现了意外的偏差，使得标准化几乎不可能实现。

曾经统一我们物种的身体共性正在消解，取而代之的是一个由各种形态和功能组成的万花筒，这正在动摇社会的凝聚力。
entries.en:
The widespread adoption of genetic manipulation across our civilization has spawned a bewildering array of physical variations.

Once predictable biological processes now exhibit unexpected deviations, making standardization nearly impossible.

The shared sense of physical commonality that once unified our species is dissolving, replaced by a kaleidoscope of forms and functions that strain societal cohesion.

entries.zh: 随机§Y400§!£pop£§H人口§!将获得['trait:trait_bioadaptability']、['trait:trait_social_pheromones']或['trait:trait_limited_regeneration']特质之一。
强制执行标准基因模板。

一项转基因实验灾难性地失败了。科学家们试图将测试对象的DNA与其他多细胞生物的DNA进行拼接，以激活超级免疫反应，使其对所有病毒都具有免疫力。

然而，他们反而创造出了一种能够溶解接触到的任何生物体细胞壁的生物，它会与接触对象融合，形成一团巨大的、无定形的生物质团。

这团生物质在测试设施中滚动前进，吞噬了沿途的一切。目前它已被控制住，但如果逃脱的话将会造成重大的健康危害。值得庆幸的是，它似乎是可食用的...
entries.en:
A transgenic experiment has gone disastrously wrong. Scientists attempted to splice the DNA of test subjects with that of other multicellular organisms to activate a hyperimmune response, rendering them impervious to all viruses.

Instead, they created a creature that dissolves the cell walls of any organism it contacts, fusing with it to become one large, amorphous mass of biological material.

This blob rolled through the test facility, absorbing everything in its path. It has been contained for now, but poses a significant health hazard if it escapes. Thankfully, it also appears edible...
Studying the blob is worth the risk.

entries.zh: 基因工蜂正在逐步推进我们的研究。
entries.en: Geneticist drones gradually advance our research.

entries.zh: [owner.GetGovernmentName]正在发生转变。我们即将实现自身的全部潜能，同时也意识到这个努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。设计我们自身的进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在实施的改变将会在未来产生深远的影响。
entries.en: The [owner.GetGovernmentName] is transforming. We are about to realize our full potential, aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our essence. Engineering our own evolution is a task of profound significance. The changes we implement now will ripple far into the future.

entries.zh: $bio.25.desc.no_options$\n\n我们现在必须为进化的第一阶段选择一个发展重点。
entries.en: $bio.25.desc.no_options$\n\nWe must now choose a focus for the first stage of our development.

entries.zh:
设计我们自身的进化已经带来了显著的改变。我们现在对基因特征、繁殖过程和DNA序列有了更深入的理解。

我们的工作即将达到顶峰。

不久之后，我们将成为注定要成为的样子。
entries.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to significant change. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our work is within reach.

Soon, we will become what we were always meant to be.

entries.zh: $bio.30.desc.no_options$我们有机会选择继续沿当前道路前进，或选择新的焦点。
entries.en: $bio.30.desc.no_options$ We have an opportunity to continue on our current path, or choose a new focus.

entries.zh: 我们正处在一个重大演化突破的边缘。我们很快就要为充分发挥演化潜力而面临关键的抉择。
entries.en: We are on the brink of a significant evolutionary breakthrough. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

entries.zh: $bio.35.desc.no_options$\n\n我们必须再一次选择优先事项。
entries.en: $bio.35.desc.no_options$\n\nOnce more, we must choose where our priorities lie.

entries.zh: 无论我们是追求最纯粹的自我形态，还是通过克隆技术走向成功，抑或是通过刻意突变来进行基因增强，这一刻都标志着一个不可回头的转折点。
entries.en: Whether we strive for the purest form of ourselves, clone our way to success, or genetically augment ourselves through deliberate mutation, this moment marks a point of no return.

entries.zh:
当我们开始对[target.GetGestaltEntityName]进行生物提升时，我们必须优先考虑那些最能使我们的文明受益的强化项目。

选择性基因操控让我们能够培育出最适合特定的工业领域的理想体征。

有了这些新获得的能力，我们可以选择强化能源生产领域或防御领域的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。
entries.en:
As we begin to biologically uplift the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], we must prioritize only those enhancements that will most benefit our civilization.

Selective gene manipulation allows us to breed specialists with desirable physical features who are best suited to specific industries.

With these newfound abilities, we have the opportunity to either bolster [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] who work in energy production, or defense.

entries.zh: 我们应该优先考虑防御。
在给工蜂制定新的模板时，必须决定好如何处理那些无法承受基因升级的个体。\n\n有一些较老的工蜂过于虚弱无法承受调整。可以将其保留作劳动力度过余生，或将回收他们的生物质补给蜂巢。
entries.en: As we introduce a new biological template for our drones, we must decide how to handle those incompatible with the genetic upgrade.\n\nSome older drones lack the strength to endure the alterations. We could either retain them as labor for the remainder of their lifespan, or recycle their biomatter to replenish the hive.

entries.zh:
一项突破性基因研究揭示了一种增强神经传递效率的方式，可以显著提升[target.GetIndividualName]的产出。

然而，这种对大脑输出功率的提升并不能长期维持，会导致寿命缩短。

我们必须决定是要保持正常的寿命或是以长寿为代价换取更强的能力。
entries.en:
A breakthrough in genetic research has revealed a way to enhance neural relay efficiency, significantly boosting [target.GetIndividualName] productivity.

However, this increase in brain output is not sustainable over a long period, leading to a shorter lifespan.

We must decide whether to retain our regular lifespans or develop heightened functioning at the cost of longevity.

entries.zh: 我们目前的寿命更加重要。

一批新增强的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经集成到了[target.GetGestaltEntityName]中，它们经过生物工程的微调，加速了神经发育和认知过程。[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的关键突触节点正以前所未有的速度运转。\n\n然而，这种加速破坏了[target.GetIndividualName]的稳定性，有可能造成灾难性的突触过载。我们或许还可以重新分配更多的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]来执行协调任务。
entries.en: A batch of newly augmented [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has been integrated into the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], their biological engineering fine-tuned to accelerate neural development and cognitive processes. The [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s key synaptic nodes are now operating at an unprecedented pace.\n\nYet, this acceleration has strained the [target.GetIndividualName]'s stability, risking catastrophic synaptic overload. Alternatively, we could reallocate more [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] to coordination tasks.

entries.zh: 自从将新一批克隆体整合进蜂巢后，我们发现了一种令人不快的声音振动问题。克隆过程中的一个失误可能阻碍了它们的生物递质的发育，产生了频率干扰。\n\n这些克隆体与蜂巢整体进行交流时，附近的所有工蜂都会被一阵嘈杂而令人不安的精神耳鸣的影响。这分散了工蜂的注意力，也影响到了工作效率。
entries.en: Since integrating a new batch of clones into our hive, we have observed unpleasant audio-vibratory issues. A misstep in the cloning process may have stunted the development of their biological transmitters, causing frequency interference.\n\nWhen these clones commune with the wider hive, all nearby drones are subjected to loud and unsettling bouts of mental tinnitus. Distractions are high, and productivity is at risk.

entries.zh:
近期克隆实验取得了异常结果。部分克隆体似乎与基因供体之间存在神经连接，导致他们无意识地同步行动。

无论距离多远，这种现象始终存在，克隆体会与星系其他位置的供体完全同步。这一发现为我们带来了新的可能性。

我们可以启动一项计划，将克隆体与供体置于相同环境中协同工作；或者提取相关神经递质，以深入研究这一现象。
entries.en:
Recent Cloning experiments have yielded unusual results. Some clones appear to be neurologically linked to their genetic donors, causing them to unintentionally move in tandem.

The phenomenon persists no matter the distance, with individual drones mirroring the actions of their counterparts elsewhere in the galaxy. This presents some intriguing possibilities.

We could implement an initiative that brings clones and donors together to work in tandem in identical environments. Alternatively, we could extract the responsible neurotransmitters to better study the phenomenon.

entries.zh: 为供体与克隆体配置完全一致的工作环境。
entries.en: Set up identical workstations for donor and clone.

entries.zh: 通过外科手术切断同步神经链接。
为了巩固蜂巢，我们用供体材料培育了一批克隆体并人工加速了它们的成熟。虽然这些克隆体是优良的生物标本，但却不可兼容。\n\n这种反常虽然令人不安，但也提供了一个独特的机会。这些独特的工蜂拥有独立的身份和思想，在与集体之外的实体交互时可能会更加有利。它们自主思考的能力也可以弥合蜂巢统一意识难以跨过的鸿沟。然而这些好处是有代价的：他们日益增强的个体意识导致了不安，将会影响我们的一些高级认知功能。
entries.en: In an attempt to bolster the hive, we cultivated a batch of clones from donor material and artificially accelerated their maturity. Though fine biological specimens, these clones are incompatible.\n\nThis deviation, while troubling, presents a unique opportunity. These individuated drones, now possessing singular identities and independent thought, may prove advantageous in interfacing with entities outside the collective. Their ability to think autonomously could bridge gaps where the hive's unified voice struggles to adapt. Yet, these benefits come at a cost: their growing awareness of individuality has led to unrest, affecting some of our higher-level cognitive functions.

entries.zh:
我们的集体意识处于混乱之中。尽管拥有了自我复制的能力，但我们却对这种行为的有效性（甚至道德性）犹豫不决。

克隆工序需要大量资源。尤其在自然繁殖可能产生更多基因多样性的情况下，我们是否更应该将这些资源花费在更其他地方？

在历史上这不是我们的繁殖方式，我们不确定是否准备好接受这种对自己物种的根本改变。
entries.en:
Our collective consciousness is in turmoil. We now possess the ability to create copies of ourselves, yet we hesitate, questioning the efficacy (and even the morality) of such actions.

Cloning processes require significant resources. Might these be better spent elsewhere, particularly as natural procreation is likely to produce more genetic diversity?

Historically, this has not been our method of procreation, and we are uncertain if we are ready to embrace such a fundamental change to our species.

entries.zh: 克隆的高效性难以忽视。
entries.en: The efficiency of cloning cannot be ignored.

entries.zh:
我们的变异实验导致蜂巢内部出现异常。以往轻轻松松的任务现在都要三思后行，相互冲突的指令使集体精神紧张。

虽然由此产生的重负可能会烧毁我们最得力的工蜂，但它也提供了一个机会。

我们必须决定：应该放慢脚步修复，还是让自己超越极限？
entries.en:
Our mutational experiments have caused irregularities within the hive. Tasks that once unfolded with ease now demand deliberate effort, as conflicting directives strain the collective mind.

While the resulting fatigue threatens to burn out some of our most effective drones, it also presents an opportunity.

We must decide: will we pause to recover or push ourselves past our limits?

entries.zh: 生前何必贪睡，死后自会长眠。
entries.en: We can sleep when we're dead.

entries.zh: 我们做出的休整决定带来了好处。之前那些不和谐的冲动逐渐安定下来，凝聚成一股和谐的思想之流，再次清晰地推动着集体。\n\n曾经在精疲力竭的边缘摇摇欲坠的工蜂又开始不知疲倦地精确工作。这段时间的反思不仅减轻了集体疲劳，而且也增强了我们应对未来挑战的决心。
entries.en: Our decision to rest and recover has borne fruit. The once-discordant impulses have settled, coalescing into a harmonious flow of thought that propels the collective with renewed clarity.\n\nDrones that once teetered on the brink of burnout now work with tireless precision. This period of reflection has not only reduced our collective fatigue, but also fortified our resolve for the challenges ahead.

entries.zh: 变异带来很多好处，而我们的蜂巢能利用选择性增来进一步满足需求。可以通过硬化几丁质附肢实现对矿物产出的特化。\n\n或者我们可以让所有工蜂获得更多基因修饰，让他们拥有多种不同功能。
entries.en: Mutation offers many benefits, and through selective enhancements, we can adapt the hive to better serve its purpose. Specialization in mineral production can now be achieved by hardened, chitinous appendages.\n\nAlternatively, we could augment all drones with more generic modifications, enabling them to perform a multitude of functions.

entries.zh: 持续的实验给蜂巢带来了意想不到的复杂性。一些工蜂出现了独特的身体特征：像是带刺的外骨骼、过大的附肢，或者异常敏感的感官器官。\n\n虽然这些变化确实带来了一定的好处，但同时也增加了代谢负担。蜂巢面临着平衡这种不断加剧的压力的问题。关键在于，要进行多少变异才算合适呢？
entries.en: Ongoing experimentation has introduced unexpected complexities to the hive. Drones are emerging with unique physical characteristics: spiked exoskeletons, oversized appendages, or oddly sensitive sense organs.\n\nWhile these deviations provide definite benefits, they also introduce a metabolic burden. The hive struggles to balance this escalating strain. The question looms: how much mutation is enough?

entries.zh:
蜂巢正在改变。通过基因组的改造，我们观察到了显著的健康改善。然而，这也使我们在面对心理压力时变得更加脆弱。

我们并不讨厌从前的自己，尽管我们正在变得更强大、认知能力更先进，但我们仍然怀念过去那些熟悉的思维模式。

整个蜂巢都弥漫着一种深深的不适感，仿佛我们的身体与内在的心灵不再匹配。我们是否已经超越了自我的界限？
entries.en:
The hive is changing. By altering our genomes, we have observed measurable health improvements. However, this has made us less resilient to psychological distress.

We did not dislike who we were before, and even though we are becoming a stronger and more cognitively advanced, we miss the familiarity of our former thought patterns.

Throughout the hive there is a deeply uncomfortable feeling that our bodies do not match our intrinsic psyche. Have we outgrown ourselves?
We must not lose our essence.

entries.zh: 政府正采取坚决措施以遏制基因差异。
entries.en: The government is taking a firm stance to curb genetic disparity.

entries.zh: 基因工程师和经过基因强化的个体都是我们社会的宝贵成员。
entries.en: Geneticists and genetically augmented individuals are valuable members of our society.

entries.zh: 精英人才创造精英成果。
政府发起的社会福利计划正在实施中。
entries.en: Government sponsored social welfare initiatives are being implemented.

entries.zh: 经过强化的工人为我们的工业效率做出贡献。
entries.en: Augmented workers contribute to the efficiency of our industries.

entries.zh: 超能力个体增强了我们的防御力量。
我们正在寻找新的、诚实的领导者。
entries.en: We are searching for new, honest leaders.

entries.zh: 克隆器官摘取的行为已被列为非法。
entries.en: The practice of harvesting clone organs has been outlawed.

entries.zh: 持续利用克隆人使我们得以专注于提高工业效率。
entries.en: The continued exploitation of clones allows us to focus on industrial efficiency.

entries.zh: 我们的社会重视公民权利。至少理论上是这样。
entries.en: Our society values civil rights. In theory at least.

entries.zh: 通过主动执法，我们对犯罪采取更严厉的立场。
entries.en: With proactive policing, we are adopting a tougher stance on crime.

entries.zh: 将对非法克隆采取果断行动。
entries.en: Decisive action will be taken against unsanctioned cloning.

entries.zh: 新兵源源不断的涌入提升了我们的军事活动。
entries.en: Our military activity increases with an influx of new recruits.

entries.zh: 政府采取果断行动以对抗排斥行为。
entries.en: The government takes decisive action to combat exclusion.

entries.zh: 变种人聚居地为社会学研究提供了宝贵资料。
entries.en: Mutant enclaves provide valuable societal research.

entries.zh: 新的创造性表达机会和新颖性促进了多样化发展。
entries.en: New opportunities for creative expression and novelty encourage diversity.

entries.zh: 生物安全和执法技术将维持现行法规的实用性。
entries.en: Biosecurity and enforcement technologies will maintain the usefulness of current regulations.

entries.zh: 随着人口对独特生物改造的尝试，相关责任问题得到了解决。
entries.en: Liability concerns are addressed as the population experiments with unique bio modifications.

entries.zh: 通过标准化的基因模板，社会凝聚力得到提升。
entries.en: With standardized genetic templates, societal cohesion improves.

entries.zh: 关于团块的决定性行动让大家感觉更安全了。
entries.en: Decisive action regarding the blob makes everyone feel safer.

entries.zh: 科学家们在这个板块上进行封闭性生物实验。
entries.en: Scientists perform contained biological experiments on the blob.

entries.zh: 超级英雄军团帮助我们维持社会秩序。
entries.en: Superhero regiments help us maintain conformity.

entries.zh: 谁来监视监视者？我们来。
entries.en: Who will watch the watchers? We will.

entries.zh: 超级英雄顾问协助政府的决策过程。
entries.en: Superhero consultants aid our government's decision making processes.

entries.zh: 我们的政府将不再依赖超能力者的支持。
entries.en: Our government will no longer rely on support from super-powered beings.

entries.zh: 严格的准则限制了大规模克隆技术的使用。
entries.en: Strict guidelines limit the use of mass cloning technology.

entries.zh: 克隆人拥有平等权利。但原体拥有更平等的权利。
entries.en: Clones have equal rights. But originals have more equal rights.

entries.zh: 艺术追求将引领我们走向伟大。
entries.en: Artistic endeavors will lead us to greatness.

entries.zh: 我们将成为星系科学领域的领导者。
entries.en: We will become galactic leaders in the sciences.

entries.zh: 我们将优先发展商品和服务生产。
entries.en: We will prioritize the production of goods and services.

entries.zh: 在法律的铁腕之下，稳定性将得到提升。
entries.en: Stability will increase under the firm hand of the law.

entries.zh: 如果能让他们开心，就让他们演绎他们的革命幻想吧。
entries.en: Let them play out their revolutionary fantasies if it keeps them happy.

entries.zh: 先祖的知识将指引我们迈向未来。
entries.en: The knowledge of our ancestors will lead us to the future.

entries.zh: 我们祖先的所作所为不能在当今浮出水面。
entries.en: Our ancestral exploits cannot be allowed to surface in the present day.

entries.zh: 查获的研究资料将补充官方发展。
entries.en: Seized research will supplement official development.

entries.zh: 基因纯度的声明必须经过严格的基因组检查验证。
entries.en: Claims of genetic purity must be verified with rigorous genome inspections.

entries.zh: 我们将尊重克隆个体的自主权。
entries.en: We will respect the autonomy of cloned individuals.

entries.zh: 公民与其克隆体之间必须有明确的等级区分。
entries.en: There must be a clear hierarchical distinction between citizens and their clones.

entries.zh: 我们必须确保克隆生产过程中不会再发生任何事故。
entries.en: We must ensure there are no more incidents in the clone production process.

entries.zh: 生产力是我们的首要任务。
情绪问题应该是我们最不需要担心的。
entries.en: Emotional troubles should be the least of our concerns.

entries.zh: 努力工作和严明纪律将把所有人塑造成模范公民。
entries.en: Hard work and discipline will make model citizens of all.

entries.zh: 尽管需要付出额外代价，我们也要提升工业产出。
entries.en: We will increase the outputs of our industries, despite the additional costs.

entries.zh: 克隆的公民能加快我们的殖民地发展进程。
entries.en: Duplicated citizens can speed up our colony development process.

entries.zh: 我们将保留这些变异体作为实验对象，用于增进对变异的认知。
entries.en: We will keep these mutants as test subjects and use them to enhance our understanding of mutation.

entries.zh: 杰出个体应该被树立为榜样 —— 一个值得追求的理想！
entries.en: Extraordinary individuals should be held up as an example; an ideal to strive for!

entries.zh: 基因优势将引领我们走向荣耀。
entries.en: Genetic excellence will lead us to glory.

entries.zh: 这些非凡的能力不能仅限于少数人。必须与全体公民共享。
entries.en: These extraordinary abilities cannot be confined to a minority. They must be shared with all citizens.

entries.zh: 不管下面爬着什么东西……我们都不想要它。
entries.en: Whatever's crawling around down there... We don't like it.

entries.zh: 瘟疫是一种有效的工具，我们可以用它来清除羸弱者。
entries.en: A plague is an effective tool which we can wield to thin the herd.

entries.zh: 我们的政府将致力于解除基因改造的一切限制。
entries.en: Our government will work to dismantle restrictions on genome modding.

entries.zh: 我们将保持一定秩序，限制对政府认可的生物黑客技术的使用。
entries.en: We will retain some order and restrict access to government-sanctioned biohacking.

entries.zh: 理论科学不过是空谈。我们的领袖应该专注于分配的任务。
entries.en: Theoretical science is nothing but speculation. Our leaders should focus on their assigned tasks.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国容不下无所事事的工人。
entries.en: There is no place in our empire for frivolous workers.

entries.zh: 防御是我们的首要任务。力量与韧性是我们军队的基石。
entries.en: Our defense is a priority. Strength and resilience are the cornerstone of our armies.

entries.zh: 各个年龄段的工蜂都为我们的研究和技术发展做出贡献。
entries.en: Drones of all ages contribute to our research and technological development.

entries.zh: 随着团结度和集体士气的提升，我们积极优先考虑自身福祉。
entries.en: With increasing cohesion and collective morale, we actively prioritize our well-being.

entries.zh: 神经中继效率的提高使我们能在更短时间内达到更高的生产力。
entries.en: Heightened neural relay efficiency gives us shorter, more intense periods of productivity.

entries.zh: 随着强化过程的改进，我们必须抽出时间关注自身福祉。
entries.en: As augmentation processes are refined, we must take time to consider our well-being.

entries.zh: 随着效率的提升，生产力大幅增长。
entries.en: Productivity soars as we increase our efficiency.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维承受着神经干扰并不断适应。即便面对这些困扰，我们依然保持着运转效率。
entries.en: The hive endures and adapts to neural interference. We maintain operational efficiency despite the nuisance.

entries.zh: 我们正在充分利用当前的协调问题。
entries.en: We are making the best of our ongoing coordination issues.

entries.zh: 强制整合叛逆的工蜂将平息一切叛乱。
entries.en: Forced integration of rogue drones will quell any rebellion.

entries.zh: 我们专注于优化克隆技术，并关注其伦理和社会影响。
entries.en: We are focused on optimizing cloning technology and addressing ethical and social implications.

entries.zh: 我们正在集体商议物种的未来，采取谨慎而周密的应对方案。
entries.en: We collectively deliberate on the future of our species, taking a careful and calculated approach.

entries.zh: 我们将用一年的时间优先关注集体福祉。
entries.en: We will prioritize our collective wellness with a year of rest.

entries.zh: 没有时间休息。我们还有工作要做。
entries.en: There's no time to rest. We have work to do.

entries.zh: 我们已经休息过了，现在恢复了活力。
entries.en: We have rested, and we are renewed.

entries.zh: 生产效率正在提升，工蜂的多面性也达到了新高度。
entries.en: Productivity is improving and drone versatility is high.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维对此很满意，所有工蜂都按其能力各司其职。
entries.en: The hive is satisfied, and specialized based on abilities.

entries.zh: 成长意味着改变，改变促进成长。我们正以加速度汲取知识。
entries.en: To grow is to change, and to change is to grow. We are learning at an accelerated pace.

entries.zh: 在不断进化的过程中，我们不能迷失自我。我们依然强大且坚定。
entries.en: As we continue to evolve, we must not lose sight of ourselves. We are strong and committed.

entries.zh: 工蜂更加健康，蜂巢思维更加愉悦。
entries.en: Drones are healthier, and the hive is happier.

entries.zh: 重大变革已经撼动蜂巢。现在我们必须专注于安全的生物改造。
entries.en: Significant changes have upheaved the hive. Our focus must now be on safe biomodification.

entries.zh: 我们不能让恶性基因异常危及我们的突变抱负。
entries.en: We cannot allow malicious genetic anomalies to compromise our mutational aspirations.

entries.zh: 我们必须以开放态度拥抱新的进化方向。
entries.en: We must be open to embracing new evolutionary directions.

entries.zh: 我们专注于提升体能和适应性的特质，确保[GetGestaltEntityName]在恶劣环境中的生存能力。
entries.en: We focus on traits that enhance physical endurance and adaptability, ensuring the [GetGestaltEntityName]'s survival in hostile environments.

entries.zh: 我们优先提升心智能力和[GetIndividualName]协调性，促进决策能力和运转效率。
entries.en: We prioritize mental capacity and [GetIndividualName] coordination, fostering better decision-making and operational efficiency.

entries.zh: 优先培育处理型[GetIndividualNamePlural]和领导节点。
entries.en: Processing [GetIndividualNamePlural] and leadership nodes are prioritized.

entries.zh: 我们选择最有利于生育力和培育健康[GetIndividualNamePlural]的特质。
entries.en: We select those traits most beneficial to fertility and the production of healthy [GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们不能分散注意力。纯粹是我们的目标，必须舍弃其他一切。
entries.en: We cannot afford to divest our interests. Purity is our goal, and we must let go of everything else.

entries.zh: 在追求纯粹的过程中，[GetGestaltEntityName]的生产体系决不能受到损害。
entries.en: The [GetGestaltEntityName]'s means of production must not be compromised in our pursuit of purity.

entries.zh: 不容偶然性有任何机会。任何非预期情况都必须立即清除。
entries.en: Chance is not to be trifled with. Anything unintended must be immediately expunged.

entries.zh: 某些所谓的杂质可能实际上对[GetGestaltEntityName]有益。我们不应操之过急地清除它们。
entries.en: Some of these so called impurities may actually be beneficial to the [GetGestaltEntityName]. We should not be so quick to eradicate them.

entries.zh: 通过重新安置剩余公民，我们可以平衡克隆相关人口增长给蜂巢带来的潜在压力。
entries.en: We can balance potential strain on the hive from clone related population growth by relocating surplus citizens.

entries.zh: 蜂巢的能量生产将由多功能克隆型工蜂加强。
entries.en: The hive's energy production will be reinforced with versatile worker-clones.

entries.zh: 蜂巢在少数简单思维的抚慰特质中得到慰藉。
entries.en: The hive luxuriates in the soothing qualities of a few simple minds.

entries.zh: 旧批次让位，新批次到来。
entries.en: Out with the old batch, in with the new batch.

entries.zh: 即便会引发不和谐，我们仍在思考存在与目的的本质。
entries.en: We ponder the nature of existence and purpose even if it causes dissonance.

entries.zh: 形而上学问题是独立意识的干扰；我们的意义不在于思考存在，而在于作为整体而活。
entries.en: Metaphysical questions are distractions of the solitary mind; we find purpose not in pondering existence, but in living as one.

entries.zh: 我们已经思考得太久。我们必须致力于物种的转变，不论可能有何潜在缺陷。
entries.en: We have deliberated for too long. We must commit to the transformation of our species, regardless of any potential drawbacks.

entries.zh: 我们的突变实验无需改变我们彼此连接的方式。
entries.en: Our mutational experimentation need not alter the way in which we are connected.

entries.zh: 蜂巢之中没有鲁莽暴戾的容身之处。
entries.en: Reckless aggression has no place within the hive.

entries.zh: 我们拥抱未来无形的混沌。
entries.en: We embrace the unwritten chaos of the future.

entries.zh: 我们选择首先接纳意识的动荡本质，共同迈向更为平衡的整体观。
entries.en: We choose to first accept the tumultuous nature of our consciousness, and move together to a more balanced general outlook.

entries.zh: 我们必须投入时间和资源来提升我们的气候适应能力。
entries.en: We must dedicate time and resources to uplift our climatological resilience.

entries.zh: 体能力量是进化的巅峰。
entries.en: Physical strength is the pinnacle of evolution.

entries.zh: 维系我们的是深度思考的能力。
entries.en: It is our ability to think deeply that sustains us.

entries.zh: 我们可以同时保持大胆与谨慎。
entries.en: We can be bold and cautious simultaneously.

entries.zh: 为了控制瘟疫的爆发，我们将处决受感染者。
entries.en: To contain an outbreak of plague, we will terminate the afflicted.

entries.zh: 对感染[GetIndividualNamePlural]的谨慎研究将引领我们找到瘟疫的解药。
entries.en: Careful study of diseased [GetIndividualNamePlural] will lead us to a plague cure.

entries.zh: 我们可能未能复查我们的计算。
entries.en: It is possible we failed to double check our calculations.

entries.zh: 如果你什么都没做错，你就没有什么担忧的必要。
entries.en: If you have done nothing wrong, you have nothing to fear.

entries.zh: 我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。\n\n我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？
entries.en: Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.\n\nWill we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and continue in our current, unrefined form?
Embrace purity and advance to new heights!

entries.zh: 我们无需改变自我管理的方式。
entries.en: We need not change the ways we govern ourselves.

entries.zh: 我们的物种已经到达关键时刻。必须做出决定。\n\n我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？
entries.en: Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.\n\nShall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journey so far and persist in our needless differentiation?

entries.zh: 我们将克隆作为未来的重要组成部分。
entries.en: We embrace cloning as a vital part of our future.

entries.zh: 我们正处在关键生物前沿的风口浪尖。一个重要的抉择在等待着我们。\n\n我们可以通过驾驭高级生物突变的力量来拥抱我们的命运，通过对我们基因密码的刻意进化来不可逆转地改变我们的文明。或者我们可以保留从过去探索中获得的教训，继续保持我们当前平凡的形态。
entries.en: We are on the cusp of a pivotal biological frontier. An important choice awaits.\n\nWe can either embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of advanced biological mutation, irrevocably transforming our civilization through the deliberate evolution of our genetic code. Or we can preserve the lessons gained from our past exploits and continue in our current, mundane form.

entries.zh: 我们可以成为任何和一切。
entries.en: We can be anything and everything.

entries.zh:
随着我们专注于净化我们的基因，我们正在认识到所有使我们文明伟大的事物。

当我们变得比以往任何时候都更加纯净，我们对我们优越的传承感到前所未有的自豪。

来自各个领域的专家；艺术界、科学界和商界，都在为我们的集体努力欢呼，并希望引领我们走向荣耀。
entries.en:
Complimenting the concentrated focus on purifying our genetics, we are realizing all the things that make our civilization great.

As we become purer than ever, we have never been more proud of our superior heritage.

Experts from all fields; the arts, science, and business, are all cheering on our collective efforts, and hoping to lead the way to our glory.

entries.zh: 我们将通过资助艺术来庆祝这一里程碑！
entries.en: We will celebrate this milestone by funding the arts!

entries.zh: 科学研究必须永远放在首位。
entries.en: Scientific research must always come first.
Consumption is the core of the economy.

entries.zh:
抗议者的呼喊在我们的城市中回荡。帝国内部的一个叛逆派系已经擅自拒绝我们的事业，背离我们通向纯净的道路。

这些麻烦制造者宣扬所谓基因多样性和文化融合的需求。

如果他们的激进行为得不到处理，我们通向纯净的进程可能会受阻。
entries.en:
Chants from protesters echo through our cities. A rebellious faction within our empire has taken it upon themselves to reject our cause, and turn away from our path to purity.

These troublemakers preach the supposed need for genetic diversity, and cultural integration.

If their activism continues unaddressed, there is a risk that our progress toward purity could falter.

entries.zh: 用空洞的承诺安抚他们。

考古学家在我们祖先母星上发现了一个古代文明的证据。

一个长期掩埋的地下库被发掘出来，其中有令人震惊的远古基因实验证据。

如果这个消息公之于众，可能会削弱我们现代对基因纯净的主张。
entries.en:
Archaeologists have discovered proof of an ancient civilization from our ancestral homeworld.

A long buried vault has been uncovered, and within there is startling evidence of past genetic experimentation.

If this news became public knowledge, it could dilute our modern claims to genetic purity.

entries.zh: 将这项研究与我们的研究整合。在过去的基础上发展。
entries.en: Integrate this research with our own. Build upon the past.

entries.zh: 销毁证据。决不能让任何人知道。
entries.en: Destroy the evidence. Nobody must know.

entries.zh: 一位名为[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]的叛逆基因学家被发现进行未经批准的生物实验。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer]无视任何安全准则，目标是创造一个体现我们所追求的纯净理想的优等种族。然而，[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe]却创造出了一个畸形怪物。\n\n现在，一个短命的亚种正在我们的监管下逐渐消亡，它们虽然与我们的基因特征有一些相似之处，但大多是疾病缠身的恐怖存在。尽管对它们基因构成的研究富有成效，但预后是致命的。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]对此毫无悔意。
entries.en: A rogue geneticist by the name of [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] has been found conducting unsanctioned biological experiments. Bypassing any safety guidelines, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer] goal was to create a race of superior beings who would embody the ideals of purity that we strive for. Instead, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe] birthed an abomination.\n\n A subspecies of short lived creatures, who share some aspects of our genetic profile, but are mostly disease-ridden horrors, are now withering away in our custody. Though study of their genetic makeup has proven fruitful, prognosis is terminal. [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] is unrepentant.

entries.zh: 革除这个叛逆者的职务！
entries.en: Remove this rogue from their post!

entries.zh: 这正是我们需要的创新精神！
entries.en: This is just the kind of initiative we need!

entries.zh: 为了加快我们通向纯净的道路并识别基因组异常者，我们推行了定期基因检测，拥有'高质量'DNA已成为一种炫耀资本。\n\n据称某些帝国官员一直在谎报他们的生物特征，伪造检测结果以表明他们拥有比实际更理想的特质。如果这件事曝光，这种对真相的隐瞒必将激起公众的愤怒。
entries.en: Having rolled out regular genetic testing to streamline our path toward purity, and identify genomic outliers, 'high quality' DNA has become something to boast about.\n\nCertain empire officials have supposedly been lying about their biological makeup, forging test results that suggest they have more desirable traits than they do in reality. If it comes to light, this concealment of truth threatens to outrage the public.

entries.zh: 我们需要更准确可靠的检测。
entries.en: We need more accurate and reliable testing.

entries.zh: 也许这位官员只是犯了个错误...
entries.en: Perhaps this official made a mistake...

entries.zh: 克隆人就在我们之中。他们生活在我们的城市里，在我们的工厂里工作。有些甚至身居要职，参与制定影响我们生活的政策。\n\n随着克隆个体融入我们的社会，许多问题仍未得到解答。他们应该享有什么权利？他们是否与非克隆人平等，还是应该作为下属被管控？
entries.en: Clones walk among us. They live in our cities, they work in our factories. Some of them are even in positions of power, shaping the very policies that govern our lives.\n\nWith the integration of cloned individuals into our society, there remain many unanswered questions. What are their rights? Are they equal to non-clones, or should they be kept in line as subordinates?

entries.zh: 所有克隆人都享有完整公民权！
他们充其量只是二等公民。
entries.en: They are second-class citizens at best.

entries.zh:
我们最具生产力的克隆设施之一因一起事故而突然停产，造成重大损失。

由于我们的许多操作都为了效率而自动化，在关键时刻没有人能够及时介入处理这次事故。

一个刚下生产线的克隆人滑倒，卷入机械装置中被碾碎，导致生产线堵塞，不得不完全停产。
entries.en:
Clone production at one of our most productive facilities has been halted suddenly due to an incident which caused significant damage.

As many of our operations are automated for efficiency, there was nobody to intervene at a key moment which led to the disturbance.

Fresh off the conveyor belt, one of the clones slipped and found themself caught in the mechanisms, grinding them up, causing a pile up, and necessitating a full stop on production.
Resume production as quickly as possible!

entries.zh: 我们帝国各地的克隆人都在报告他们正在经历困扰，在寻找自我认同感方面苦苦挣扎。\n\n他们渴望拥有超越其基因捐献者的身份认同。他们质疑自己存在的意义，对生活目标和抱负感到茫然。
entries.en: Clones across our empire are reporting struggles, grappling with their sense of self.\n\nThey long for an identity beyond that of their genetic donors. They question their very purpose, feeling listless regarding their life goals and aspirations.

entries.zh: 这很常见。去做心理治疗吧。
他们应该在工作中寻找成就感。
entries.en: They should seek fulfillment in their work.

entries.zh: 帝国主体物种的每个§Y£leader£领袖§!获得§G+200§!经验值。
entries.en: Every §Y£leader£ Leader§! of the Empire's main Species gains §G+200§! Experience.

entries.zh: 随着更多克隆人融入我们的人口，维持他们生存所需的额外资源开始给经济带来压力。\n\n虽然眼前的挑战重重，但更大的劳动力和消费群体带来的经济活力可能会为长期繁荣奠定基础——前提是我们能有效管理这个过渡期。
entries.en: As more clones are integrated into our population, the additional resources required to sustain them are beginning to strain the economy.\n\nWhile the immediate challenges are significant, the economic dynamism brought about by a larger workforce and consumer base could lay the foundation for long-term prosperity - provided we can manage the transition effectively.

entries.zh: 我们的基础设施必须跟上需求的增长。
entries.en: Our infrastructure must grow to meet demand.

entries.zh: 让他们在外星殖民地享受生活吧。
entries.en: They can enjoy life on the offworld colonies.

entries.zh: 自发的肢体生长。物质形态的波动。突发性的形态转变。这些报告虽然零星，但不容忽视。\n\n我们的变异实验在整个文明中产生了一些不太理想的结果。也许解锁随意修改基因的工具比我们最初预想的要复杂得多。
entries.en: Spontaneous limb growth. Fluctuations between states of matter. Sudden onset metamorphosis. These reports are few and far between, but they cannot be ignored.\n\nOur experiments with mutation are garnering some less than desirable results across our civilization. Perhaps unlocking the tools to modify one's genes at will was more than we initially bargained for.

entries.zh: 不寻常的变异可以促进我们的研究。
entries.en: Unusual mutations can boost our research.

entries.zh: §Y唯心主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
entries.en: §YSpiritualist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

entries.zh: 每位§Y威权主义£leader£领袖§!获得§Y$leader_trait_eager$§!特质。
由于自行进行变异实验，我们的一小部分人口发展出了非凡的能力和身体强化。\n\n作为独特的强者和天赋者，他们正在形成一个群体，并引起了公众的广泛关注。
entries.en: A small percentage of our population has developed extraordinary abilities and physical enhancements due to their own experiments with mutation.\n\nAs uniquely strong and gifted people, they are forming a community and garnering a lot of attention from the public.

entries.zh: 他们的成功可能激励他人。
听起来他们会是优秀的士兵。
entries.en: It sounds like they'd make good soldiers.

entries.zh: §Y军国主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§G+50§!
entries.en: §YMilitarist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §G+50§!

entries.zh: 找出他们是如何做到的并复制这一过程。
entries.en: Find out how they did this and replicate it.

entries.zh: 监控确认了一群基因改造者居住在城市下水道系统的存在——这令人不安地印证了长期被忽视的都市传说。\n\n这一发现加剧了社会紧张，随着对未知的恐惧升级，外表明显变异的公民报告遭受更多歧视。然而，这些个体展现出了非凡的创造力，以意想不到的方式利用下水道气体进行资源生产并改造他们的环境。
entries.en: Surveillance has confirmed the existence of a population of genetically altered individuals inhabiting urban sewer systems - an unsettling echo of long-dismissed urban legends.\n\nThis discovery has heightened social tensions, with visibly mutated citizens reporting increased discrimination as fears of the unknown escalate. Nevertheless, these individuals have demonstrated remarkable ingenuity, harnessing sewer gases for resource production and adapting their environment in unexpected ways.

entries.zh: 这些变异者可能发现了什么...
entries.en: These mutants may be on to something...

entries.zh: 一种新疾病正在我们的帝国蔓延。这种疾病导致一系列令人不适的症状，包括但不限于：不自主的气体和液体排出、极度疲劳，某些情况下甚至会致命。\n\n最奇特的是，这种疾病只影响那些通过基因变异改变了生理特征的人。对他们改造后基因组的持续研究带来了一些令人惊讶的发现。
entries.en: An outbreak of a new disease is spreading across our empire. The illness causes a host of unpleasant symptoms, including but not limited to: involuntary expulsions of air and liquid, debilitating fatigue, and in some cases loss of life.\n\nMost curiously, this disease is only affecting those who have altered their physiology in certain ways with genetic mutations. Ongoing study of their modified genome has led to some surprising insights.

entries.zh: §Y唯物主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
entries.en: §YMaterialist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

entries.zh: 我们的基因组研究设施为整个文明提供了前所未有的生理改造能力。\n\n然而，帝国的公民们想要更多。他们呼吁打破中央化的资源控制，允许所谓的\"生物黑客\"自由且不受限制地使用基因技术。
entries.en: Our Genomic Research Facilities have granted our entire civilization access to physiological alteration unlike anything we have ever experienced.\n\nHowever, the citizens of our empire want more. There are calls for breaking up centralized resources, and allowing so-called "biohackers" free and unrestricted access to gene technology.

entries.zh: 给予生物黑客更多自主权。
普通公民已经拥有太多自由了。
entries.en: The average citizen already has too much freedom.

entries.zh: §Y平等主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§G+50§!
entries.en: §YEgalitarian§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §G+50§!

entries.zh: 一位名为[event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientist]刚刚发表了一篇学术研究，这项研究可能大大加快并提高我们基因实验的效率和效果。\n\n这种新方法目前仅限于理论，尚未经过测试，因此要安全地应用到我们的工作中还需要仔细考虑其方法论。
entries.en: A [Owner.GetScientist] by the name of [event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName] has just published a piece of academic research that could be used to dramatically accelerate and improve the efficiency and efficacy of our genetic experimentations.\n\nPurely theoretical, the new method has not been tested, so the methodology will require some careful consideration in order to be applied safely to our processes.

entries.zh: 轻率的想法——和个人——都不会被容忍。
entries.en: Frivolous ideas - and individuals - will not be tolerated.

entries.zh: 由于我们持续的基因改造实验，我们的物种已被一段失控的基因代码侵入。我们正以惊人的速度变得虚弱，这段外来序列与我们自身基因物质的不受控制的相互作用正在破坏我们的稳定性。\n\n我们必须在为时已晚之前解决这种异常的生物行为。
entries.en: Our species has been infiltrated by a piece of rogue genetic code, a consequence of our persistent experimentation in genetic modification. We are becoming unwell at an alarming rate, destabilized by the unregulated interaction of this foreign sequence with our own genetic material.\n\nWe must address this anomalous biological behavior before it is too late.

entries.zh: 如果我们的文明要达到纯净，我们必须首先考虑[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的福祉。基因改造过程必须确保每一个适应性改变都能增强集体的韧性。\n\n走错方向——引入导致不稳定或破坏凝聚力的改变——可能会是灾难性的，威胁到我们统一的根基。
entries.en: If our civilization is to become pure, we must first consider the wellbeing of the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]. The genetic modification process must ensure that every adaptation enhances the collective's resilience.\n\nStarting off on the wrong path - introducing changes that cause instability or undermine cohesion - could be disastrous, threatening the very foundation of our unity.

entries.zh: 为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。\n\n只有通过仔细选择值得延续我们血统的工蜂，我们才能超越自然进化。
entries.en: In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our species, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.\n\nOnly by carefully selecting the drones worthy of carrying on our lineage, can we transcend beyond natural evolution.

entries.zh: 为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。\n\n只有通过仔细选择拥有符合我们集体利益的特质的共生体，我们才能超越自然进化。
entries.en: In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our symbiotic multitude, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.\n\nOnly by carefully selecting viable symbionts with traits of interest to the collective can we transcend beyond our initial boundaries.

entries.zh: 基因修饰的回报将确保我们的传承，但每个[target.GetIndividualName]的角色、每分努力都必须与我们的纯净愿景保持一致。\n\n我们现在面临一个重大抉择：是否要不惜牺牲适应能力来追求极致完美？还是应该采取更全面的策略，优先建设能够持续支撑这些努力的基础设施？
entries.en: The rewards of genetic modification will secure our legacy, but every [target.GetIndividualName]'s role, every ounce of effort, must be aligned with our vision of purity.\n\nWe now face a critical decision: should we optimize for perfection at the cost of adaptability? Or should we embrace a broader strategy, prioritizing the infrastructure required to sustain these efforts?

entries.zh: 追求纯净必须是我们唯一的焦点。
entries.en: Becoming pure must be our only focus.

entries.zh: 我们必须花时间发展基础。
entries.en: We must take time to develop our infrastructure.

entries.zh: 我们在[target.GetGestaltEntityName]内部发现了一些基因杂质和异常。\n\n在我们追求更大目标的过程中，必须消除这些缺陷特征，从自然进化手中夺回对我们身体发展的控制权。
entries.en: We have isolated a number of genetic impurities and anomalies within the [target.GetGestaltEntityName].\n\nAs we strive towards our larger goals, we must eliminate these defective traits and take back control of our physical development from natural evolution.
Cull the weak to strengthen the whole.

entries.zh: 重新改造有缺陷的个体。
§Y仁善倾向的§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
entries.en: §YBenevolence-inclined§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

entries.zh: 我们的克隆设施运转效率远超最初预期，导致现在出现了克隆体过剩的情况。\n\n整合如此多的工蜂将是一个挑战。
entries.en: Our cloning facilities are operating more efficiently than we initially expected, so we now have a clone surplus.\n\nIntegrating this many drones is proving challenging.

entries.zh: 蜂巢的新成员应该被迁移。
entries.en: New additions to the hive should be migrated.

entries.zh: 我们的一处主要克隆中心发生故障影响到了一些工蜂。克隆过程不知为何遭受到基因污染，导致长出了一批没有思考能力的克隆体。\n\n它们本质上就是活着的物体，完全没有知觉，没有更高的认知功能。在完全找出原因、修正了这个生产问题之前，克隆设施的产出率暂时下降了。
entries.en: Several drones have been affected following a malfunction at one of our primary Cloning centers. Genetic contaminants somehow entered the duplication process, leading to a batch of clones being grown without the capacity for thought.\n\nThey were essentially biological objects, completely non-sentient with no higher cognitive functions. Until the matter has been fully addressed, and the production problems mended, productivity at the facility is reduced.

entries.zh:
我们的意识内部浮现出了一个疑问：会不会有一天克隆体把我们都取代掉了？

我们在基因复制方面的初步努力进展顺利，使我们不禁好奇起这种高效的繁殖方法是否最终会取代我们的自然繁殖。

如果是这样，那么可能有一天蜂巢里再也没有原生子个体，只有克隆的克隆的克隆……这对我们这个物种究竟意味着什么呢？这个问题没有人知道答案，也让异常见蠢蠢欲动，但我们不得不问。
entries.en:
From within the consciousness, a question emerges: will clones one day replace us all?

Our initial efforts into genetic duplication are going well, so much so that we are curious if this efficient method of reproduction could eventually overtake our natural practice.

If so, then one day the hive may no longer contain any original donors, only clones of clones of clones... What does this mean for us as a species? A question without an answer, and one which breeds dissent. But we are compelled to ask.

entries.zh: 这个问题本身是有价值的。
这种问题只会让我们分心。
我们有了一项发现。通过操控特定基因，我们可以扩展意识的触及范围，使我们的感知能力超越物种原有的极限。\n\n要在整个蜂巢范围内实施这些基因突变需要消耗大量能量，但这样做可能会加深我们对宇宙的理解，以及我们在其中所处位置的认知。
entries.en: We have made a discovery. By manipulating specific genes, we can expand the reach of our consciousness to give us heightened senses beyond what we once thought of as the limits of our species.\n\nImplementing these mutations hive-wide will require a great deal of energy, but doing so may deepen our understanding of the universe as well as our place within it.

entries.zh: 这点代价微不足道。继续执行。

entries.en: The process must not be rushed.

entries.zh: 蜂巢的多个区域正在经历无法控制的愤怒浪潮，这股情绪波动在共享意识中激起涟漪，放大了我们集体的痛苦与挫折。\n\n最近引入的突变似乎过度刺激了工蜂攻击控制中枢的神经细胞，打破了蜂巢的情绪平衡。冲突事件愈发频繁，一些子个体甚至抛弃了原有任务，开始攻击其他同类。
entries.en: Whole sections of the hive are experiencing surges of uncontrolled anger, a surge of emotion that has sent ripples through the shared consciousness, amplifying our collective pain and frustration.\n\nA recently introduced mutation appears to be overstimulating neurocytes in our drones' aggression-control centers, disrupting the hive's emotional balance. Conflicts are erupting more frequently, with some drones abandoning their tasks and attacking others.

entries.zh: 我们将齐心协力，保持清醒。
entries.en: As one, we will be mindful.

entries.zh:
虽然某些突变确实让我们更强大和强化了我们，但我们发现其他突变却带来了不愉快的副作用。

虽然旨在延长寿命的强化已经成功实施，但这些相同的突变却降低了我们对极端气候的耐受性。

那些经历了这些生物强化的个体在调节体内温度系统时遇到了困难，这种不适感传遍了整个蜂巢。
entries.en:
While some mutations galvanize and enhance us, we are finding that others come with unpleasant side effects.

Enhancements aimed to increase our longevity are being implemented successfully, however these same mutations are lowering our tolerance for extreme climates.

Those of us who have undergone these biological augmentations are having difficulty regulating our internal thermoregulatory systems, and the discomfort is felt throughout the entire hive.

entries.zh: 我们必须升级气候防护系统。
entries.en: We must upgrade our weather protection systems.

entries.zh: 随着我们的改变，我们对环境的偏好也在改变。
entries.en: As we change, so do our environmental preferences.

entries.zh: 我们的工蜂必须忍受突变带来的不适。
entries.en: Our drones must struggle through the discomfort brought about by mutation.

entries.zh: 我们发现了两种突变。一种变异能够增强基层子个体的力量，大幅提高劳动效率。另一种则能提升复杂型工蜂的智力，增强解决问题和战略思维的能力。\n\n蜂巢必须决定选择哪条进化道路。
entries.en: A pair of mutations has been identified. One variant enhances menial drones' strength, greatly improving labor efficiency. The other sharpens complex drones' intellect, boosting problem-solving and strategy.\n\nThe hive must decide which path to embrace.

entries.zh:
我们差点没控制住基因瘟疫的突然爆发。

我们对自己的生物学操控引发了基因突变，导致许多[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的身体受到损害。

受影响的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已被隔离，现在必须决定如何继续前进。
entries.en:
We have barely contained the sudden outbreak of a genetic plague.

Manipulating our own biology has triggered rogue mutations in our DNA, leading to many [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] becoming physically compromised.

Affected [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] have been quarantined, and we must now decide how to move forward.

entries.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量工蜂的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
entries.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to the degradation of genetic integrity in a substantial amount of our drones. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having reviewed the biological calculations involved in uplifting our species, and amended some potentially problematic procedures, we are ready to continue our efforts.

It is not yet certain however if we have actually rectified the error, or worse, introduced more blunders.

entries.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量共生体的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
entries.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to a degradation of genetic integrity in a significant number of our symbionts. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having reviewed the calculations involved in adapting our constituent parts, and having amended some imbalanced enzyme slurries, we are ready to continue our efforts.

It is not yet certain, however, if we have actually rectified the error - or worse, introduced more blunders.

entries.zh: 我们可以从后果中吸取教训。
entries.en: We can learn from whatever happens next.
