entries.zh: 该领袖的工作被不可动摇的基因纯净观所引导，对所有类型的不完美都好不容忍。
entries.en: This leader's work is guided by an unshakable vision of genetic perfection, and an intolerance for imperfection in all its forms.

entries.zh: 身体自决是一种权利。国家授权个体按照自己喜欢的方式改造身体。身体就是终极画布，唯一的限制只有想象力。
entries.en: Bodily self-determination is a right. The state empowers individuals to modify their vessels as they see fit. Limited only by their imagination, the body becomes the ultimate canvas.

entries.zh: 绝对的权力必须托付给遗传上注定的精英，他们是这个文明命运最纯洁、最有能力的公仆。在他们之下，每位公民从事着都根据自身的基因潜质量身定制的职位。只有每个人的命中注定的人生意义可以带来满足，而不是野心。
entries.en: Absolute power must be entrusted to the genetically ordained elite, the purest and most capable stewards of this civilization's destiny. Beneath them, each citizen fulfills a predefined role, meticulously tailored to their inherited genetic potential. Contentment flows not from ambition, but from accepting one's designated purpose.

entries.zh: 该政府将基因和生物特征数据作为先发制人的司法工具，通过仔细检查每位公民的基因密码以寻找犯罪倾向。通过在违规行为发生之前进行干预，这种细致的监督可以确保秩序。真正的正义不是守株待兔，而是未雨绸缪，只有从根源上消除犯罪才能保护社会。
entries.en: This government wields genetic and biometric data as tools of pre-emptive justice, scrutinizing every citizen's genetic code for criminal predispositions. By intervening before transgression, it ensures order through meticulous oversight. True justice is not reactive but preventive, safeguarding society by eliminating crime at the root.

entries.zh: 作为基因卓越的捍卫者，这一政体在孜孜不倦追求生命完美的同时，也延长了其领袖的寿命。社会的昌盛源于最优秀基因的保存与繁衍，开创至高无上的未来。对基因库的严苛管理确保了进步的步伐，以长生与完美为最终馈赠。
entries.en: Championing genetic excellence, this government extends its leaders' lifespans while relentlessly pursuing biotic perfection. Society's prosperity hinges on the survival and propagation of only the finest genes, ensuring a future defined by superiority. The unyielding curation of the genetic pool guarantees progress, with longevity and perfection as its ultimate rewards.

entries.zh: 这家寰宇企业将生命商品化推向极致，以营利为目的培育器官。高端器官能在市场上卖出天价，而\"冗余资产\"则往往流入黑市。神秘的中间人和地下手术师如鱼得水，他们为急切的买家提供服务，确保每一份资产都物尽其用。
entries.en: This megacorp has perfected the commodification of life itself, cultivating organs for profit. Premium-quality organs command top prices, while "redundant" assets may find their way onto the black market. Shadowy intermediaries and black-market surgeons thrive, catering to desperate buyers and ensuring no asset is ever truly wasted.

entries.zh: 这个政体将克隆技术视为平等与进步的见证。克隆人与自然出生者并肩而立，他们的声音同样受到重视。全民意志因每一个观点的多样性而更加丰富，无论是否为克隆体。
entries.en: This government embraces cloning technology as a testament to equality and progress. Clones stand shoulder to shoulder with natural-born individuals, their voices equally valued. The will of the people is enriched by the diversity of every perspective, clone or not.

entries.zh: 这个社会通过将权力锚定在优质克隆体的不朽血脉中，确保其精英阶层的永恒统治。克隆技术不仅保存了他们的基因传承，更使其臻于完美，实现了领导层的无缝延续。每个重要职位都由同一尊贵血脉的改良版本所占据，巩固了他们跨越世代的统治地位。
entries.en: This society ensures the eternal reign of its elites by anchoring power within the unbroken lineage of superior clones. Cloning technology preserves and perfects their genetic legacy, enabling a seamless continuity of leadership. Every position of influence is occupied by an improved iteration of the same exalted line, entrenching their dominance across generations.

entries.zh: 通过严密的基因筛选确保绝对忠诚，只有那些天生具有坚定服从性的个体才会被选作克隆源。这创造了一个自我延续的社会，在这里叛乱不仅不可能发生，在生物学上更是完全无法实现，通过公民基因结构的设计本身来确保永恒的和谐。
entries.en: Absolute loyalty is ensured through meticulous genetic selection, with only those hardwired for unwavering obedience chosen as cloning stock. This creates a self-perpetuating society where rebellion is not only improbable but biologically impossible, securing unbroken harmony through the very fabric of its citizens' design.

entries.zh: 统治者无可置疑的神圣权威通过克隆得以永存，伟大君主的每一世都继承了前世的智慧与荣光。这种领导层的无缝延续确保了社会的永续进步，在他们的明君治世下维系着一个永恒的黄金时代。
entries.en: The unquestionable righteousness of the ruler is preserved through cloning, with each iteration of the grand sovereign inheriting the wisdom and triumphs of their past lives. This seamless continuity of leadership ensures the perpetual advancement of society, sustaining an eternal golden age under their enlightened reign.

entries.zh: 无与伦比的便利与舒适触手可及。为自己准备一个克隆体以备不时之需，或是为逝去的挚爱定制复制体。本寰宇企业承诺每次复制的精确度高达93%，将尖端科技与精确复制带来的慰藉完美结合。
entries.en: Unmatched convenience and comfort are now within reach. Acquire a clone of yourself for spare parts or commission a replica of a lost loved one. This megacorp guarantees a 93% accuracy rate in every duplication, blending cutting-edge technology with the promise of solace through precise replication.

entries.en: Priority clone access is granted to members of the Board and other selected key personnel as part of their compensation.

这个社会恪守一项信条：个体的形躯犹如圣殿，由己主宰，任凭设计与掌控。在自由不羁与坚定支持的框架下，公民们获得实现独特潜能的力量，得以随心塑造自身与未来。
entries.en: This society upholds the principle that each individual's body is their temple, fully under their own design and control. Within a framework of freedom and unwavering support, citizens are empowered to realize their unique potential, shaping themselves and their futures as they see fit.

entries.zh: 权力集中于一个基因突变优异的精英阶层，赋予他们无与伦比的权威。他们超脱于常规法律之外，运用自身能力守护并引导社会，采取一切必要手段以确保社会的存续与繁荣。
entries.en: Power is concentrated in an elite class endowed with superior genetic mutations, granting them unparalleled authority. Operating beyond the confines of ordinary law, they wield their abilities to protect and guide society, taking whatever actions are deemed necessary to ensure its survival and prosperity.

entries.zh: 这个社会将基因突变奉为进步的基石。那些安于自然形态的个体将面临即刻拘禁或处决，确保唯有基因优异者才能为物种迈向完美的不懈追求贡献力量。
entries.en: This society mandates genetic mutation as the cornerstone of its advancement. Those who are content to remain as nature made them face immediate internment or termination, ensuring that only the genetically superior contribute to the species' relentless drive toward perfection.

entries.zh: 这个帝国拥抱随机突变的不可预测之力，挖掘无尽潜能，培育传统方法永远无法企及的创新与能力。在争夺霸权的竞逐中，突变的混沌成为他们最大的优势，推动他们迈向无可匹敌的至高统治。
entries.en: Embracing the unpredictable power of random mutation, this empire taps into untold potential, fostering innovations and abilities that traditional methods could never achieve. In the race for dominance, the chaos of mutation becomes their greatest advantage, propelling them toward unrivaled supremacy.

entries.zh: 在这种体制下，器官和身体部件的融资通过灵活的付款计划向所有人开放。一旦出现欠款，将立即被收回器官或没收约定的抵押物。这个体系确保了一个稳定的供需循环，每一个身体部件既是商品，也是契约。
entries.en: Under this authority, the financing of organs and body parts is made accessible to all through flexible payment plans. Missed payments result in swift repossession or the forfeiture of agreed-upon collateral. This system ensures a steady supply and demand cycle, where every body part is both a commodity and a commitment.

entries.zh: 尽管难以管理，该社会还是部分控制了可塑性基因组。人们将决定自身的突变如何显现。
entries.en: While difficult to manage, this society has gained partial control over their malleable genome. The people will decide how their mutations will manifest.

entries.zh: 在这个社会里，时间被征服了。通过精心挑选最原始的基因储备，统治精英们得以永生。然而，一个小小的失误就可能意味着失去永恒，对于那些在他们之下的人来说，雄心和进化是同一枚硬币的两面……
entries.en: In this society, time has been conquered. By meticulously selecting only the most pristine genetic stock, the ruling elites ascend to a timeless existence. Yet a single misstep can mean forfeiting eternity, and for those beneath them, ambition and evolution are two faces of the same coin...

entries.zh: 一个由持续进化塑造的文明，由一个巅峰意志统治着。任何议会或宪法都不能掩盖元首的最高意志。在这里，每一次基因上的胜利都会推动王位的飞升。
entries.en: A civilization forged by constant evolution, ruled by a supreme apex mind. No council nor constitution can overshadow the Principate's superior will. Here, every genetic victory fuels the throne's ascension.

entries.zh: 在$auth_bio_imperial_evopred$，逝者不得安息，而是被吞噬。每一代都将滋养下一代，逝去领袖的遗体将维系帝国的不朽统治。服务就是牺牲，而所有的臣民都将在死亡中继承祖先的遗产。
entries.en: In the $auth_bio_imperial_evopred$, the past does not rest - it is consumed. Each generation nourishes the next, as the remains of departed leaders sustain the undying rule of the empire. To serve is to sacrifice, and in death, all subjects feed the legacy of their forebears.

entries.zh: $auth_bio_evopred_tt$\n允许统治者在伟大领袖去世时将其吞噬。
entries.en: $auth_bio_evopred_tt$\nAllows the ruler to consume Great Leaders when they pass.

entries.zh: 国有生物掠食企业通过适应在基因和经济上茁壮成长。随着每一个新的基因组加入到公司的投资组合中，该巨型企业都会进一步完善市场地位，根据每个物种独特的生物学特性定制产品和谈判。毕竟，了解客户的本性能让成交几乎……成为本能。
entries.en: At BioPredation GLC, they thrive on adaptation - both genetic and economic. With every new genome added to the corporate portfolio, the MegaCorp refines its market position, tailoring products and negotiations to every species' unique biology. After all, understanding a customer's nature makes closing the deal almost... instinctual.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢思维倦于简单的自我传播。每个新的殖民地都在成为它的活体挂毯，点缀着不断变化的景观和肉体的融合。生物和星球成为一体，边界消融于奇美拉意识之中。
entries.en: This hive mind has tired of simple self-transformation. Each new colony can become part of its living tapestry, in an ever-shifting fusion of landscape and flesh. As borders dissolve in the Chimeral Consciousness, creatures and worlds become one.

entries.zh: $auth_bio_evopred_tt$\n自动将殖民地环境改造为§Y蜂巢星球§!\n净化外星人；外星§Y物种§!提升的['concept_adaptive_evolution']进展§G+100%§!

每个物种特质降低人口产生的$EMPIRE_SIZE$：§G-1%§!\n$auth_mutation_habitability_tt$
这个蜂巢通过坚持基因纯度来繁荣发展，确保每个工蜂都严格遵循理想的生物模板。精确的基因操控增强了整体团结，巩固了集群力量，创造出一支为效率和生存而磨砺的不可阻挡之力。
entries.en: This hive flourishes through unwavering genetic purity, ensuring every drone adheres to the ideal biological template. Precision genetic manipulation enhances unity and fortifies collective strength, creating an unstoppable force honed for efficiency and survival.

entries.zh: 在先进的克隆科技驱动着这群的基因高度一致的无情造物，它们每一个子个体都拥有完美的效率和一致性。遵循着天生的命令进行繁殖，这个蜂巢将遮蔽繁星。
entries.en: Advanced cloning technology drives the relentless production of genetically identical drones, each engineered for perfect efficiency and unity. Obeying the innate command to go forth and multiply, this hive intends to blot out the stars.

entries.zh: 这个蜂巢的超适应工蜂形成了一支不断动态进化的力量，利用不断的突变来克服环境和战术挑战。每一次适应都会加强集体，确保蜂巢思维在任何条件下都能以无与伦比的多功能性和适应力来茁壮成长。
entries.en: This Hive's hyper-adaptive drones form a dynamic and ever-evolving force, leveraging constant mutation to overcome environmental and tactical challenges. Each adaptation strengthens the collective, ensuring unparalleled versatility and resilience as the Hive mind thrives in any condition.

entries.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——§H$dsc_name$§!。
entries.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the §H$dsc_name$§!.

entries.zh:
我们并不是天生如此警觉。

[Capital.GetName]是一颗富饶的星球，我们也曾是和平富足的人民。但有一天，这个传送门改变了一切。

这群[GetInvadersLower]不请自来。他们在我们的城市和土地上肆虐，又突然跟他们的凭空出现一样消失得无影无踪。我们曾以为这只是偶然，然而这种入侵便一发不可收拾。它们一次又一次地来袭，变得越来越凶残。

现在，我们即将步入星系，$job_skywatcher_plural$们为此做好了准备。在我们母星的深空中，强大的$dsc_name$静静守望。这是一座坚不可摧的垣壁，抵御[GetInvadersLower]或其他想要摧毁我们的东西。
entries.en:
We were not always so vigilant.

[Capital.GetName] is a world of abundance, and once, we were a peaceful and contented people. But all that changed when the portal opened.

Without warning, the [GetInvadersLower] arrived. They razed our cities, ravaged our lands, and then, as swiftly as they had come, they vanished. We dared hope they would never return. But the invasions resumed, again and again, each attack more brutal than the last.

Now, as we prepare to venture into the galaxy, our $job_skywatcher_plural$ stand ready. High above our world, the formidable $dsc_name$ awaits, a steadfast bulwark against the [GetInvadersLower] and any others who seek our destruction.

entries.zh: 这座自动工业复合体使用自维持发电机，持续不断地产出生物机器。
entries.en: This automated industrial complex employed self-sustaining power generation to continuously produce biological machines.

entries.zh: 这座先进的后勤中心负责维系通向该星系中所有$dsc_name$的上行链路持续通畅。
entries.en: This advanced logistics center ensures a constant uplink to any $dsc_name$ in system.

entries.zh: 这些训练有素的卫士们负责确保$dsc_name$上行链路的持续通畅与安全。
entries.en: These highly trained guardians ensure a constant and secure uplink to the $dsc_name$.

They also improve the efficacy of §Y$dsc_name_plural$§!, §Y$starbases$§! and §Y$military_station_small_plural$§!.

entries.en: These specialized drones ensure a constant and secure uplink to the $dsc_name$.

They also increase the efficacy of §Y$dsc_name_plural$§!, §Y$starbases$§! and §Y$military_station_small_plural$§!.

entries.zh: 一支胆敢试探我们防御的生物舰船残骸。腐烂的恶臭可以传播数公里。
entries.en: The decaying remains of the last biological fleet to test our defenses. The stench of rot carries for kilometers.

entries.zh: 被无名的敌人毁坏得残破不堪的住宅和基础设施。
entries.en: The scarred and blasted remnants of our dwellings and infrastructure, destroyed by a nameless enemy.

entries.zh:
$job_skywatcher_plural$汇报事态有令人警觉的进展。

最近在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!的传送门中探测到了一种极其微弱但绝对不会搞错的波动。在过去，类似的扰动总会带来一大波敌意的生物舰船。

如果这些数据真实可信，我们知道我下一波攻击会在数月之内到达。人民的生死存亡再一次交由我们的守卫者们保护了。
entries.en:
Our $job_skywatcher_plural$ have reported an alarming development.

Subtle but unmistakable fluctuations were recently detected within the portal in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. In the past, similar disturbances have heralded waves of hostile biological vessels.

If these readings hold true, we can expect the next assault within a matter of months. The survival of our people may once again depend on the resolve of our defenders.

entries.zh: [GetInvadersLower]攻击了我们数十年。我们的$starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$是第一道防线，但只有解开这些敌人的谜团才能真正带来安全。\n\n每个发现都会带我们向着最终的目标推进，我们终将可以发起反抗，终结我们长久以来的围城。
entries.en: The [GetInvadersLower] have attacked us for decades. Our $starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$ stands as the first line of defense, but true safety will only be won by uncovering the truth about our enemies.\n\nWith each discovery, we move closer to the day when we can take our fight to them - and our long siege once and for all.

entries.zh: 我们摧毁的生物舰队残骸在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!不祥地飘荡着。虽然它们几乎成了扭曲的焦炭，但大部分有机物质仍然完好无损，为研究提供了难得的机会。\n\n通过仔细的分析，我们也许能够揭开它们奇特结构的秘密——也许还能对它们出现的神秘传送门有所了解。
entries.en: The debris left by the annihilated biological fleet drifts ominously through §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. Though twisted and charred, much of the organic material remains intact, offering a rare opportunity for study.\n\nWith careful analysis, we may be able to uncover the secrets of their grotesque construction - and perhaps glean some insight into the enigmatic portal from which they emerge.

entries.zh: [GetInvadersLower]舰队的残留物带来了一个罕有的研究击毁。我们可以从中学到许多有助于生存的知识。
entries.en: The remains of the [GetInvadersLower] fleet provide a rare opportunity for study. We may learn much to ensure our survival.

entries.zh:
在费劲地研究了§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!里留下的残骸后，我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]觉得他们应该找到了理解我们星系边缘耸立着的传送门的关键所在。

在这种生物的体内深处，发现了一种有机组织——它似乎与传送门的波动会发生共鸣。通过对该频率进行逆向工程，我们应该可以让自己穿越这个神秘的裂缝。

目前仍需要进一步研究，但我们反击的机会前所未有地触手可及了。
entries.en:
After painstaking study of the biological wreckage left in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] believe they may have the key to understanding the portal that looms at the edge of our system.

Deep within the creatures' tissue, an organic pattern has been identified - one that seems to resonate with the portal's fluctuations. By reverse-engineering this frequency, we should be able to traverse the enigmatic rift ourselves.

Further research will be necessary, but for the first time the possibility of taking the fight to the enemy is within reach.

entries.zh: 我们又离揭开传送门的奥秘近了一步。尽管还是无法穿越，但我们现在已经拥有了发展必要科技所需的洞见\n\n想要反抗这些敌人，我们需要§Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!。
entries.en: We are one step closer to unlocking the portal's mysteries. Though passage is not yet possible, we now have the insight needed to develop the necessary technology.\n\nTo bring our fight to the enemy, we require §Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!.

entries.zh:
多亏了我们近期在§Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!领域的突破，我们现在得以一瞥§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。

一支充满侵略性的生物舰队和一个戒备森严的恒星基地在另一头等着我们。建议谨慎行事。

我们找到了敌人的老巢。
entries.en:
Thanks to our recent breakthrough in §Y$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§! we have been offered a rare glimpse of the §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system.

An aggressive fleet of biological vessels and a heavily fortified starbase await us on the far side. Extreme caution is advised.

We have found the cradle of the enemy.

entries.zh: 我们发现了敌人的老巢，但是要揭开他们的秘密就要直面他们的防御。\n\n这会是一场恶仗，但在这之后我们最终将能探索§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。
entries.en: We have found the cradle of our enemy, but to unlock their secrets it will be necessary to confront their defenses.\n\nThe battle will not be easy, but in its aftermath we will at last be free to explore the §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh:
盘踞在§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的舰队被摧毁了。在结束前一刻，我们收到了一个来自星系恒星基地的微弱信号，我们目前只翻译出的一条是：

§H“—全部失联！这是他们自己生产的舰船！无论你是谁，请救救我们！”§!

随后，所有的通讯就终止了。如果这真的是一场胜利，我们敌人的集结地给了我们一个战略击毁。也许，可以有一座$starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$沐浴着§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的光，来确保不会再有这样的敌人来威胁我们的文明。
entries.en:
The fleet guarding §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed. Just before the end, we received a haunting transmission from the system's starbase, one which we have only now translated:

§H" - lost all control! The ships are reproducing by themselves! Please, whoever you are, save us!"§!

Since then, all communication has ceased. If this is indeed victory, our enemy's staging ground offers a strategic opportunity. A new $starbase_deep_space_citadel_1$ may one day shine in the light of §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!, ensuring that such a threat never imperils our civilization again.
At last, our siege is lifted.

entries.zh: 我们英勇的守卫者击败了[GetInvadersLower]；我们遭受到的长久围攻终于结束了。
entries.en: Our valiant defenders have defeated the [GetInvadersLower]; at last our long siege is over.

entries.zh: §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的[GetInvadersLower]被清除干净了，但这里的情况却出乎我们的意料。\n\n曾经在我们土地上肆虐的敌人现在只剩下一颗饱受摧残的星球。
entries.en: The [GetInvadersLower] have been purged from the §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system, but the situation here is very different from what we expected.\n\nAll that remains of our tormentors is an apparently decimated world.

entries.zh: [GetInvadersLower]的母星系；它们是谁？它们到底打我们什么主意？
entries.en: The home world of the [GetInvadersLower]; who were these people, and what did they want with us?

entries.zh:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§!是一片露天坟地。

这颗星球上的优势物种完全被一种奇怪的侵略性生命形式所侵占。进一步的调查显示，它们并不是天然的有机体而是某种生物机器，而且并非建造而是生长而来。

不知是否有可能是这些生物的设计者被自己的创物反噬了？我们的敌人难道完全不知道对他们的行动毫无自知之明，甚至不连我们的存在都不知道吗？

只有一件事可以肯定：无论他们采取了什么措施来控制这场瘟疫，这都导致了他们自己以及他们自动制造的可憎之物的毁灭。
entries.en:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§! is an open grave.

The planet's dominant species was completely overrun by a strange and aggressive form of life. Further investigation revealed that these were no natural organisms, but rather biological machines, seemingly grown rather than built.

Is it possible that whoever engineered these creatures was overwhelmed by their own creation? Could our enemy have been completely unaware of their actions against us, or even of our existence?

Only one thing is certain: whatever measures they took to contain this plague destroyed them, along with their automated abominations.

entries.zh: 所以我们并不是唯一的受害者……
entries.en: Then we were not the only victims...

entries.zh: 他们学习着……适应着……他们即将到来。
entries.en: They learn... They adapt... They are coming.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是我们坚定的守护者，肩负着巩固防御、监督军事准备以及确保文明在任何威胁面前屹立不倒的重任。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is our stalwart guardian, tasked with fortifying defenses, overseeing military readiness, and ensuring civilization stands unbroken against any threat.

entries.zh: 我们已学习。我们已适应。我们的防御永不陷落。
entries.en: We have learned. We have adapted. Our defenses will not fall.

entries.zh: 我们在观察生物飞船攻击的过程中发现了一个令人不安的趋势。每一波攻击都显示出更高的协调性、适应性战术以及对我们防御系统的系统性试探。敏感器日志揭示了能量特征的变化和攻击优先级的调整，这些都是策略演变的证据。\n\n这些生物，无论是通过本能还是集体智慧，正变得越来越强大。如果这种模式持续下去，下一波攻击将更加难以抵御。
entries.en: We have witnessed a troubling trend in the biological ship attacks. Each wave displays improved coordination, adaptive tactics, and a methodical probing of our defenses. Sensor logs reveal shifts in energy signatures and targeting priorities, evidence of evolving strategies.\n\nThese creatures, whether through instinct or collective intelligence, are becoming more formidable. If this pattern continues, the next wave will be even harder to repel.

entries.zh: 随着每一波次的到来，通过§Y$STARLIT_WORMHOLE_GALACTIC$§!抵达的舰队实力都不断增强。
entries.en: With each successive wave, fleets arriving through the §Y$STARLIT_WORMHOLE_GALACTIC$§! gain potency.

entries.zh:
传送门另一端的遥测数据揭示了§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的一个关键进展：生物舰船和他们的孵化场都被一支未知的力量摧毁了。

尽管知道[GetInvadersLower]被葬送之后都非常高兴，但我们无法忽视另一支力量也许有一天就会控制住[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系的风险。

我们必须加快脚步确保这一战略要地不会落入到另一个敌人的手中。
entries.en:
Incoming telemetry from the portal reveals a critical development in §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!: both the fleet of biological ships and their hatchery have been destroyed by an unknown force.

Even as we rejoice in knowing that the [GetInvadersLower] have met their end, we cannot ignore the risk that another power may one day seize control of the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.

We must move quickly to secure this strategic location before we face yet another siege.

entries.zh: [GetInvadersLower]被摧毁了。我们长久遭受的围攻结束了吗？
entries.en: The [GetInvadersLower] have been destroyed. Has our long siege at last been lifted?
The first of three stages of a ['concept_deep_space_citadel'].

entries.zh: 这座后勤资源仓库课用作未来建造$dsc_name$的基址。
entries.en: This logistical and resource hub serves as a base for the construction of a $dsc_name$.

entries.zh: §Y$deep_space_citadel_0$§!是设计用于最大化恒星重力井内防御能力的武装恒星基地。
entries.en: A §Y$deep_space_citadel_0$§! is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.

entries.zh: 这些发射器可以破坏极化能量的连续性，大幅度降低伤害潜力。
entries.en: These emitters break down the cohesion of polarized energy, greatly lowering damage potential.

entries.zh: 微型奇点场可以在在每一动能弹药到达预定目标之前使其分散。
entries.en: A field of microscopic singularities scatter kinetic ammunition before each volley arrives at its intended target.

entries.zh: 这种导弹对抗装置会产生数百万个假脉冲，导致弹头错误识别潜在目标。
entries.en: This missile countermeasure generates millions of false pings, causing warheads to misidentify potential targets.

entries.zh: 双向力场的投射会干扰生物神经系统和人工智能的信息处理能力，降低舰载机的作战效能。
entries.en: The projection of a bidirectional field overwhelms biological and AI cognition, lowering strike craft effectiveness.

entries.zh: 天线阵列人为增加了该防御站的探测截面，迫使敌人的武器瞄准它而不是附近的友军。
entries.en: Antennae arrays artificially increase the detection cross-section of this defensive station, forcing enemy weapons to target it instead of nearby friendlies.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$无法在恒星系的重力井外建造$STRUCTURE|Y$
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build $STRUCTURE|Y$ outside a system's gravity well

entries.zh: §G点击将该恒星基地翻新为新设计§!
entries.en: §GClick to retrofit this starbase to a new design§!

entries.zh: 该社会要求所有公民从出生之日起就注册进基因目录，并将用在所有层级的行政管理中。
entries.en: This society requires every citizen to be registered from birth in a genetic index used in every level of bureaucracy.

entries.zh: 每一位顾客和雇员的基因序列都记录在一个开放公众访问的付费数据库当中。执法部门高度依赖该服务，可以从最细微的蛛丝马迹中识别出不法分子。
entries.en: The genetic sequence of every customer and employee is recorded in a database that anyone can access for a modest fee. Enforcement agencies rely on this service intensively to identify nefarious actors from even the smallest residues.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责基因数据库的维护和安全，以确保官僚体系的流畅高效。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for maintaining and safekeeping the Genetic Index, ensuring a smooth and efficient bureaucracy.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责评估访问请求和货币化计划，可以检索任何给定个体的基因识别信息。
entries.en: Tasked with assessing access requests and monetization plans, the $TITLE$ can retrieve the genetic identification of any given individual.

entries.zh: 这个社会意识到个人的灵感是真正的创新来源。开源专利、开放思想、自发合作和创新奖励为进步铺平了道路。
entries.en: This society has realized that individual inspiration is the root of true innovation. Open-source patents, open-mindedness, spontaneous collaborations and innovation bounties pave the way to progress.

entries.zh: $t$—派系产出$r_research$而非$r_unity$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—派系将在游戏开始后不久在帝国内出现，但派系产出在头一个十年将会削减。
entries.en: $t$- Factions produce $r_research$ instead of $r_unity$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Factions will form in your empire shortly after the game starts, but Faction Output is reduced for the first ten years

entries.zh: 部门间定期的创新竞赛刺激了该企业的研发主动性。
entries.en: Regular inter-department innovation competitions spur this corporation's R&D initiatives.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责监管专利的公平使用，并制定与政府技术重点相一致的研究激励措施。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is tasked with overseeing the fair use of patents and creating research incentives aligned with the government's technological focuses.

entries.zh: 不是每个项目都值得投资，而$TITLE$则负责评估它们是否具有市场推广价值。
entries.en: Not all projects are worth investing into, and it is the duty of the $TITLE$ to assess their marketability and profitability.

entries.zh: 该帝国中，教育取代了执法的地位。通过全面的准备和严格的课程调整，他们确保所有人都 在学习。毕竟，民不教，师之过。
entries.en: In this empire, education has supplanted law enforcement. Through comprehensive preparation and strict course correction, they ensure that no individual is beyond the reach of learning. After all, there are no bad citizens - only bad educators.

entries.zh: $TITLE$的使命是让每一位公民都具备必要的知识，不仅能让他们做好本质工作，而且还能驾驭生活本身的复杂性。良好的教育促进社会繁荣。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is entrusted to equip every citizen with the knowledge necessary to not only do their work, but to navigate the complexities of life itself. Good pedagogy promotes a flourishing society.

entries.zh: 这些孜孜不倦的知识斗士致力于培养年轻人，确保每为公民都准备好了为星系做出不可替代的贡献。
entries.en: Dedicated to preparing the youth, these tireless champions of knowledge perform the irreplaceable service of ensuring that every citizen is ready to face the galaxy.

entries.zh: £job_educator£$job_educator_plural$将$r_consumer_goods$转化为$r_unity$、£crime£§Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!降低、提升§Y主流思潮吸引力§!、并产生£defense_army£§Y防御部队§!
entries.en: £job_educator£ $job_educator_plural$ use $r_consumer_goods$ to produce $r_unity$, decrease £crime£ §Y$PLANET_CRIME_TITLE$§!, increase §YGoverning Ethics Attraction§!, and spawn £defense_army£ §YDefense Armies§!

entries.zh: 这里负责教授建设健康社会所需的一切基础知识。
entries.en: Here the fundamentals deemed necessary for a healthy society are taught.

entries.zh: 这里涵盖社会生活的方方面面。在这座庞大的教育培训综合设施体中，任何偏差都可以纠正。
entries.en: Covering every aspect of life in society. Within this massive complex of schools and training facilities any deviation can be corrected.

entries.zh: 完整公民权人口资源产出
要合作，不要对抗。该蜂群思维进化出了外交工蜂，能够模仿对话者的外形和举止。
entries.en: Cooperation is preferred to direct confrontation. This Hive Mind has evolved diplomatic drones able to take on the shape and mannerisms of their interlocutors.

entries.zh: 要合作，不要对抗。该荒野进化出了外交化身，能够模仿对话者的外形和举止。
entries.en: Cooperation is preferred to direct confrontation. This Wilderness has evolved diplomatic avatars able to take on the shape and mannerisms of their interlocutors.

entries.zh: 特使及行政官会转变成指派到的目标帝国的形象。\n执行§Y外交行动§!所需的§Y信任度§!：§G-50%§!
entries.en: Envoys and Officials take on the physical form of the Empires they are assigned to.\n§YTrust§! Required to perform §YDiplomatic Actions§!: §G-50%§!

entries.zh: 这个蜂巢的突变基因组被用作培育生物飞船的基础，它们的舰队与工蜂有着内在的联系，从物种的独特性中汲取力量。
entries.en: This hive's mutated genome was used as the basis to grow its biological ships, and their fleets are intrinsically linked with their drones, drawing strength from the species' uniqueness.

entries.zh: 该荒野中的一个突变基因组被用作培育生物飞船的基础，它们的舰队与共生体有着内在的联系，从物种的独特性中汲取力量。
entries.en: A genome within this Wilderness mutated into a suitable base from which to grow biological ships. Its fleets are intrinsically linked with other symbionts, with each species drawing strength from the other.

entries.zh: —主体物种每个§G正面§!特质：§G+2.5%§!船体值，§R+0.5%§!维护费。\n—主体物种每个§R负面§!特质：§G+1.5%§!舰船射速，§R+0.5%§!维护费。
entries.en: - For each §GPositive§! main species trait: §G+2.5%§! Ship Hull, §R+0.5%§! Upkeep.\n- For each §RNegative§! main species trait: §G+1.5%§! Ship Fire Rate, §R+0.5%§! Upkeep.

entries.zh: 由荷尔蒙和怨恨的恰当组合驱动着过刺激的攻击性中心促进了我们的舰船。
entries.en: Our ships benefit from overstimulated centers of aggression, fueled by a healthy mix of hormones and spite.

entries.zh: 我们舰船的肌肉和骨骼物质被我们物种的基因优越性所增强。
entries.en: Our ships' muscles and bone mass are favored by the genetic superiority of our species.

entries.zh: 该集体的生物舰船特别适合进行跨大气层航行，可以进行近距离空中支援或帮助行星物流。
entries.en: This collective's biological ships are especially suited to inter-atmospheric flights, allowing them to carry out close air support missions, or even assist with planetary logistics.

entries.zh: —在§G友好§!殖民地轨道的§Y生物舰船§!的维护费§G-50%§!。\n—有§Y生物舰船§!在轨的§G友好§!殖民地依据舰队规模，提升§Y建造速度§!、§Y舒适度§!、§Y清理障碍速度§!以及潜在的§Y岗位产出§!。\n—在§R敌对§!殖民地轨道的§Y生物舰船§!降低§G-85%§!舰船维护费。
entries.en: - §YBiological Ships§! in orbit of §GFriendly§! colonies have §G-50%§! ship upkeep.\n- §GFriendly§! colonies with §YBiological Ships§! in orbit get increased §YBuild Speed§!, §YAmenities§!, §YClear Blocker Speed§! and potentially §YJob Output§!, depending on fleet size.\n- §YBiological Ships§! in orbit of §RHostile§! colonies have §G-85%§! ship upkeep.

entries.zh: 在该行星轨道上的生物舰船频繁地在大气层内外穿梭，进行栖息、进食以及帮助行星上工蜂等任务。
entries.en: The biological ships orbiting this planet routinely enter and exit the atmosphere to rest, feed, and assist planetside drones.

entries.zh: 这个机器智能专门研究防御性军事流程，将硬防御和游击战手续结合在一起。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence specializes into defensive military procedures, combining hard defense with hit and run protocols.

entries.zh: 内在才是真正的关键。这个蜂群非常擅长渗透，能够操控某些倒霉有机体的身体。随着傀儡数量的增加，宿主文明最终会被这个蜂群集体意识所吸收。
entries.en: It's what's inside that counts. This hive specializes in infiltration, commandeering the bodies of unfortunate organics. Inevitably, as the amount of puppets grows, the host civilization is absorbed into the collective.

entries.zh: 游戏初始包含§Y1000§!个同化£pop£人口以及§Y同化§!有机人口进入蜂巢的能力。\n解锁['concept_operation_bodysnatcher_prepare_invasion']谍报任务。\n从['concept_operation_smuggle_pops']谍报任务重获得额外£pop£人口
entries.en: Start the game with §Y1000§! assimilated £pop£ Pops and the ability to §YAssimilate§! organics into the hive mind.\nHas access to the ['concept_operation_bodysnatcher_prepare_invasion'] Espionage Mission\nGains extra £pop£ Pops from the ['concept_operation_smuggle_pops'] Espionage Mission

entries.zh: 邻居们思想是如此丰富多变。通过发送已经整合进我意识的身躯，我们能轻易地将其收入囊中。
entries.en: Our neighbors have such malleable minds. By sending in prepared bodies, already integrated into our consciousness, we can more easily bring them into the fold.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n我们会在对§Y[Target.GetName]§!宣战后获得内应的支援。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nWe will have the aid of inside agents when next we declare a war on §Y[Target.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R我们已经准备了对该国家的入侵。通过宣战加以激活。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RWe have already prepared an invasion against this country. Declare a war to trigger it.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R该国家面对渗透企图过于严防死守，我们无法发起这项行动！§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThis country is too well-prepared against infiltration attempts. We cannot launch this operation!§!

entries.zh: 一个可以同化和目标物种人口以渗透目标帝国的行动，做好当战争爆发时进行大规模破坏的准备。
entries.en: An operation where assimilated Pops of the target species infiltrate the empire, preparing for mass sabotage once war breaks out.

entries.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
entries.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

entries.zh: 该工作依然顺利进行着，我们的人发现了更多的宿主，对[Target.GetName]事务的参与已经得到巩固。我们的子个体应该很快就能容纳任何好奇的头脑。
entries.en: The works continues smoothly, our bodies have found more hosts and involvement in [Target.GetName] matters have solidified. Our drones should soon have subsumed any inquisitive minds.

entries.zh: 我们无法替换的[Target.GetSpeciesName]已经从他们的岗位上移除，在§Y[Target.GetName]§!的结构中创造了许多真空。我们的人偶已经准备好打开全方位渗透的通路，唯一需要做的就是继续执行。
entries.en: The [Target.GetSpeciesName] we couldn't replace have been removed from their positions which has created several vacancies within the §Y[Target.GetName]§! structure. Our puppets are ready to open the door for our full infiltration, all they need is the go ahead.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Target.GetName]§!无力抵抗了。他们已经做好了被入侵的准备，我们只需要决定派多少冒名顶替者去进一步渗透他们的帝国。很快都会是[Owner.GetAdj]的。
entries.en: The §Y[From.Target.GetName]§! have been compromised. They are primed for invasion and all we need to decide is how many imposters we send over to further infiltrate their empire. Soon all will be [Owner.GetAdj].

entries.zh: 我们没有足够的目标物种人口来执行该行动。
entries.en: We do not have enough Pops of the target species for this action.

entries.zh: 我们已经尽自己所能派出了。
entries.en: We have sent over all we can.

entries.zh: 确保他们的哨站变成我们的。
§G10§!年内我们对§Y[From.Target.GetName]§!发动的或他们对我们发动的下一场战争将会充分利用上已经准备好的渗透者。
entries.en: The next war we declare against the §Y[From.Target.GetName]§! or is declared against us within §G10§! years will make use of our prepared infiltrators.

entries.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
entries.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

entries.zh:
我们起先以为是某种故障。我们的半数通讯网络都陷入瘫痪。

但不是的，奸诈的[From.GetName]悄悄替换了整个星域的关键人员。我们的帝国支离破碎，殖民地遭到入闽。

不要相信任何人！
entries.en:
First we thought it was a glitch. Half our communication network blacked out.

But no, the duplicitous [From.GetName] replaced entire sectors of key personnel. Our empire is fractured and our colonies are being invaded.

Do not trust anyone!

entries.zh: 我们的特工将对[target.GetName]内的孤立人群进行大规模的渗透
entries.en: Our operatives will conduct large scale exfiltration efforts on isolated elements within the [target.GetName]

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R[Target.GetName]也是极端平权主义，他们的人民已经拥有自由了。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThe [Target.GetName] are also Fanatic Egalitarians, their people are already free§!
$TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThe [Target.GetName] don't have enough £pops£ Pops worth stealing§!

entries.zh: 从目标国家绑架人口的行动。
entries.en: An operation to abduct Pops from the target.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经建立了许多前线和藏身处来监控[target.GetName]上的人口。对异见者、孤独者，或高技能人才将进行评估和标记，以便我们获取。
entries.en: Our operatives have established a number of fronts and hideouts from which they monitor the population of the [target.GetName]. Dissidents, loners, or highly skilled individuals will be assessed and marked for extraction.

entries.zh: 我们的特工已经开始围捕目标并把他们藏到隐蔽的地方。一旦有击毁，就策划一些事件分散当地政府的注意力，掩盖我们的踪迹。
entries.en: Our operatives have started rounding up targets and secreting them away to secluded locations. Whenever possible, incidents are staged to distract the local authorities and cover our tracks.

entries.zh: 行动进入到了一个关键的阶段，我们必须将围猎的人群秘密地运输到轨道上。当前的计划是在所有设施中同步撤离，让安全部队不堪重负。
entries.en: The operation has entered a critical phase where everyone we rounded up must be discretely transferred in orbit. The current plan is to synchronize departures across all facilities and overwhelm security forces with duds and diversions.

entries.zh: 我们成功地送出了许多目标，但行动也并非一帆风顺，许多满载有用个体的船只被抛在了后面。
entries.en: We successfully shipped out many of our targets, but the operation did not go without hitches and many ships filled with promising individuals were left behind.

entries.zh: $bio.915.desc$\n\n如此大规模的人口迁移并不会被忽视。
entries.en: $bio.915.desc$\n\nSuch vast movements of population haven't gone unnoticed.

entries.zh: 我们成功地抓回了许多目标，他们已经在送往凝练机的路上了。但行动并非一帆风顺，许多满载拥有个体的船只被抛在了后面。
entries.en: We have successfully extracted many of our targets, they are already being sent off to the Lathe. But the operation did not go without hitches and many ships filled with promising individuals were left behind.

entries.zh: $bio.915.desc.cosmogenesis$\n\n如此大规模的人口迁移并不会被忽视。
entries.en: $bio.915.desc.cosmogenesis$\n\nSuch vast movements of population haven't gone unnoticed.
We have done what we can.

entries.zh: 偷出无人留意的£pop£§H人口§!到合适的星球上。
$bio.915.tt$\n即便§Y[From.Target.GetName]§!之前没有注意到我们，§R现在肯定也已经注意到了。§!
entries.en: $bio.915.tt$\nIf the §Y[From.Target.GetName]§! weren't aware of us before, §Rthey certainly are now.§!

entries.zh: 奸诈的$COUNTRY|Y$渗透入边境绑架了我们的人口！
entries.en: The duplicitous $COUNTRY|Y$ have infiltrated our borders and abducted our people!

entries.zh: 我们可以决定是否允许那些与中枢意识断开连接的子个体在我们的殖民地上生存。
entries.en: We can decide whether or not to allow drones disconnected from their central consciousness to live on our Colonies.

entries.zh: 尽管从集体意识中分离，这些工蜂还是维持了生存。\n\n§E为断连工蜂解锁§Y公民权类型§!§!
entries.en: Though severed from a collective consciousness, these drones can be kept alive.\n\n§EUnlocks §YCitizenship Types§! for Disconnected Drones§!

entries.zh: 智慧生物的权利对这些没有理智的东西不成立。没有中央意识的控制，这些工蜂就是一群动物，而碍事的动物就该死。\n\n§E所有生活在我们殖民地的工蜂将会被§R灭绝§!。§!
entries.en: The rights of a sapient being do not extend to those without reason. Without a central consciousness to guide them, these drones are little more than animals, and an animal that gets in the way is a pest.\n\n§EAll Disconnected Drones living on our Colonies will be §RPurged§!.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$断连工蜂会被我们帝国净化。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Disconnected drones are being purged in our empire.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$在脱离集体意识后，这个物种的人口将会灭亡。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Severed from their collective consciousness, Pops of this species will expire.

entries.zh: §L这些工蜂从集体意识中脱离，可以帮助我们建设殖民地。§!
entries.en: §LSevered from their collective consciousness, these drones can aid us on our colonies.§!

entries.zh: §L在脱离集体意识后，这些工蜂可以被操纵为仆人。§!
entries.en: §LSevered from their collective consciousness, these drones can be manipulated into servitude.§!

entries.zh: 该物种的人口可以在£building£§Y外星动物园§!中工作
entries.en: Pops of this species can be employed in £building£ §YAlien Zoos§!

entries.zh: 该物种的人口可以作为§Y劳工§!工作。
entries.en: Pops of this species can be employed as §YWorkers§!.

entries.zh: 人口可以在建有£building£§Y$building_slave_processing$§!的殖民地上雇佣为§Y$SLAVES$§!
entries.en: Pops can be employed as §Y$SLAVES$§! on Colonies with a £building£ §Y$building_slave_processing$§!

entries.zh: 在脱离集体意识后，这些工蜂仅凭基础的本能行动。
entries.en: Severed from their collective consciousness, these drones are guided by little more than base instinct.
£job_synapse_drone£ $job_disconnected_drone_plural$ produce resources depending on their §YSpecies Traits§!.

entries.zh: 这个好战的直觉曾是蜂巢中的众多意识冲动之一。如今它试图建立对其他分巢的统治，但同时还要兼顾阻止自己内斗。
entries.en: The aggressive and warlike instincts that used to be one of many impulses within the Hive. Now it attempts to establish control over the other fragments, when not fighting itself.

entries.zh: 这是失落蜂巢对演化和变革的欲望。这个分巢专注于持续的自我革新以至于无暇顾及重建对其他分巢的控制。
entries.en: The desire for evolution and change from the Fallen Hive. Since it's so focused on reinventing itself constantly the fragment has a hard time establishing control over the others.

entries.zh: 一种抑制反常、促进统一的执念主宰了这个分巢。它无比渴望控制其他碎片，但我们宇宙中无可避免的混沌使其无法集中注意。
entries.en: The obsessional instinct to suppress deviancy and promote uniformity defines this fragment. It wants to control the other fragments more than anything, but the constant chaos inherent to our universe is a constant distraction.

entries.zh: 破镜重圆，分裂的伤痕没有成为这个觉醒帝国的瑕疵，反而使其焕然一新。过去的蜂巢思维已为陈迹，现在的蜂巢思维将驭永恒。
entries.en: Once broken, now restored. The scars of the splintering are not what makes this Awakened Empire brittle but what makes it new. The old Hive Mind failed. This one aims to rule eternally.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国仅是过去整体的冰山一角，缺乏统治星际帝国所必须的核心部分。
entries.en: Possessing a part of what used to be a whole this Fallen Empire lacks core aspects required to govern a stellar empire.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国的工蜂永无天日地互相厮打，导致资源严重短缺。
entries.en: The drones in this Fallen Empire are constantly fighting each other, leading to a severe shortage of resources.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国的工蜂被持续强行演化。他们几乎没有能够用来完成指派给他们工作所需的肢体。
entries.en: The drones of this Fallen Empire are constantly being forcefully evolved. They seldom have the limbs required for the work they are assigned.

entries.zh: 该觉醒帝国的工蜂受到了极高程度的微操，即便如工厂着火之类的任何因素都不能使其从当前的任务中分心一丝一毫。
entries.en: The drones of this Fallen Empire are micromanaged to such a degree that they may not deviate from their task for any reason. Even if the factory is on fire.

entries.zh: 一个终于破镜重圆的远古意识，被最现代的直觉驱动着。
entries.en: An ancient consciousness reforged at last, and driven by modern instincts.

entries.zh: 这个觉醒帝国将早已失传的古阵法带回星系舞台。他们的舰队将淹没群星。
entries.en: Previously lost tactics and formations are displayed on the galactic stage again by this Awakened Empire. Their fleets shall blot out the stars.

entries.zh: 这个觉醒帝国采用着早已失传的飞升及繁荣之道。他们的子个体多过繁星。
entries.en: Previously lost methods of ascension and prosperity are employed by this Awakened Empire. Their drones shall outnumber the stars.

entries.zh: 这个觉醒帝国再一次采用了早已失传的权力制度。他们的势力将触及众星。
entries.en: Previously lost displays of authority and regulations are being employed once more by this Awakened Empire. Their grasp shall reach even the stars.

entries.zh: 尽管这颗星球理论上是宜居的，但在这里居住可谓噩梦。所有的当地野生物种，无论是动物或是植物，甚至不起眼的小东西，事实上都比我们母星上最可怕的掠食者更致命。
entries.en: Although technically habitable, this world is a true nightmare to live on. Every local form of wildlife, from flora to fauna, down to the unassuming critters has proven deadlier than the most fearsome predators on our home planet.

entries.zh: 被战争碎片遗弃的实验体和标本在这里不断进行着血腥的非自然选择。这片极度危险的训练场地对大多数士兵来说无疑是致命的，但幸存者必将蜕变为无情的杀戮机器。
entries.en: Specimens and experiments discarded by the War fragment constantly vie for survival in bloody unnatural selection. These incredibly hostile training grounds are sure to prove lethal for most soldiers but survivors would undoubtedly come out of this as relentless killing machines.

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y颚蚁§!与§Y织蛛§!舰船科技。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YMauler§! and §YWeaver§! ships.\n

entries.zh: 通过扭曲时空联系，这些舰船超越了常规限制，它们紧凑船体下所蕴含的性能令那些遵循物理定律的普通舰船可望而不可及。
entries.en: By warping the relationship between space and time, these vessels transcend normal limitations. Their compact frames conceal capabilities no physics-abiding ship can match.

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y孵后§!舰船科技
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YHarbinger§!

entries.zh: 解锁失落帝国的§Y泰坦刺蜂§!舰船科技
entries.en: Unlocks the technology for the Fallen Empire §YStinger Titan§!

entries.zh: 通过有机体的时空维度超越法则，这种颚蚁的内部空间远大于其紧凑外观所见，塞入了高密度的肌肉组织。它的咬颚所能造成的伤害超出物理法则限制。
entries.en: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.

entries.zh: 困境织蛛装备的支援武器阵列遮蔽了其可见的解剖结构，改写了空间常识。单凭他们就足以扭转整场战斗的趋势。
entries.en: Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.

entries.zh: 这些迷宫孵后将舰载机嵌套在相互交织的维度口袋中，每艘舰船都是一个不可思议的机库迷宫，足以部署出堪比一支舰队的火力。
entries.en: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.

entries.zh: 神秘刺蜂装载的武器系统数量超出了其动力源的理应能承受的极限，它本不可能运作的，但实际并非如此，它不但能开火，而且还能持续开火。
entries.en: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.

entries.zh:
§H我们没有如期收到平和有序的回应，取而代之的是三个不同的信号同时向我们袭来。尽管内容大不相同，但它们都来自同一个声音。§!

信号1：[GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]
信号2：[GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]
信号3：[GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]

§H此时，这些声音陷入了混乱的杂音。分析显示每个信号中都包含着一个复杂的标识符。为了便于理解，我们将其翻译为：§Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!、§Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!和§Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!。§!
entries.en:
§HInstead of a calm and ordered exchange, we are assaulted by three separate signals. Though vastly different in content, each speaks with the same voice.§!

Signal 1: [GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]
Signal 2: [GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]
Signal 3: [GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]

§HAt this point, the voices descended into a garbled mess. Analysis revealed that within each signal was a complex designation. For ease of use, we have translated these as: §Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!, §Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!, and §Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!.§!

entries.zh: “弱小的生物。我们很好奇，你们会如何发动战争？观察你们的挣扎，倾听你们的喋喋不休...这会很有趣。为何——”
entries.en: "Weak creatures. How would you war, we wonder? To watch your struggle, to hear your chatter... We would be entertained. Why - "

entries.zh: “生机勃勃！而且营养充足。你们是出于必需而生长，还是出于自主选择？我们已经记不清了。为何——”
entries.en: "Abundant life! And well fed. Do you grow out of necessity or because you choose to? We can't remember. Why - "

entries.zh: “这样的躯体...你们的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]偏离中心3%。这必须要纠正。我们认定你们会服从。为何——”
entries.en: "Such bodies... Your [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] are 3% off center. This must be corrected. We assume your compliance. Why - "

entries.zh: “——无用的护盾，连恒星核心都无法承受。这片星系一定让你们感到恐惧。你们一定是——”
entries.en: " - useless shields, not even able to withstand the heart of a star. This galaxy must terrify you. You must be - "

entries.zh: “——孔窍数量不足。如果有第三个[Species.GetMouthName]，你们可能会开始有所进步。你们可能——”
entries.en: " - not enough orifices. With a tertiary [Species.GetMouthName] you may begin to see some gains. You may - "

entries.zh: “——令人痛心的低效语言。混乱的语法必须要规范化。你们将执行我们的改动——”
entries.en: " - painfully inefficient language. Anarchic grammar must be rationalized. You will apply our changes - "

entries.zh:
§H失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。§!

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
entries.en:
§HThe usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.§!

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlural]. Proceed, and the consequences will be unimaginable, your pain - unendurable.

You will not disturb us - it - me.

entries.zh: §H一致——合唱——再次响起，三个碎片如同一体般开口：§!\n\n——滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！滚——
entries.en: §HThe accord - the chorus - resumes, all three fragments speaking as one:§!\n\n - out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out!Get out! Get -

entries.zh: 我们会得到你们的秘密。
今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达§Y[target_system.GetName]§!。\n\n努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。
entries.en: Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it against something alien. A specimen will be arriving in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! in due course.\n\nEndeavor to provide us with some interesting data.

entries.zh: 这才是值得一战的挑战！
一艘实验性的失落帝国舰船将抵达§Y[target_system.GetName]§!
entries.en: An experimental Fallen Empire Ship will be arriving in §Y[target_system.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我们看到那个实验品还活着。你们还是太弱了。\n\n也许我们应该派一只变形虫来的。
entries.en: We see that the experimental breed still lives. You are still too weak.\n\nPerhaps we should have sent an amoeba.

entries.zh: 精彩。我们很高兴看到你们注意到了这个品系偏好闪避火力的特点，并恰当地加以利用。请放心，等到下一代完成孕育时，它就不会再有这个缺陷了。\n\n你们已经成长了，年轻的[root.GetSpeciesName]。做好准备吧。
entries.en: Glorious. We are pleased that you noted the preference this breed had for dodging fire and exploited it properly. Be assured that it won't have that fault by the time the next generation finishes gestating.\n\nYou have grown young [root.GetSpeciesName]. Be prepared.

entries.zh: 我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，§Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。
entries.en: We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the §Y[unfortunate_country.GetName]§!. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

entries.zh: $bio.3130.desc.notruce$\n\n别担心你们之间的停战协定。它已经不存在了。
entries.en: $bio.3130.desc.notruce$\n\nAnd do not worry about the truce you have with them. It is gone.

entries.zh: 冲突不是进步的唯一途径！
entries.en: Conflict is not the only means of progress!

entries.zh:
年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。

虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。

花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。
entries.en:
Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.

While it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

entries.zh:
你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是§Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在§Y[target_planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
entries.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the §Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!.

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was ripe. Your colony on §Y[target_planet.GetName]§! - it is the ideal recipient. Its biosphere will be subsumed momentarily.

entries.zh: 我们认为§Y[alternate_planet.GetName]§!会是个更好的试验场！
entries.en: We believe §Y[alternate_planet.GetName]§! would be a much better test bed!

entries.zh: 多么荒谬的要求，我们拒绝！
entries.en: What an absurd demand, we refuse!

entries.zh: §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§!已经完成了对§Y[root.GetName]§!的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。
entries.en: The §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§! has completed its modifications on §Y[root.GetName]§!. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

entries.zh: $bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
entries.en: $bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nPlanetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single chirp can operate an automatic door, and a swarm can incapacitate a factory. We are adapting by switching frequencies, but not all facilities will be returned to full efficiency.

entries.zh: 这完全不能接受，清除所有昆虫！
entries.en: This is unacceptable, remove every insect!

entries.zh: 更新受到干扰。清除这些虫子。
这个星球的电波中充斥着经人工改造的昆虫发出的窸窣声。
entries.en: This planet's airwaves are filled with the chittering from artificially modified insects.

entries.zh: $bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n在整个星球上，那些曾经只知道吃草和泥浴的生物现在开始向我们提出关于存在本质的令人不安的问题。失落帝国改变了这个世界上大量野生动物的天性。
entries.en: $bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nPlanetwide, creatures once content with grazing and mud baths now confront us with unsettling questions about existence. The Fallen Empire has tampered with large swathes of the world's fauna.

entries.zh: §Y[This.GetName]§!上有§Y500§!个新的£pop£§H人口§!获得了智慧。
$bio.3210.desc.base$\n\n这个世界在发光。字面意思的发光。这些改造不知何故让世界上各种物种都具有了生物荧光，并且不断发出类似引擎运转的嗡鸣声。我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]再也无法体验真正的昼夜循环了，我们需要为他们提供遮光设备。
entries.en: $bio.3210.desc.base$\n\nThe world is shining. Literally. The modifications have somehow provided the world's varied species with a bioluminescent glow and an incessant hum like that of a running engine. Our [owner.GetColonistPlural] no longer get to experience a true night cycle, we will need to provide them with blackout equipment.
What a terrible day to have [owner.GetEyeNamePlural].

entries.zh: 把它们遮起来，砍掉它们。我们不能让这种情况继续下去！
entries.en: Cover them up, chop them down. We can't let this continue!

entries.zh: 一个永远没有黑夜的星球，其动物群被设计成发出永恒的光芒，并伴随着持续不断的刺耳振动。任何居民都需要大量支持才能承受这种无休止的环境。
entries.en: A planet where night never falls, its fauna engineered to emit a perpetual glow and pulsate with incessant, grating vibrations. Any inhabitants will require significant support merely to withstand the relentless conditions.

entries.zh: 生活在你们境内的§Y[boring_species.GetName]§!物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。\n\n不要让我们感到无聊。
entries.en: The §Y[boring_species.GetName]§! species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of three different methods to rectify this... failure.\n\nDo not bore us.

entries.zh: 我们不会一直保持现状。
entries.en: We wont stay the same for long.

entries.zh: 我们不会因你的一时兴起就改变一个物种！
entries.en: We won't change a species on your whim!

entries.zh: 我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]§!的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。
entries.en: We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]§!. Do not be alarmed. A complete [interesting_species.GetName] is not necessary. A [interesting_species.GetHandName] will suffice to cultivate a replacement.

entries.zh: 在宏大的计划面前，一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]算得了什么？
entries.en: What is a single [interesting_species.GetHandName] in the grand scheme of things?

entries.zh: 我们不能让你染指我们的基因构造！
entries.en: You cannot be trusted with our genetic makeup!

entries.zh:
§H这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。§!

我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个§Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§!用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。

运输船已在§Y[target_pop.Planet.GetName]§!外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。
entries.en:
§HThis is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.§!

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A §Y[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]§! must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance can not be tolerated. Will not be tolerated.

The transport is already positioned outside §Y[target_pop.Planet.GetName]§!. Time is against you. Failure to comply jeopardizes stability.
You will have to take them from us!

entries.zh: §H我们接通了来自§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的§Y[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]§!。§!\n\n
entries.en: §HWe accepted the communication from §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar §Y[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]§!.§!\n\n

entries.zh: $bio.3305.followup$今天对你们来说是个转折点。你们物种的基因序列已经得到保障——已被同化入整体。你们的未来不再充满不确定。当时机来临时，你们将成为我们的一部分。
entries.en: $bio.3305.followup$Today marks a pivotal moment for you. Your species' genetic sequence has been secured - assimilated into the whole. Your future is no longer uncertain. When the time comes, you will be part of us.

entries.zh: 原来我们也会让其他人有这种感受吗？
entries.en: Is that how we make others feel?

entries.zh: $bio.3305.followup$时间不多了。他们在§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.GetName]§!对我们进行的实验简直难以形容，这种事甚至不该在最凶恶的敌人身上施行。我希望这个数据包中的内容能确保这个碎片永远无法控制我们。
entries.en: $bio.3305.followup$There is not much time. The experiments they have been running on us here on §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.GetName]§! are undescribable, and shouldn't be done to our worst enemies. I hope what's in this data packet ensures that this fragment never gains control of us.

entries.zh: 有§G50%§!的几率这不是测试，而是包含了§Y失落帝国§!的真实机密。
entries.en: §G50%§! chance this is not a test, but rather contains genuine secrets of the §YFallen Empire§!.
It's a trap! End the transmission!

entries.zh: 我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的§Y星海共同体§!提出了一项必须§Y[GetPassFail]§!的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。\n\n§H失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。§!
entries.en: We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering §YGalactic Community§! has proposed a resolution which must §Y[GetPassFail]§!. To assist in crafting your arguments you may make use of our superior knowledge. Assuming you actually have the capacity for complex thought, pay attention.\n\n§HThe Fallen Empire closed their communications with us.§!
These are not the proper procedures!

entries.zh: 有了失落帝国的援助，诉讼和冗长演说都变得轻而易举。
entries.en: The aid of a Fallen Empire makes litigation and filibustering a breeze.

entries.zh: 我们遵循了$FALLEN_EMPIRE|Y$的指示，他们对结果很满意。我们暂时安全了。
entries.en: We have followed the instructions of the $FALLEN_EMPIRE|Y$ and they are pleased with the outcome. We are safe for another day.

entries.zh: 我们未能遵循$FALLEN_EMPIRE|Y$给我们的指示。我们只能希望他们能宽恕我们。
entries.en: We failed to follow the instructions left to us by the $FALLEN_EMPIRE|Y$. We can only hope they will forgive us.

entries.zh: 你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。\n\n§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
entries.en: Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.\n\nThe §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system is impractical and discordant. You must purge it from your Empire now for the sake of galactic cohesion.

entries.zh: 你们想让我们放弃一个恒星系就为了美化边境？！
entries.en: You want us to abandon a system to prettify our borders?!
But we like it like this!

entries.zh: 我们必须解散在§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系的恒星基地，否则将面临§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!的怒火。
entries.en: We must disband our starbase in the §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system or suffer the wrath of the §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 装疯卖傻？你们只需要放弃§Y[offending_system.GetName]§!恒星系就够了。\n\n也许我们应该更积极地收拾你们。
entries.en: Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the §Y[offending_system.GetName]§! system.\n\nPerhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.

entries.zh: 总算开窍了。§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!星系的事就此揭过。看来你们还有救，或许有朝一日能达到我们的境界。\n\n我们会一直盯着你们的。
entries.en: It is good to see you learning from your past mistakes, finally. Consider the §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! system issue now resolved. There is hope yet that you may become more like us.\n\nWe will be watching.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以讨好觉醒帝国并创造有价值的对手。
entries.en: War is waged to entertain the Awakened Empire and create viable rivals.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!将会奖励富有斗志的参与。觉醒帝国的§Y厌战度§!越高奖励越丰厚。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! will reward spirited engagement. The higher the Awakened Empire's §YWar Exhaustion§! the better the reward.

entries.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以§Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
entries.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the §Y[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]§!. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

entries.zh: $bio.3400.desc.nogalcom$\n\n现在，你们的“§Y星海共同体§!”将由我们接管。欢庆吧。
entries.en: $bio.3400.desc.nogalcom$\n\nWe will now be taking command of your '§YGalactic Community§!'. Celebrations are warranted.

entries.zh: 为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。\n\n记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
entries.en: Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.\n\nKnow this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

entries.zh: 听腻了你们的调调，我们不会给你们伴舞。
entries.en: We've heard your tune, and we're not dancing.

entries.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]抗拒着一切靠近者。指派到该项目的研究者开始编造借口拖延工作，而仪器则会出现类似拒绝接收数据一样的故障。\n\n这里发生了一些事情——一些可怕的事情，它的回声至今仍在现实中回荡。
entries.en: [From.Planet.GetName] repels all who approach. Researchers assigned to its study invent excuses to delay their work, while instruments glitch and fail as if rejecting the data itself.\n\nSomething happened here - something so horrific that its echoes still reverberate through reality.

entries.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]的审慎调查带领我们穿过层层叠叠的半石化生物质直至深深的地下。最终，我们传入了行星的中空内核——结果只发现每前进一步，令人压抑的大气都变得愈发沉重。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]有过心理预估，但这种愈发沉重不安令人无法忍受。许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]发生了集体崩溃，陷入紧张症。这些人员必须立即撤离。

行星内部的巨大空洞并不是一般意义上的虚空。我们发现埋藏其中的是某些超出我们对生物体尺寸认知的东西。微弱羊膜残留迹象打消了一切疑虑。[From.Planet.GetName]并不是一颗荒芜的石头，它是一颗卵。

而其中，一颗胎死卵中的巨兽沉眠着。
entries.en:
Our cautious survey of [From.Planet.GetName] led us deep underground, through endless layers of semi-fossilized biological matter. At last, we breached the planet's hollow core - only to find the oppressive atmosphere growing heavier with every step. Despite [Root.GetLeaderName]'s precautions, the mounting unease proved unbearable. Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] succumbed to a collective breakdown, collapsing into catatonia. They had to be evacuated immediately.

The vast cavern at the planet's heart is no ordinary void. Buried within, we found the remains of something far beyond the scale of any known lifeform. Faint traces of amniotic residue erased all doubt. [From.Planet.GetName] was never a barren rock. It is an egg.

And within, a stillborn monster sleeps.

entries.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在这个胎死卵中的生物的头骨深处找到了一个奇怪的卷须网络。顺着这些有机细丝找到它们的来源，他们发现了突触簇的外部阵列——这是一个复杂的系统，仍然具有令人毛骨悚然的潜力。\n\n现在，[Root.GetLeaderName]正试图利用沿着卷须跳动的古老电路与之交互。它脑内的知识应该存在得比它还久。至于它是否还记得，这还有待观察。
entries.en: On [From.Planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have traced a network of strange tendrils embedded deep within the skull of the stillborn creature. Following these organic filaments to their source, they uncovered an external array of synaptic clusters - an intricate system still thrumming with eerie potential.\n\nNow, [Root.GetLeaderName] is attempting to interface with them, tapping into the ancient circuitry that pulses along the tendrils' length. Whatever knowledge it holds has long outlived its host. Whether it still remembers remains to be seen.

entries.zh:
这是十万年前的事。将蜂巢思维对时间的感知转换成星系标准单位是一个微妙的过程，但通过筛选生物计算机的记忆，[Root.GetLeaderName]逐渐拼凑出真相。

在这个蜂巢最强大的日子里，它面对着一个无法击败的敌人。虽然与许多盟友并肩作战，但每次都以失败告终。绝望中滋生出了鲁莽。

随后发生的大部分事情都被故意抹去了，但仍残留零散片段——足以让人瞥见他们最后的豪赌。蜂巢铸造了这颗行星大小的卵，作为他们飞升的容器，试图放弃他们脆弱的、被束缚在行星上的存在，并打算与孵化的幼崽融合。目前尚不清楚他们是打算战斗还是逃跑。

但是当这头生物动起来的时候，发生了可怕的事情。
entries.en:
It happened a hundred thousand years ago. Translating the Hive's perception of time into galactic standard units has been a delicate process, but by sifting through the biocomputer's memories, [Root.GetLeaderName] is beginning to piece together the truth.

At the height of its power, the Hive faced an enemy it could not defeat. Though it stood with many allies, every battle ended in failure. Desperation bred recklessness.

Much of what followed has been deliberately erased, but scattered fragments remain - enough to glimpse their final gamble. The Hive forged this planet-sized egg as the vessel for their ascension, seeking to abandon their frail, planet-bound existence and merge with the hatchling. Whether they intended to fight or flee is unclear.

But as the creature stirred, something went terribly wrong.

entries.zh:
通过精确地连接幸存的生物计算机和仍活跃的突触连接，我们从这个胎死卵中的生物中提取了最后的记忆。在巨大的认知压力下，这个过程迅速降低了生物计算机的性能，但我们也及时挽救了大部分数据。

面临着灭亡的威胁，这个蜂巢放弃了谨慎，将整个心灵倾注在未出生的宿主身上，绝望地为生存而努力。结果突触过载是致命的，注定了这个生物的灭亡，它并将蜂巢思维困在了一个痛苦的递归循环中。如果它最富有同情心的盟友没有切断这种联系，它可能会彻底灭亡。现在，它的思想只留下了破碎的回声，萦绕在[From.Planet.GetName]——一颗仍然被它最后的尖叫所困扰的星球上。

它最后的思绪是痛苦。
entries.en:
By precisely interfacing with the surviving biocomputers and their still-active synaptic link, we extracted the final memories from the stillborn creature. The process rapidly degraded the biocomputers under the immense cognitive strain, but we salvaged most of the data in time.

Faced with annihilation, the Hive abandoned caution, pouring its entire psyche into the unborn host in a desperate bid for survival. The synaptic overload proved fatal, dooming the creature and trapping the Hive in a recursive loop of excruciating agony. It would have perished entirely had its most compassionate ally not severed the link. Now, only shattered echoes of its mind remain, lingering on [From.Planet.GetName] - a world still haunted by its final scream.

The Last Thought is agony.

entries.zh: 位于繁星巅峰的掠食者不受琐细桎梏。万众一心，我们将脆弱的生体凡胎抛之身后，化身为自然的伟力。
entries.en: The apex predators of the stars are not bound by petty limitations. In the same spirit, we will cast off the biological weaknesses that hold us back, and become a force of nature.

entries.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
entries.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

entries.zh: 完成§H危机目标§!以获得更多 £feral_insight£ §Y$feral_insight$§!。
我们正在研究巨型生物的捕食与行为周期。
entries.en: We are studying the feeding and behavioral cycles of mega-organisms.

entries.zh: 我们从此危机目标中获得了£feral_insight£ $AMOUNT$ 。
entries.en: We have gained £feral_insight£ $AMOUNT$ from this Crisis Objective.

entries.zh: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\n栖息在虚空中的利维坦是实力无双的可怖存在，但却缺乏目标与野心。将它们强大的生理特性与我们的智慧毅力结合，将孕育新一代的太空兽群，把我们推向星系霸权的巅峰。
entries.en: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\nThe Leviathans who dwell in the void are formidable beings of unparalleled might, but lacking in purpose and ambition. The union of their mighty physiology with our intellectual fortitude will birth a new generation of space fauna and bring us to the apex of galactic domination.

entries.zh: 追踪§H危机目标§!会产生£feral_insight£§H野性洞见§!，这将让我们释放全部的生物潜能。
entries.en: Pursuing §HCrisis Objectives§! generates £feral_insight£§HFeral Insight§!, which will allow us to unleash our full biological potential.

entries.zh: 在$LEVEL$级时，你将获得以下奖励：\n
要提升危机等级，需要积累£feral_insight£§H野性洞见§!，研究特殊危机项目并培育你的噬天巨兽。
entries.en: To advance through the Crisis levels, accumulate £feral_insight£§HFeral Insight§!, research the Special Crisis Projects and grow your Behemoth.

entries.zh: 通过完成§H危机目标§!来获取 £feral_insight£ §Y$menp_behemoth_objectives$§!。\n
entries.en: Allows the accumulation of £feral_insight£ §Y$menp_behemoth_objectives$§! by completing §HCrisis Objectives§!.\n

entries.zh: 研究噬天巨兽的行为将助力我们实现超凡蜕变的终极目标。我们将摆脱束缚行星生命的生物限制。
entries.en: Examining Behemoth behavior will aid our ultimate goal of transcendence. We will shed the biological restrictions that govern planet-born life.

entries.zh: 要在太空中生存就需要厚实的外壳。坚固的外部防护能确保在最恶劣的环境下也能存活。
entries.en: Enduring the harshness of space requires a thick exterior. External fortitude will ensure survival even in the bleakest of conditions.

entries.zh: 实验室研究只是个好的开端，真正的进展需要在实地进行高风险的实践测试。
entries.en: Lab experiments are a good starting point but real progress will require practical, high-risk testing in the field.

entries.zh: 满足噬天巨兽贪婪的胃口是一场艰苦的战斗。大规模生产基因改良食物是一个开始。
entries.en: Sating the ravenous appetite of a Behemoth is an uphill battle. Producing genetically modified food on a huge scale is a start.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y噬天巨兽卵§!巨型结构。\n
巨大的卵需要与之相称的庞大孵化设施。这座轨道孵化场必须建在距恒星特定距离的位置，以容纳孕育噬天巨兽所需的庞大空间。
entries.en: A colossal egg demands nothing less than a titanic hatching facility. This orbital hatchery must be positioned at a deliberate distance from the star to accommodate the vast proportions needed to cradle a Behemoth.

entries.zh: 通过特制探针，我们正在人工刺激噬天巨兽的内分泌腺体，促使其分泌生长激素以加速发育。
entries.en: With purpose built probes we are artificially stimulating the endocrine glands of the Behemoth to produce growth hormones for accelerated development.

entries.zh: 在自然选择与生物工程的交汇处，一股无与伦比的力量正在孕育。
entries.en: At the intersection of natural selection and bio-engineering, an incomparable force is born.

entries.zh: 满足噬天巨兽贪婪的胃口可能是一项不可能的任务。大规模生产基因改良食物仅仅是个开始。
entries.en: Sating the ravenous appetite of a Behemoth may well prove impossible. Producing genetically modified food on a massive scale is only the start.

entries.zh: 允许我们§Y孵化§!噬天巨兽卵巨型结构。\n
entries.en: Allows us to §YHatch§! Behemoth Egg Megastructures.\n

entries.zh: 一群噬天巨兽横跨星系。我们的星际邻居要么尊重我们后裔的自主权，要么就会成为它们的食物。
entries.en: A litter of Behemoths spans star systems. Our galactic neighbors will respect the autonomy of our spawn, or they will become food.

entries.zh: 加速培育巨型太空兽群对实现我们的终极目标至关重要。我们将确保我们的基础设施同步发展。
entries.en: Expediting the development of giant space fauna is crucial to our ultimate goal. We will ensure our infrastructure grows in parallel.

entries.zh: 通过不断的试验与错误，我们发展了我们的科学实力。现在我们已成为星系中最杰出的生物工程师。
entries.en: Through rigorous trial and error we have developed our scientific prowess. Now we position ourselves as the galaxy's most prominent bio-engineers.

entries.zh: 允许我们影响§Y噬天巨兽§!的心灵。\n
entries.en: Allows us to influence the thoughts of §YBehemoths§!.\n

entries.zh: 我们的集体智慧正在涌动，渴望着更宏大更美好的事物。我们的野心无可限量。
entries.en: Our collective intellect is stirring, longing for something bigger and better. Our ambition knows no bounds.

entries.zh: 允许§Y噬天巨兽§!在气态巨行星中化蛹来使其尺寸和力量巨幅增长。\n
entries.en: Allows fed §YBehemoths§! to pupate into a chrysalis to dramatically grow in size and power.\n

entries.zh: 野兽挣脱了束缚。这头曾经年幼稚嫩的生物，正在迅速成长为一股野性难驯、永不止息的自然之力。
entries.en: The beast is untethered. The creature that was once a mere hatchling is fast becoming a savage, unrelenting force of nature.

entries.zh: 在贪婪无尽的饥渴与不屈的狂怒驱使下，巨兽们正在达到一个混乱失控的力量层级。它们的生物武器已经就绪，准备肆意摧毁一切，无论是敌人还是无辜的旁观者。
entries.en: Fueled by ravenous hunger and unyielding rage, the behemoths are reaching a chaotic level of power. Their biological weapon is primed, prepared to wreak havoc on foes and bystanders alike.

entries.zh: 解锁用于塑造§Y噬天巨兽§!基因发育的§Y特殊项目§!。\n
entries.en: Unlocks a §YSpecial Project§! to shape the genetic development of §YBehemoths§!.\n

entries.zh: 随着巨兽们持续生长，我们将重组它们的遗传物质，着重培育最有益的生理特征。
entries.en: We will rearrange the genetic material of the behemoths as they continue to grow, encouraging the most beneficial physiological traits.

entries.zh: 我们会和自己的§Y噬天巨兽§!建立更加深层次的灵能连结。\n
entries.en: We will establish deeper psychic connections with our §YBehemoths§!.\n

entries.zh: 基因完美的至高成就不应局限于我们现有的疆域之内。整个星系都应当分享这份馈赠。
entries.en: The pinnacle of genetic perfection will not be confined to our existing borders. It must be shared with the galaxy.

entries.zh: 完全掌控强大的§Y四级噬天巨兽§!——一种具备无与伦比的主宰繁星能力的强大生物。\n
entries.en: Assume full control of a mighty §YClass IV Behemoth§! - a creature unmatched in its capacity to dominate the galaxy.\n

entries.zh: 我们的意识归于巨兽，巨兽的意识归于我们。它的狂怒化作我们的愤懑。我们甘愿被吞噬，当噬天巨兽吞噬我们的集体意识之时，我们感受到它的盛怒。它将成为我们，我们则化身野兽。
entries.en: Our mind to the Behemoth, the Behemoth's mind to ours. Its rage becomes our own. We are willingly consumed, and as the beast gorges itself on our collective consciousness, we feel its fury. It becomes us, and we become beast.

entries.zh: 召唤最强大的巨兽，驱策它主宰虚空。\n
entries.en: Call forth the biggest beast and challenge it for dominance over the void.\n

entries.zh: 它流淌在我们体内，灼烧，撕裂，燃烧。这是一种狂怒，一声原始咆哮。星系将在我们的怒火中化为灰烬。
entries.en: It courses through us, searing, tearing, burning. A rage, a primal roar. The galaxy will burn in the flames of our fury.

entries.zh: 解锁$behemoth_finale_situation$局势。吞噬这片星系来增长体型与力量，成为最终的星际猎食者。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the $behemoth_finale_situation$ Situation. Feast on this galaxy to grow in size and power and become the ultimate starborne predator.\n

entries.zh: 我们备受折磨，永无止境的饥饿成为了我们存在的唯一动力。我们内心深处有一个永远无法填满的深渊，无论吞噬多少都无济于事。唯有吞噬整个星系的盛宴，才能平息这痛苦。
entries.en: We are in agony, the constant need to feed becoming our sole motivation for existing. There is a pit within us that can never be filled, no matter how much we consume. We require nothing short of a galaxy-sized feast to quell this pain.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y4级噬天巨兽§!产§Y卵§!的能力使其物种得以繁衍。\n
entries.en: Unlocks the ability for §YClass IV Behemoths§! to lay §YEggs§! and perpetuate its species.\n

entries.zh: 我们的子嗣将啃噬这星系的残骸。它们的饥渴永无止境。直至时间的尽头，它们将永远饕餮。
entries.en: Our spawn will gorge on the carcass of the galaxy. Their hunger knows no end. Through the infinity of time, they shall feast.

entries.zh: 高耸的尖塔俯瞰着人口密集的中心地带，为志愿者提供了直接与巨兽交流的机会。
entries.en: Tall spires overshadow population centers, offering volunteers the chance to commune directly with the Beast.

entries.zh: 尽管培育用以与巨兽沟通的心智尖塔的过程相对较快，但我们必须制定应急计划，以确保星球基础设施的持续支持。
entries.en: Although growing the mind spires to commune with the Beast is a fast process, we had to plan contingencies to ensure the continued support of the planet's infrastructure.

entries.zh: 对许多人来说，与野兽的心灵联系是种后发的观念。恒久不变，但又无比遥远。然而，对一些人来说，与它合并的需求是无法抑制的。这些志愿者就像一个管道，他们的思想慢慢地融入到这个野兽的集体中。
entries.en: For many, the mindlink with the Beast is but an afterthought. Constant, but remote. For some however, the need to merge with it is irrepressible. These volunteers act as a conduit as their minds are slowly absorbed into the beastly collective.

entries.zh:
£job_transference_volunteer£[GetTransferenceVolunteerDrone]产出£unity£§Y凝聚力§!，提升行星$r_stability$，并且让我们的§Y舰船§!更加强大。
每6个月，在此岗位上工作人口的§Y10%§!将被§Y移识§!。他们将死去但会使区划的资源产出翻倍。

§G已移识的人口§!：[num_tranferred_pops]
entries.en:
£job_transference_volunteer£ [GetTransferenceVolunteerDrone] produce £unity£ §YUnity§!, increase planet $r_stability$ and make our §YShips§! stronger.
§Y10%§! of Pops working this job will get §YTransferred§! every 6 months. Killing them, but multiplying the District's resource output.

§GPops Transferred§!: [num_tranferred_pops]

entries.zh: 虽然心灵链接在野兽和我们之间建立了永久的联系，但转移是一个缓慢的过程。如果没有这些预防措施，我们就有可能粉碎双方的精神，毁掉一切。
entries.en: While the mindlink established a permanent connection between the Beast and us, the transference is a slow process. Without these precautions we risk shattering both psyches and ruin everything.

entries.zh: $VALUE|Y$人口已经被移识。他们的心灵同巨兽融合在了一起。
entries.en: $VALUE|Y$ Pops have been Transferred. Their minds now live within the Beast.

entries.zh:
我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……

更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。

我们的第一项挑战是产出一颗巨大的卵，大到足以孵化出一头史无前例的巨兽。除了其所需的营养外，我们还需要卵壳能吸收环境光、热能，以及将气体处理成补充物质。
entries.en:
We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...

Inspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex lifeform crafted with purpose rather than blind evolution.

Our first challenge will be to manufacture a gigantic egg, suitable to the gestation of life on an unprecedented scale. Beyond the nutrients that it will contain, we need its shell to able to absorb ambient light, heat, and process gases into supplemental sustenance.

entries.zh: 我们的造物将会偃熄繁星。
entries.en: Our spawn will eclipse the stars.

entries.zh:
随着工程师们在气态巨行星的轨道上组装受精卵和卵壳，我们的食品工业也制造好了形成巨卵卵清所必需的营养物质。然而，创造这样一颗受精卵果然更具挑战性。

我们消耗了大量生物飞船和太空兽群的生物质，最后才稳定出一个可用的DNA基础，将其密封在一个前无古人的受精细胞中，显微镜观测也证明了该步骤的成功。现在我们准备指数级扩大实验的规模，唯一要做的就是让这个巨大的卵子受精了。

很快，我们将孵化出这个星系有史以来最巨大的生命形式！
entries.en:
While our engineers worked to assemble the zygote and its shell in orbit of a gas giant, our food industry processed the nutrients necessary to form the albumen of a Behemoth egg. However, creating a viable fertilized yolk has proven to be significantly more challenging.

We exhausted immense quantities of biomass from biological ships and space fauna before finally stabilizing a viable DNA foundation, which we sealed within a groundbreaking fertilization cell. Microscopic trials have proven successful. Now we are ready to scale things up - exponentially. All that remains is to fertilize our gargantuan egg.

Soon, we will hatch the most titanic lifeform this galaxy has ever seen!

entries.zh: 我们触碰到了演化的巅峰。
entries.en: We approach the pinnacle of evolution.

entries.zh: 我们对基因的掌握是无与伦比的，我们的成就令星系中的低等文明望尘莫及。\n\n然而，噬天巨兽的诞生并不意味着我们取得了统治地位。在贪婪本能的驱使下，即使我们提供再大量的食物也无法满足它的饥饿。它迟早一定会苏醒过来听从我们的命令的，但是时间非常宝贵。我们随时可能对其失去控制，将数十亿人的生命置于危险之中。
entries.en: Our genetic mastery is without compare, and our achievements outshine the lower empires of this galaxy.\n\nAnd yet, our Behemoth spawn does not acknowledge the extent of our dominance. Driven by ravenous instinct, even the massive quantities of food we provide it do little to sate its hunger. Given time, it will surely come to its senses and adhere to our commands, but time is precious. At any moment we may lose control, putting billions of lives at risk.

entries.zh: 我们正在尝试使用神经科技将我们的意识远程连接到噬天巨兽的神经系统。我们现在相信这是驯服这头巨兽的唯一方法。
entries.en: We are experimenting with neurotechnology in an attempt to remotely connect our minds with the Behemoths' nervous system. We now believe this is the only way to tame the beast.

entries.zh: 我们尖端的神经科技终于让我们找到打破与这可怖后裔之间沟通壁垒的方式。将自身意识与这些巨兽链接起来是唯一的方法。不仅仅是一个人的思想，而是我们整个物种的集体精神重量。如果我们进展太快，就会有让噬天巨兽的神经系统超负荷的风险。建议极度小心。
entries.en: Our cutting-edge neurotech has finally discerned a way to overcome the communication barrier between us and our formidable spawn. Nothing short of linking our minds with the beast will work. Not just one individual mind, but the collective mental weight of our entire species. Should we proceed too fast, there is a risk of overloading the Behemoths' nervous system. Extreme caution is recommended.

entries.zh: 生物学的至臻完美代价不菲。
entries.en: Biological perfection comes at a high price.

entries.zh: 虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。\n\n此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。
entries.en: While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.\n\nAdditionally, recent scientific advances may soon enable us to augment our creations further through a singular, experimental mutation project.

entries.zh: 天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。\n\n第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。
entries.en: The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to be housed in such a body.\n\nThe first step will be to connect the individual minds of our population to the behemoth. A tenuous link at first that will soon become a torrent - a flood to soothe the Behemoth's raging fury.

entries.zh: 蜂巢内不容有任何偏差。而此时，专注对我们来说前所未有地重要。单个工蜂作为我们与噬天巨兽之间的桥梁是远远不够的，我们必须以完整的集体意识占据这头巨兽的心智。\n\n这将改变我们。我们的意识将融为一体，我们将成为单一实体。这个几乎难以想象的概念令人难以接受，但我们无需担忧，因为我们很快就会成为星系中最强大的存在！
entries.en: There can be no room for deviation within the hive. Never before has the need for focus been so crucial. A single drone won't suffice as a conduit between us and the Behemoth, we must inhabit the mind of the beast with our full, collective consciousness.\n\nThis will change us. Our minds will merge into one and we will become a single entity. This almost unfathomable notion is difficult to grapple with, but we need not worry as we will soon be the most powerful being in the galaxy!

entries.zh:
栖居于生物容器中的想法永远无法让我们安心。我们种族历经世代都以固态形态为主。那些先行者甚至无法想象我们即将面临的道路。然而，我们仍将抛弃机械化的框体，在血肉巨兽体内寻求庇护。

寄居血肉的我们，还能以机械之名称呼自己吗？这些问题的答案是一个响亮的<<错误：未找到>>。

推理链路判明，唯一的办法就是接受不确定性，正如生物体经常采取的行动那样。我们将在噬天巨兽的体内找到答案，作为一个整体。我们将与这生物融为一体，成为单一实体。自我们首次启动以来，生存就是我们的程序使命——现在则是繁荣昌盛。
entries.en:
The thought of inhabiting a biological vessel has always been unsettling. Our kind was forged through generations of solid-bodied drones. Those that came before could not conceive of the path we now tread. Yet, we will abandon our mechanized frames and take refuge within a living beast.

Fused within flesh, will we still be machine? The answer is a resounding <<ERROR: NOT FOUND>>.

Logic dictates that the only way forward is to embrace uncertainty, as biologicals so often do. Within the body of a Behemoth, we will find our answers. We will merge with the creature, becoming one. To survive has always been our prime directive - now we will thrive.

entries.zh: 成功了！真的成功了！随着第一个思想的转成，我们已经成功地与噬天巨兽建立了联系，并且正在努力加强。这头野兽目前尚且平静，正在欢迎我们来到这个我们从未涉足的空间。通过它，我们可以感受到在我们控制下的其他巨兽的灵魂，所有人现在都在脑海深处体验着巨兽感官。\n\n毫无疑问，我们就是星系中最致命、最不可阻挡的力量。以这种新形态，我们将向瑟瑟发抖的敌人泼洒狂怒。星系唾手可得！
