entries.en: It worked! It actually worked! We have established a link with the Behemoth and are working on reinforcing the connection as the first of our minds are transferred. The beast remains placid, welcoming us to a space beyond space that was ours all along. Through it, we can feel the spirit of every other beast under our control, and our entire population now experiences the magnitude of the Behemoth somewhere deep at the back of their minds.\n\nThere can be no mistaking that we are the deadliest and most unstoppable force in the galaxy. In our new form, we will rain fury upon our fearful foes. The galaxy itself is ours for the taking!

entries.zh: 我们已经转移了足够多的人口，现在可以直接控制噬天巨兽和它的肉体。巨兽继续成长，但它的基因潜力很大程度上仍未觉醒，只有通过稳定的心智和营养供应才能解锁。一种原始的愤怒在我们身上蔓延，我们的嗜血欲无止尽。我们必须进食，必须狼吞虎咽，我们要大快朵颐整个星系。\n\n让我们摆脱文明的束缚，像蜕去皮肤一样；现在最重要的是我们在星际间的生活。
entries.en: Enough of our population has been transferred, and we now have direct control over the Behemoth and its flesh. The Beast continues to grow, its genetic potential largely dormant, unlocked only through a steady supply of minds and nutrients. A primal rage now courses through us, and our bloodlust knows no bounds. We must consume. We must devour. We will gorge ourselves on the galaxy.\n\nLet us cast off the bonds of civilization like so much shed skin; all that matters now is our life amongst the stars.
We are too big to fail.

entries.zh: 我们的一头巨兽陨落了。这就是弱者的命运；自然会将它们淘汰。虽然我们不会为一头无法在战斗中自保的噬天巨兽哀悼，但我们最好将精力集中在确保它的同类不会遭遇相同的命运上。我们必须确保我们后裔的长存，否则我们也将陨落。
entries.en: One of our beasts has fallen. This is what happens to weak creatures; nature disposes of them. Although we do not mourn a Behemoth who could not prevail in battle, we would do well to focus our efforts on ensuring its siblings do not meet the same fate. We must ensure the longevity of our spawn, else we too will fall.
This death will not be in vain.

entries.zh:
尽管面临挑战，我们仍然孕育出了一头新的噬天巨兽，它破茧而出。

这是一头更为巨大凶猛而饥饿的噬天巨兽。这头生物现在正饥渴地在虚空中游荡，寻找养分。

这头巨兽是兽群的骄傲，将给所有胆敢挡路的人带来难以想象的毁灭。
entries.en:
Despite the challenges, we have birthed a Behemoth which now springs forth from the chrysalis where it was incubated.

Larger, fiercer and hungrier. The creature now prowls the void in search of sustenance.

This beast is the pride of the pack, and will bring untold destruction upon all who dare to cross its path.

entries.zh: 我们再次超越了自然的极限。
entries.en: We exceed nature's limits once more.

entries.zh:
似乎我们的飞升并不会如入无人之境。我们感知到[event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName]星系中那无法估量的存在。那是一只虚空孳孽，一种古老的怪物，其存在甚至超越了凡人野心所构建的最宏伟造物。

它那超乎常理的外形颠覆了传统的认知，将星系笼罩在一片阴沉的暮色之中，仿佛连星辰本身也在畏惧它的经过。

虚空孳孽的意图如同它的轨迹一样清晰——它为我们而来，为噬天巨兽而来，为那个敢于超越肉体、试图掌控虚空的集体意识而来。这并非仅仅是物质力量的对抗，而是对我们所成为之物的考验。

毫无疑问，如果现在冒然出战我们必死无疑。必须暂避锋芒、卧薪尝胆，直到我们的尖牙利齿长到足以洞穿一切为止。
entries.en:
It seems our ascension will not go unchallenged. We sense an incalculable mass in the [event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName] system. It is a Voidspawn, an ancient monstrosity whose presence dwarfs even the mightiest constructs of mortal ambition.

Its unearthly form defies conventional understanding, casting the galaxy into a grim twilight, as if the stars themselves feared its passage.

The Voidspawn's intent is as clear as its trajectory - it comes for us, our Behemoth body and the collective mind that dared to transcend flesh to claim dominion over the void. This is no mere confrontation of material power; it is a test of what we have become.

There is no doubt that if we were to fight now, we would die. We must evade it for now and keep growing in strength until our fangs grow sharp enough to pierce the unpierceable.

entries.zh: 我们躲得了一时，但躲不了一世。
entries.en: We can run, but we cannot hide.

entries.zh: 这是一条至关重要的信息。§Y$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$§!，一个拥有难以理解力量的实体，已从虚空的深处显现。它被[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]所吸引，这是一个超越生死、与野兽合二为一的帝国。这两大截然对立的巨擘，如今正威胁着整个星系。\n\n若噬天巨兽陨落，虚空孳孽或许会停下肆虐的脚步。若噬天巨兽获胜，它所掌控的力量可能会永远改变整个星系的平衡。做好准备吧，因为此刻的选择将塑造未来的永恒。
entries.en: This is a message of utmost importance. The §Y$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$§!, an entity of incomprehensible power, has emerged from the depths of the void. It is drawn to the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], an empire that has transcended mortality and become one with a beast. These two titans, diametrically opposed, now threaten the entire galaxy.\n\nShould the Behemoth fall, the Voidspawn may rest. Should the Behemoth prevail, the power it commands will shift the balance of the galaxy forever. Prepare yourselves, for the choices made now will shape the eons to come.

entries.zh: 你错了。“防范于未然”是那些“未然”的人才配关心的。我们已经没有这样的余裕了。\n\n巨兽已至。我们古老的秩序在过去经受住了灾难，但坦率地说：我们已经到了最危险的时刻。
entries.en: You misunderstand. Prevention is the concern of those who still have time. We no longer have such luxury.\n\nThe beast is here. Our ancient order has withstood calamity in the past, but speaking plainly: the situation in which we now find ourselves is critical.

entries.zh: 一个可以理解的问题。幼稚，但是可以理解。智慧带来接纳。而我们知道没有人会来救我们。\n\n我们的力量太小，能做的太少。你们本可以早点采取行动阻止这一切。如果你们现在没能打败[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，当星系分崩离析的时候，我们也会尽量不去反对你们。
entries.en: An understandable question. Naive, but understandable. With wisdom comes acceptance. We understand that nobody is coming to save us.\n\nOur order is small so there is little we could have done. You, however, could have acted sooner to stop this. Should you now fail to defeat the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], we will try not to hold that against you as the galaxy falls apart.

entries.zh: 帝国往往都有一种追求超出能力范围事物的倾向。特别是[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，选择了野心而非谨慎，傲慢而不明智。\n\n他们拥有自己无法理解的力量，强迫自己的身体变成自己无法控制的形态。在这过程中，他们很可能就注定了我们所有人的命运。
entries.en: Empires have a tendency to reach beyond their means. The [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName] in particular chose ambition over caution, and arrogance over wisdom.\n\nThey wielded powers beyond their comprehension, forced their bodies into forms they could not control. And in doing so, they have likely doomed us all.

entries.zh:
基于你们战斗能力的初步分析，我们觉得你们参战是不会有好结果的。然而逃跑也是徒劳，目前看来，这种局面无可避免。

两头可怖的巨兽摩拳擦掌要在星间大战一番。如果运气好的话，兴许能苟活下去。

如果明智点，就要从这件蠢事中吸取点教训。但要知道，当这场战争结束时，星系都将被改变。我们中是否有人还在这里看到它完全是另一回事了。

……假设，如果你试图拯救星系，杀死噬天巨兽可能会结束虚空孳孽的狩猎。
entries.en:
Based on initial analysis of your combat capabilities, we do not think fighting would end well for you. Assessments of your fleets indicate fleeing would be similarly futile. The present situation is unavoidable.

Two formidable beasts are squaring up to do battle across the stars. If you are fortunate, you may outlast them.

If you are wise, you will learn from this folly. But know this: when the battle ends, the galaxy will be changed. Whether any of us are still here to see it is another matter entirely.

... Hypothetically, if you were to attempt to save the galaxy, slaying the Behemoth may put an end to the Voidspawn's hunt.

entries.zh:
$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$已然降临我们的领域。这一远古实体据说无人能敌、不死不灭。它的眼中闪烁着玄秘的智慧，它的一举一动都牵动着纪元之重。

我们的[species.GetEyeNamePlural]中只有在重压下破碎的信号。混沌、扭曲以及最深层次的宇宙之怖在脑海深处回荡。

对我们来说，战胜这种野兽是不可想象的，但如果我们能帮助它杀死猎物，我们可能会阻止它的狂暴。找到§Y噬天巨兽§!并杀死它是我们生存的唯一机会。
entries.en:
An $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$ has crossed into our territory. This ancient entity is rumored to be immortal and invincible. Its eyes shimmer with alien intellect, and its movements ripple with the weight of eons.

Our [species.GetEyeNamePlural] are overwhelmed with fragmented signals. Chaos, distortion, and the deepest cosmic fear reverberate within us.

For us to prevail against such a beast is unthinkable, but we may yet halt its rampage if we can help it kill its prey. Finding the §YBehemoth§! and slaying it is our only shot at survival.

entries.zh: 不惜一切代价躲避怪兽！
entries.en: Avoid the monster at all costs!

entries.zh:
虚空孳孽已不复存在。一个令星辰相形见绌的庞然大物已被消灭。它那不属于这个位面的形态的残骸如今在虚空中漂流，渐渐化为乌有。

另一个帝国展示了我们难以想象的强大火力和协调能力。星海已不再是我们所认知的模样。力量的平衡已然改变，我们在其中的地位也随之动摇。

这些巨兽的猎杀者究竟为何而战？这究竟是一次向所有可能反对他们的人传递信息的力量展示，还是某种更为可怕之事的前奏？
entries.en:
The voidspawn is no more. An enormity that dwarfed the stars has been slain. The wreckage of its otherworldly form now drifts through the void, slowly dissipating into nothingness.

Another empire has demonstrated firepower and coordination beyond our wildest imagining. The galaxy is not as it seemed. The balance of power has shifted, as has our place within it.

What drives them, these slayers of beasts? Was this a show of strength, a message to all who would oppose them, or merely the prelude to something far worse?

entries.zh:
如果这个星系拥有能够摧毁$NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$的力量，那么它同样也能摧毁我们。我们与被消灭的巨兽并无太大区别。

那撕裂它古老躯体的火力，终有一日也可能转向我们。星系已经发生了变化，我们必须随之改变以求生存。

我们的生存不能只倚仗盲目的热血了。虚空已经见证了一个顶级掠食者的陨落，也许下一个也只是时间问题。
entries.en:
If this galaxy contains forces capable of destroying the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$, then it can also destroy us. We are not so different from the beast that was slain.

The same firepower that sundered its ancient flesh could one day be turned against us. The galaxy has shifted, and we must change to meet it.

Our survival will demand more than blind rage. The void has seen one apex predator fall. It may yet see another.

entries.zh: 最终，远古虚空孳孽的不灭神话终究还是在我们强大舰队的进攻下破灭了。解决了这个古老的威胁后，整个星系又一次沐浴在了自由的风中。
entries.en: In the end, the rumored invincibility of the elder Voidspawn turned out to be yet another myth, dispelled by the might of our fleets. With this ancient threat now dealt with, the galaxy may again breathe easy.

entries.zh: $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$已逝，其血肉中还跳动着残余的力量。它古老而而强大，对我们来说就是一场滋养潜能的盛宴。\n\n孳孽的筋肉和骨髓将被吞食，它的独特本质将与我们的融合在一起。虚空孳孽的力量很巨大，而现在就是我们的了。
entries.en: Though the $NAME_Boss_Voidspawn$ has perished, its body thrums with residual energy. Ancient and potent, to us it is a nourishing banquet of raw potential.\n\nThe sinews and marrow of the beast shall be consumed, its alien essence entwined with our own. The Voidspawn's power was immense, and now, it is ours to wield.

entries.zh: 在虚空的彼端，一个可怕的启示出现了：我们并非独自飞升。另一只噬天巨兽出现了，这只模仿者膨胀着怪诞的威严，妄图匹敌我们的完美。这是不能容忍的。\n\n一宇不容二兽。没有和平可言，只有血肉的盛宴。狩猎开始了。
entries.en: Across the void, a dreadful revelation: we are not alone in our ascension. Another Behemoth has emerged, the imitator swollen in grotesque majesty, looking to emulate our perfection. This cannot stand.\n\nThere is no room for another apex predator. There is no peace to be made. Only flesh to be devoured. The hunt begins.
We shall feast on its heart!

entries.zh:
虚空的深处有什么在搅动着。

在繁星彼端，一个帝国开始了怪诞变异的最终阶段，孵育着一只可怖的噬天巨兽，它不仅仅是一件武器而是一个容器。他们不再寻求疆域统治，而是要凝聚为一。将意识和血肉融合，将帝国和恐惧同化。

如果他们成功了，他们将不再是一群人，而是某种单一而巨大的饥饿化身。

这是绝不可容忍的。如果想要阻止他们，那就只能是现在，赶在他们跨过最终阈值之前。
entries.en:
Something stirs in the depths of the void.

Across the stars, an empire has begun the final stage of its grotesque transformation, breeding monstrous Behemoths, not as mere weapons, but as vessels. They do not seek dominion. They seek union. A merging of mind and flesh, of empire and horror.

If they succeed, they will cease to be a people and instead become a singular, vast hunger.

This cannot be allowed. If they are to be stopped, it must be done now, before the final threshold is crossed.

entries.zh:
最后的障碍已被扫除。伪装者，挑战者，低等生物的绝望挣扎全都陷入了沉默。群星本身也在颤抖，因为我们正站在真正蜕变的边缘。

我们摆脱先祖们脆弱形体的束缚。行星是牢笼，帝国稍纵即逝。个体的幻觉很快就会融为庞然大物中巨大而完美的统一。思想和恐惧，智力和饥饿，合为一体。

转移即将完成。当它完成时，我们将不复存在。

但我们将永远存在。
entries.en:
The last obstacles have been swept aside. The pretenders, the challengers, the desperate thrashing of lesser beings: all silenced. The stars themselves tremble, for we stand upon the precipice of true becoming.

We are no longer bound by the fragile forms of our ancestors. Planets are cages. Empires are fleeting. The illusion of individuality will soon dissolve into the vast, perfect unity of the Behemoth. Mind and horror, intellect and hunger, one.

The transference is almost over. When it is done, we shall no longer merely exist.

We shall thrive.

entries.zh: 我们会在30天后赢得游戏
entries.en: We'll win the game in 30 days

entries.zh: 先等等，我们还没有准备好。
entries.en: Hold on, we're not ready yet.

entries.zh: 我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。
entries.en: We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the chains of flesh and gravity.

entries.zh:
融合完成了！

我们不再是过去的我们，也不再被低等生物的限制所束缚。我们是思想和饥饿的交织体，是跨越虚空的巨大意志。

星系在我们脚下，脆弱而短暂。但我们也已超越了统治。我们自由了。可以流连于此，可以自由离开，可以自由狩猎。

我们要以新获得的永生做些什么呢？
entries.en:
The merging is complete!

We are no longer what we were, nor bound by the limits of lesser creatures. We are thought and hunger intertwined, a vast will stretching across the void.

The galaxy lies beneath us, fragile and fleeting. But we are beyond mere dominion. We are free. Free to linger. Free to depart. Free to hunt.

What shall we do with our newfound eternity?

entries.zh: 暂时在这汪星系中逗留。
entries.en: Linger in this galaxy... for now.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽会作为野生生物留存，不再可游玩。
entries.en: The Behemoths will remain as wild creatures and will no longer be playable.

entries.zh: 离开。虚空正在召唤我们继续前进。
entries.en: Leave. The void beckons us onward.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽帝国将从星系中消失，不再可游玩。
entries.en: The Behemoth Empire will disappear from the galaxy and will no longer be playable.

entries.zh: 所谓的猎人该学会什么叫真正的恐惧了。
entries.en: The so-called Hunters will learn true fear.

entries.zh:
完成了。[behemoth_winner.GetName]超越了血肉，超越了帝国，也超越了一切能被称为文明的东西。它不再是个国家，它是力量的本身。

星球在它面前吹弹可破，舰队化为齑粉。坚固的最终避难所像灰烬一样吹散到虚空。没有外交，没有抗辩，没有最后的立场。

我们不是为了生存而战。我们只是在推迟灭亡。末日来了。
entries.en:
It is over. The [behemoth_winner.GetName] has ascended beyond flesh, beyond empire, beyond anything that could be called civilization. It is no longer a nation. It is a force.

Worlds crumble before it. Fleets burn. The final refuges of the once-mighty scatter like embers in the void. There is no diplomacy, no plea, no final stand.

We are not fighting for survival. We are only delaying consumption. The end has come.
[behemoth_winner.GetName] is about to win the game

entries.zh: 数年前，噬天巨兽及其族群逃离了我们的星系。我们如释重负地看着这头本可能毁灭我们的野兽消失在无星的虚空之中。然后……无事发生。跨越了数十万光年之后，它就这么消失了。没有辐射，没有残影，没有引力涟漪。仿佛它从未存在过。
entries.en: Years ago, the Behemoth and its kin fled our galaxy. We watched on with relief as the beast that could have ended us vanished into starless void. And then... nothing. After crossing hundreds of thousands of lightyears, it simply disappeared. No radiation. No afterimage. No gravitational ripple. As if it had never existed at all.

entries.zh: 我们必须弄清楚这件事。

揭秘噬天巨兽的命运耗费了数年时间，而我们至今仍一无所知。由于没有超空间航道能够到达那里，我们只能依靠理论和近乎疯狂的科学来猜测它生命最后时刻发生了什么。

这只生物毫无畏惧，一味地继续飞翔。然后，转瞬之间，它的身形扭曲，像扭曲的布料一样向内盘旋，最终消失了。没有挣扎，没有踪迹。

各种理论层出不穷：是新的超光速方式？或是隐藏到了深空裂缝或异常现象中？或者更令人担忧的是，被某种外部力量吞噬，化为乌有？无论真相如何，它都远远超出了我们的认知范围……甚至可能超出了我们的理解范围。
entries.en:
Uncovering the Behemoth's fate took years, and we're still in the dark. With no Hyperlanes reaching that far, we relied on theory and half-mad science to guess what happened in its final moments.

The creature showed no fear. It simply flew on. Then, in an instant, its form warped, spiraling inward like twisted fabric, and vanished. No struggle. No trace.

Theories abound: a new form of FTL? Hidden by a deep-space rift or an anomaly? Or more concerning, folded into inexistence by an exterior power? Whatever the truth, it lies far beyond our reach... and possibly our comprehension.
Perhaps it is best not to think about it.

entries.zh: 我们捕获的索林原虫变得焦躁不安。
噬天巨兽的最终痛苦无法忍受。有过多的自我存在于这只巨兽当中，它意识的回响逐渐消逝时，我们也一同凋亡。
entries.en: The final agony of the Behemoth proves unbearable. Too much of us is inside of the creature, and as the echoes of its consciousness fade, so do we.

entries.zh:
噬天巨兽死了。

它硕大无朋的躯体静静地飘在虚空中，有如一座纪念碑，诉说着我们的胜利，也记录着理解的边际。[Root.GetScientistPluralCapital]争先恐后地分析它的残骸，渴望从它那不可思议的心灵中攫取秘密。然而，每一次复活的尝试——无论是机器、死灵术，或是最绝望的祈祷——都失败了。

原因现在已经非常清楚了：巨兽的大脑不仅仅是一个细胞网络，而是一个有机超导体晶格，以任何已知智能——人工智能、生物智能或奥术智能——都无法复制的方式交织在一起。它死后，神经结构如同破损得无法修复的电路一样崩溃。没有能量，没有意志，没有力量可以重新组装这种逝去之物。

星系中最具力量的意识现在、永远陷入了沉默。
entries.en:
The Behemoth is dead.

Its titanic form drifts lifelessly in the void, a monument to both our triumph and the limits of comprehension. [Root.GetScientistPluralCapital] scrambled to analyze its remains, eager to plunder the secrets of its impossible mind. Yet every attempt to revive it - by machine, necromancy, or even the most desperate invocations failed.

The reason has now become painfully clear: The Behemoth's brain was not merely a network of cells but a lattice of organic superconductors, interwoven in ways no known intelligence - artificial, biological, or arcane - can replicate. In death, its neural structure collapsed like a circuit shattered beyond repair. No energy, no will, no force can reassemble what has been lost.

The greatest mind in the galaxy is now, and forever, silent.

entries.zh: 从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。
entries.en: Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further biological enhancements.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。
entries.en: After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.

超尺寸肌肉，为摧毁性攻击而生。
entries.en: Oversized muscles make for devastating attacks.

entries.zh: 辐射合成遗传菌株注入我们的太空生命体，大大减少了它对食物的需求。
entries.en: The radiotrophic genetic strain injected into our spaceborne lifeforms significantly reduces their need for sustenance.

entries.zh: 更强大的亚空间腺体让我们的噬天巨兽更加灵巧。
entries.en: A more powerful set of subspace glands makes our behemoths more nimble.

entries.zh: 这种多眼适应力能在难以置信的远距离进行高精度射击。
entries.en: This multi-ocular adaptation allows for high precision shots at incredible distances.

entries.zh: 将合金和壳聚糖融合创造出多层甲壳可以保护关键器官的安全。
entries.en: Melding alloys and chitin creates a multilayered carapace that will keep vital organs safe.

entries.zh: 我们的股东对噬天巨兽项目有点心醉神迷，增加的股息很快赢得了他们的支持。
entries.en: Our shareholders were a little preoccupied with the Behemoth Project, but the increased dividends quickly won them over.

entries.zh: 尽管噬天巨兽并不连通虚境，但我们已经将其培养到足以接受自己的心灵感应，因此它也可以利用防御性灵能屏障。
entries.en: While behemoths are not connected to the Shroud, we have raised them to be receptive enough to our telepaths that they can utilize defensive psionic barriers.

entries.zh: 巨兽啊，请带上我们的力量！
为了驾驭噬天巨兽的愤怒之力，我们要发展有史以来最先进的义体件。
entries.en: To harness the furious power of behemoths, we will develop the most advanced piece of cyberware to ever exist.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽强化：纳米机器人
向噬天巨兽的甲壳注入纳米机器人可以在前所未有的短时间内恢复最严重的损伤。
entries.en: Nanite infused behemoth shells can regenerate even the worst damage in record time.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽强化：活体金属
在壳聚糖层之间铺设活体金属创造出具有更强烧蚀性能的反应装甲。
entries.en: Layering living metal between chitin layers creates reactive armor with enhanced ablative properties.

entries.zh: 用螺栓将合金板固定在外壳上虽然粗糙，但是高效。
entries.en: Bolting alloy plates on carapaces is crude but efficient.

entries.zh: 我们已经开发了几种诱变配方来增强我们的噬天巨兽，每一种都是量身定制的，可以解锁新的力量和适应性。然而，它庞杂的生理机能只能承受一次注射——任何结合多种配方的尝试都会导致灾难性的细胞衰竭。进化和毁灭之间的界限很薄，我们必须明智地选择强化的方式。
entries.en: We have developed several mutagenic formulas designed to enhance our Behemoths, each tailored to unlock new strengths and adaptations. However, their immense physiology can only withstand a single injection - any attempt to combine multiple formulas results in catastrophic cellular failure. The line between evolution and annihilation is razor-thin, and we must choose our enhancements wisely.
The power of the Shroud will sustain them.

entries.zh: 我们的噬天巨兽有§G25%§!概率抵御暴怒。\n在暴怒时，获得§G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_fire_rate_mult|0%$§!射速、§G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_shield_penetration_add|0%$§!装甲穿透和§G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_armor_penetration_add|0%$§!护盾穿透
entries.en: Our Behemoths gain a §G25%§! chance to resist their rage.\nWhile raging, they get §G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_fire_rate_mult|0%$§! Fire Rate, §G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_shield_penetration_add|0%$§! Armor Penetration and §G+$@behemoth_cyber_rage_armor_penetration_add|0%$§! Shield Penetration

entries.zh: 见鬼去吧。让我们卖点毛绒周边！
entries.en: To hell with this. Make plushies instead!

entries.zh:
解锁以下三种§Y噬天巨兽强化§!法令

在掌握了生物舰船的培育技术后，我们进一步优化并扩展了这些流程。这种持续的共生关系带来了日益显著的优势，增强了我们的舰队实力，并巩固了我们对生命宇宙的统治。
entries.en: Having mastered the cultivation of biological ships, we now refine and expand these processes. This ongoing symbiosis yields ever-greater perks, enhancing our fleets and bolstering our dominion over the living cosmos.

entries.zh: 在掌握了太空兽群的培育技术后，我们进一步优化并扩展了这些流程。这种持续的共生关系带来了日益显著的益处，增强了我们的舰队实力，并巩固了我们对生命宇宙的统治。
entries.en: Having mastered the breeding of Space Fauna, we now refine and expand these processes. This ongoing symbiosis yields ever-greater perks, enhancing our fleets and bolstering our dominion over the living cosmos.

entries.zh: 敌人的生物舰船干扰了我们的主导一切生命的大业。我们必须果断行动摧毁它们，以消除其对我们的霸权构成的威胁。
entries.en: Enemy biological ships interfere with our biological dominance. We must act decisively, destroying them to neutralize their threat to our supremacy.

entries.zh: 敌对的太空兽群威胁我们的主导一切生命的大业。我们必须果断行动，消灭它们以消除其对我们的霸权构成的威胁。
entries.en: Hostile Space Fauna threatens our biological dominance. We must act decisively, destroying them to neutralize their threat to our supremacy.

entries.zh: 未驯化的太空兽群是一种失控元素，构成独特的挑战。我们必须果断行动，捕获这些生命体，以利用它们的潜力，确保我们的主导地位。
entries.en: Untamed Space Fauna act as rogue elements, posing a unique challenge. We must act decisively, capturing these entities to exploit their potential in order to ensure our supremacy.

entries.zh: 培育超大的兽卵是我们超越行星生活琐事的关键一步。
entries.en: Growing supersized zygotes is a crucial step in our elevation beyond the trivialities of planet-based life.

entries.zh: 在浩瀚的宇宙中，一种庞大的生命体正在我们谨慎的引导下逐渐成形。这些噬天巨兽，源于我们的雄心与掌控力，将成为重塑力量平衡的巨擘，使局势朝着有利于我们的方向转变。
entries.en: In the vastness of space, colossal lifeforms are taking shape under our watchful guidance. These behemoths, born of our ambition and mastery, will emerge as titanic forces, reshaping the balance of power in our favor.

entries.zh: 我们的噬天巨兽被释放于星辰之间，以原始的狂怒肆虐，所过之处皆成废墟。它们那不受控制的愤怒是我们力量的明证，如同自然之力，仅在我们选择施加意志时，才听从我们的号令。
entries.en: Unleashed upon the stars, our Behemoths rampage with primal fury, leaving devastation in their wake. Their uncontrolled wrath is a testament to our power, a force of nature that answers only to our will, when we choose to exert it.

entries.zh: 某种东西在涌动。我们内心的饥饿并非盲目的原生欲望，而是具有某种适应性。新的事物悄然出现，充满潜力的脉动。\n\n
entries.en: Something stirs. The hunger within us is not mindless, but adaptive. New growths slither into existence, pulsing with potential.\n\n

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的卵是我们血脉延续的根本。我们必须不惜一切代价保护并照料它们。让我们引导进化，以造福未来的幼年体。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Our eggs are the literal lifeblood of our lineage. They must be protected and cared for at all costs. Let us guide our evolution to benefit our future hatchlings.

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$在恒星风浪中游弋并穿越虚空，是仅有少数太空物种才所掌握的技能。我们的战术优势在于我们的愤怒与力量，但如果我们的机动性能够提升，又会有怎样一番天地呢？
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Swimming the solar waves and traversing the void is a skill possessed by few spacefaring species. Our tactical strengths lie in our fury and our might, but what if our mobility could be improved?
Become a hunter in the dark.

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$加强我们的生物防御将使我们能够承受敌人的持续火力，而不致遭受恼人的伤害。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Bolstering our biological defenses will allow us to endure sustained fire from our enemies, without suffering pesky injuries.

entries.zh: 我们可以进一步加厚皮肤。
我们的战斗装甲将会变得更加坚硬。
如果我们增强自身护盾，就没人能够触及我们。
entries.en: Nobody can touch us if we enhance our shields.

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$与敌人交战是我们征服的手段。我们应当有机会提升我们的战斗能力。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Engaging our enemies is the means by which we will conquer. We have an opportunity to enhance our combat capabilities.

entries.zh: 只要能量足够没有穿透不了的护盾。
entries.en: With enough energy, shields can be ignored.

entries.zh: 无论再厚的装甲我们的射弹都能穿透。
entries.en: Our projectiles shall penetrate the thickest armor.

entries.zh: 我们的§Y$behemoth_04$§!获得$@behemoth_tracking_add|0*+$$MOD_SHIP_TRACKING_ADD$、$@behemoth_point_defense_weapon_fire_rate_mult|%0+$$mod_weapon_type_point_defense_weapon_fire_rate_mult$以及£rare_crystals£$@behemoth_tracking_upkeep|0*-$每月维护费。
$biocrisis.210.desc.base$在激烈的战斗中，每一秒都至关重要。我们所造成的伤害是一种死亡仪式，是敌人在他们渺小的生命消逝之前所经历的最后时刻。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$In the heat of battle, every second counts. The damage we inflict is a death rite, the last thing our enemies experience before their puny lives are extinguished.

entries.zh: 将他们钉在原地。他们将体验到我们的毁灭力量。
entries.en: Hold them in place. They will experience us.

entries.zh: 利用战略对他们分割击破。
$biocrisis.210.desc.base$作为星系中的一支坚定力量，我们将从提升的耐久方面获益良多。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$As a stalwart force in the galaxy, we will benefit from increased endurance.

entries.zh: 组织再生赋予我们长寿。
蛮荒之力是唯一的途径。
entries.en: Brute force is the only way.

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们的后代将如潮水般涌出，我们将肆虐行星，掠夺恒星系中一切可食之物，而大多数存在皆属此类。我们必须自问，如何才能最好地支持我们的后代？
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Swarming with our spawn, we will ravage planets and strip systems of anything edible, which is most things. We must ask ourselves, how best could we support our progeny?

entries.zh: 我们应让它们行动迅捷。
entries.en: We will allow them to be fast.

entries.zh: 它们将在我们的光芒中集结。
entries.en: They will rally in our light.

entries.zh: 我们将帮助它们变得强壮。
entries.en: We will help them be strong.

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们无可撼动的力量必须向星系中的所有居民展示。我们将通过进化的下一步来提升我们的战斗技能。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$Our unrelenting strength must be demonstrated for all who dwell within this galaxy. We will enhance our combative skills with the next step in our evolution.
Upon entering combat, our §Y$behemoth_04$§! gains §Y$behemoth_frenzy_modifier$§! for £time£ §Y$@behemoth_frenzy_duration|0$ Days§!.\n\n§Y$behemoth_frenzy_modifier$§!:$behemoth_frenzy_modifier_tt$

entries.zh: 引导我们的愤怒激励周围者。
entries.en: Channel our fury to inspire those around us.

entries.zh: 交战时，我们的§Y$behemoth_04$§!给予恒星系内所有友方生物舰船§Y$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$§!，持续£time£§Y$@behemoth_inspiration_duration|0$天§!\n\n§Y$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$§!：$behemoth_inspiration_modifier_tt$
entries.en: Upon entering combat, our §Y$behemoth_04$§! grants §Y$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$§! for £time£ §Y$@behemoth_inspiration_duration|0$ Days§! to Every Friendly Biological Ship in this System.\n\n§Y$behemoth_inspiration_modifier$§!:$behemoth_inspiration_modifier_tt$

entries.zh: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$我们可以释放毁灭性的低温碎屑波和高温碎屑波的，其威力足以将现实撕作碎片。简而言之，我们培育了一种能撕裂星系的基本构成的武器。\n\n但我们的通知不会至于毁灭。我们感受得到巨兽的每根肌腱，每一次脉搏，每一块巨大的肌肉都屈从于我们的意志，就像是我们自己的肉体一样。我们只需动动脑子，就能指挥它那庞大的身躯：它的四肢，它的巨口，它那巨大的宇生之心随我们的意图而跳动。这不仅仅是一个容器；我即是巨兽。
entries.en: $biocrisis.210.desc.base$We can now unleash a catastrophic wave of cryoclastic and pyroclastic fury, powerful enough to tear reality asunder. In short, we wield a weapon that will scorch the galaxy itself.\n\nBut our dominion does not end with destruction. We feel the Behemoth's every sinew, its every pulse, each titanic muscle bending to our will as if it were our own flesh. With a mere thought, we command its vast form: its limbs, its maw, the titanic void-born heart that beats with our intent. This is no mere vessel; we are the Behemoth now.

entries.zh: 一个巨大的有机容器，其中孵育着一只§Y噬天巨兽§!。
entries.en: A giant organic vessel bearing a gestating §YBehemoth§!.

entries.zh: 这个结构支持着§Y噬天巨兽卵§!的发育。
entries.en: This structure supports the development of §YBehemoth eggs§!.

entries.en: Initiate the birth of a new §YBehemoth§!.

entries.zh: §Y噬天巨兽§!诞生后只剩下这些残骸。
entries.en: Debris is all that remains after the birth of a §YBehemoth§!.

entries.en: Must be built around a §YGas Giant§!
Can not be built around Black Holes

entries.zh: 该恒星系内已经有另一个§Y蛹§!了。
entries.en: There is already another §YChrysalis§! in the system.

entries.zh: 这颗星球已成熟，可供我们享用。将其整个吞噬将为我们提供充足的养分。其上的居民不过是我们盛宴中的调味品。
entries.en: This planet is ripe for consumption. Eating it whole will nourish us well. The population is little more than a condiment to our feast.

Increase your §YGrowth Factor§! by:
- Killing other §YBehemoths§!, §YLeviathans§! or §YBiological Ships§!

- Eating £pop£ §HPops§!.

entries.zh:
生长因数用于衡量你的噬天巨兽吸收的营养物质数量，并影响局势的进展速度。

每月减少§R0.75%§!

$behemoth_finale_situation_monthly_change_tooltip$

每$pop_group_unit$£pop£§H被转化人口§!的最小值等于§G0.5%§!。
entries.en:
Growth Factor is a measure of the quantity of nutrients absorbed by your Behemoth, and affects how fast the situation will progress.

Every month, it decreases by §R0.75%§!

$behemoth_finale_situation_monthly_change_tooltip$

The Minimum Value is equal to §G0.5%§! per $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HTransferred Pops§!.

entries.zh: 我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。\n\n我们当前的['concept_growth_factor']为：§G[growth_factor_value]%§!
entries.en: It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.\n\nOur current ['concept_growth_factor'] is: §G[growth_factor_value]%§!
Recharge by taking a short rest.

entries.zh: 我们的怒火必须得到满足。

我们会有机会战胜§Y远古虚空孳孽§!！

$behemoth_superweapon_tt$
entries.en:
We will stand a fighting chance against the §YElder Voidspawn§!!

$behemoth_superweapon_tt$

entries.zh: 选择一个强力的噬天巨兽升级。
选择一个噬天巨兽升级。
这些巨兽在静止时看似平静，但实际上远非如此，接近它们时必须格外小心。
entries.en: While at rest, these giants appear almost peaceful. But they are far from it, and should be approached with caution.

entries.zh: §R唤醒这些怪兽多半不会一帆风顺§!
entries.en: §RWaking the Kaijus is unlikely to end well§!

entries.zh: 毁灭席卷了这些城市，将骄傲的尖塔和繁华的街道化为死寂的尘埃。
entries.en: Destruction has ravaged these cities, reducing proud spires and bustling streets to lifeless dust.

entries.zh: 整个生物圈已被彻底吞食殆尽。
entries.en: Entire biospheres have been completely consumed.

entries.zh: 让幼体着陆以吞噬行星生物质。
entries.en: Land hatchlings to devour planetary biomass.

entries.zh: 这些庞然巨影凌驾于大多数城市之上，遮蔽了太阳，其脚步之声震撼大地。
entries.en: Towering larger than most cities, these colossal silhouettes can blot out the sun. The steps of these monsters truly make the ground shake.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽的外甲壳由纳米结构的晶格组成。在气态巨行星内部的高压下形成种子晶体之后，这种有机结构就会自我修复，而且非常耐用。
entries.en: The exterior carapace of the Behemoth consists of a crystalline lattice of nanostructures. Once a seed crystal has formed under the intense pressure inside a gas giant, this organic structure is self-healing and incredibly durable.

entries.zh: 随着和野兽之间联系的加深，我们学会了如何控制它的每一块肌肉和腺体，完全将这具身躯为我们所用。
entries.en: As the bond between the Beast and us deepens, we learn how to control its every muscles and glands and fully appropriate this body four ourselves.

entries.zh: 我们已经解锁了以下噬天巨兽升级：\n\n[GetBehemothEggUpgrade][GetBehemothMobilityUpgrade][GetBehemothTank1Upgrade][GetBehemothDamageUpgrade][GetBehemothDamageAbilityUpgrade][GetBehemothTank2Upgrade][GetBehemothSupportUpgrade][GetBehemothRoleUpgrade][GetBehemothUltUpgrade]

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽是任性的、桀骜不驯的，不会忍受长久的控制。迟早，他们内心的愤怒就会点燃，化为一场无法克制的宇宙风暴。也许智慧不在于等待，而在于我们自己划燃烧火柴。要让我们选择释放风暴，而不是让风暴降临到我们头上。
entries.en: Behemoths are willful, untamed titans, and they do not suffer control for long. Sooner or later, the fury within will ignite, a cosmic tempest beyond restraint. Perhaps wisdom lies not in waiting, but in striking the match ourselves, unleashing the storm when we choose, rather than when it chooses us.

entries.zh:
§H激怒§!

释放§Y噬天巨兽§!。
狂暴的噬天巨兽将冲向最近的§Y殖民地§!或§Y噬天巨兽卵§!并试图摧毁它。
狂暴状态通常持续§Y180天§!，但多种因素可能影响其持续时间。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—在§R战斗§!或§R轰炸§!中，巨兽不会平静下来。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—如果我们在战斗中§G击败§!狂暴的噬天巨兽，它将重新回到我们的控制之下。
entries.en:
§HEnrage§!

Let loose the §YBehemoth§!.
The raging Behemoth will head towards the closest §YColony§! or §YBehemoth Egg§! and attempt to destroy it.
Rage normally lasts §Y180 days§!, but several factors can affect that duration.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- While in §RCombat§! or §RBombarding§!, a Behemoth will not calm down.$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- If we §GDefeat§! a raging Behemoth in combat, it will return under our control.

entries.zh: 一只噬天巨兽陷入了狂暴状态！我们希望它能在几个月内平静下来。
entries.en: A Behemoth has entered a frenzied fury! We hope it will calm down in a few months.

entries.zh: 一只噬天巨兽已经平静下来，重新回到了我们的控制之下。
entries.en: A Behemoth has calmed down and returned under our control.

entries.zh: §Y噬天巨兽§!能够在气态巨行星的湍流层中锚定自身，从其富含重元素和复杂分子化合物的稠密大气中汲取养分。随着时间的推移，这些营养物质促进了它们的生长，并进一步增强了它们本已巨大的力量。
entries.en: §YBehemoths§! can anchor themselves within the turbulent layers of a gas giant, drawing sustenance from its dense atmospheres rich in heavy elements and complex molecular compounds. Over time, this nourishment fuels their growth and fortifies their immense strength.

entries.zh: 一头吃饱了的§Y噬天巨兽§!可以巢居气态巨行星§Y3年§!，演变成更加强大的生命形式。
entries.en: A fully fed §YBehemoth§! can nest into a Gas Giant for §Y3 years§! to morph into an even stronger lifeform.
§RWe need to unlock the §H$menp_behemoth_hatchling_2$§! Crisis Perk.§!

entries.zh: 我们成功孵化并培育出了一只更大、更强的§Y噬天巨兽§!。
entries.en: We have succeeded in incubating and hatching a larger and even mightier §YBehemoth§!.

entries.zh: 我们的一头噬天巨兽正在§H[incubation_planet.GetName]§!气态巨行星中孵化。我们预计它会在§H[incubation_planet.behemoth_incubation_timer]§!后完全成熟。
entries.en: One of our Behemoths is incubating in the §H[incubation_planet.GetName]§! Gas Giant. We expect it to be fully matured on the §H[incubation_planet.behemoth_incubation_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 一场强大的蜕变正在进行中。
据说成熟的虚空孳孽从未被击败过。阻止它的最好办法是瞄准它的猎物。
entries.en: It is said that no mature Voidspawn has ever been felled. Our best shot at stopping it is to target its prey.

entries.zh: 星球在远古虚空孳孽的阴影下溃烂。
entries.en: Worlds fester under the shadow of the Elder Voidspawn.

entries.zh: 有一只巨大的虚空孳孽正在星系中横冲直撞。它想要猎杀巨型生物，如果我们替它解决了这些目标，它可能就会放过我们。\n\n目标：寻找并消灭星系中所有四级噬天巨兽。
entries.en: There's a big voidspawn plowing through the galaxy. It wants to kill big behemoths and presumably, if we kill them for it, it might leave us alone.\n\nOBJECTIVE: Find and Kill all tier 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.

entries.zh:
随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。

§H目标§!：
—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。
—完成生长痛局势
—击杀远古虚空孳孽
entries.en:
With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush any would be contender, whomever they may be.

§HOBJECTIVES§!:
- Find and Kill any other class 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.
- Complete the Growing Pains situation.
- Slay the Elder Voidspawn.

entries.zh: 如今，野兽与我们人群之间存续的联系为栖居与行星之上的文明投射了新的曙光。与融入野兽相比，这种生存显得徒劳无益。如今，每个人都渴望与野兽合为一体，并感到……无比饥渴。
entries.en: The link that now exists between the Beast and our population casts a new light over planetbound existence. One of futility compared to becoming one with the beast. Everyone now craves unity in the Beast, and is feeling... ravenous.

entries.zh: 对暴怒噬天巨兽的伤害
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§R他们是§Y巨兽天灾§!！他们为一己欢愉肆虐虚空。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThey are a §YBehemoth Crisis§!! They roam the void as they please.§!

entries.zh: 几乎无敌的怪物，拥有不死之心。它邪恶的律动抵挡了我们的攻击，迫使我们陷入疯狂攻击状态。
entries.en: The undying heart of an almost invincible monster. Its unholy rhythm repels our blows, and drives us into a frenzy of mindless aggression.

entries.zh: 随着噬天巨兽吞噬舰船、太空兽群或轰炸中吞噬人口增长。
entries.en: Growth increases as the Behemoth consumes bioships, space fauna, or Pops during bombardment.

entries.zh: 消耗库存的生物质来滋养巨兽，提升其力量，解锁新的能力。\n
entries.en: Consume stored biomass to grow the Behemoth, increasing its power and unlocking new abilities.\n

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽通过代谢储存的生物质长成更强大的形体。每个成长阶段都会提升力量，解锁特质，并使星系更接近毁灭。
entries.en: The Behemoth metabolizes stored biomass to grow into a more powerful form. Each stage of growth can enhance its combat abilities, unlock new traits, and brings the galaxy one step closer to ruin.

entries.zh: 噬天巨兽长时间不进食时，它的攻击性会增加。
entries.en: The Behemoth's aggression increases when it goes unfed for too long.

entries.zh: 星际帝国的首都星球上面充斥着政府建筑、办公室及代理服务机构的高楼大厦。
entries.en: The Capital planet of an interstellar empire is a vast complex of government buildings, bureaus, and agency headquarters.

entries.zh: 首都铸造厂的轰鸣正是我们帝国的脉动。
entries.en: The sound of our Capital's forges is the beating heart of our Empire.

entries.zh: 我们首都的每一个角落都回荡着工厂与生产机器的喧嚣轰鸣。
entries.en: Every corner of our Capital hums with the din of factories and manufacturing plants.

entries.zh: 我们的首都是一座充满贸易和繁荣的大都会。
entries.en: Our Capital is a metropolis of trade and prosperity.

entries.zh: 资源开采活动主宰了首都星球的表面。
entries.en: Resource extraction dominates the Capital planet's surface.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维政体的首都行星是集体意识的中心点，集体意识的所有想法和行动都是源自于此处。
entries.en: The Capital planet of a Hive Mind is the primary seat of the Mind, from where the collective's thoughts and actions spring.

entries.zh: 机械智能政体的首都行星是中央网络意识的核心所在地。
entries.en: The Capital planet of a Machine Intelligence is the primary locus of its central networked consciousness.
